    ## 2. Architecture and state
    
    Use Next.js App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and `lucide-react`, with static deployment on Vercel.
    
    ### Application structure
    
    - **Routes (`src/app`):** `/` for Dashboard, plus `/welcome`, `/chores`, `/expenses`, `/agreements` and `/settings`. A client initialization gate shows loading until storage is read, then presents setup, recovery or the requested screen.
    - **Shared UI (`src/components`, `src/styles`):** App shell, page header, avatar/picker, fields, status pills, accessible dialogs, confirmations, notices and empty states. Desktop sidebar; mobile navigation drawer. Tables become cards on phones; Kanban scrolls within its own region.
    - **Feature modules (`src/features`):** Setup, household, chores, expenses, agreements and dashboard. Keep form drafts local to their feature.
    - **Domain utilities (`src/domain`):** Types, runtime validation, money parsing/allocation, balances, rotation, date helpers and sample generation. These functions must not depend on React or browser storage.
    - **State layer (`src/state`):** One client provider with typed domain actions and shared selectors. Route changes must preserve the provider. Keep browser storage access behind a small adapter.
    
    Follow the PRD's `AppState` model with `schemaVersion: 1`. Use stable IDs and member ordering; retain archived members. Persist facts, selected profile and settings. Calculate balances, transfer suggestions, overdue indicators and dashboard counts from those facts.
    
    ### Important interfaces
    
    - Domain actions cover CRUD, status changes, rotation, archive/restore, profile selection and resets.
    - Commands return success or actionable validation/storage errors.
    - Storage exposes load, save and clear operations with explicit failure results.
    - Inject time and ID generation into domain operations where needed for deterministic tests.
    
    ### Financial rules
    
    - Parse currency input as decimal strings into integer cents; percentages into integer basis points.
    - Require safe integer amounts and reject inputs whose calculations exceed supported integer bounds.
    - Allocate equal-split remainder cents by stable roster order. Use largest remainder for percentages, with the same stable tie-breaker.
    - Validate payer and participant totals independently. Reject duplicate entries for the same member within each role.
    - Generate advisory transfers from open-expense nets, matching largest balances first with stable member-ID ties.
    - Settlement is a confirmed whole-expense marker for resolution outside the app, never an integrated payment action.
    
    ## 3. Persistence and recovery
    
    Use only `localStorage["roomieos:v1"]`.
    
    - Read storage once after client mount. Do not render household-dependent content or save defaults before initialization completes.
    - Distinguish absent data, valid data, malformed/unsupported data and unavailable storage.
    - Validate structure, references, roster constraints, dates and financial invariants on load and before persistence.
    - Generate sample data only after explicit selection or confirmed reset. Base dates on the local date at that moment.
    - For each change, calculate and validate the next state, persist it, then publish it to React. Show success only after saving succeeds.
    - If saving fails, preserve the prior household and the user's form input. Show a useful error and allow retry.
    - Invalid data remains untouched until the user confirms reset. Unsupported versions must not silently become sample data.
    - Reset demo replaces saved state only after confirmation. Start over clears it only after confirmation and successful storage removal.
    - On another tab's storage change, stop stale writes and offer reload before further editing.
    - Store calendar dates as `YYYY-MM-DD`; use timestamps for completion events. Recompute date-sensitive displays on focus and relevant interactions.

    ## 5. Dependencies, tests and risks
    
    ### Dependencies
    
    Next.js, React, React DOM, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and Lucide. Add Zod for runtime validation and Vitest for domain/storage tests. Use native forms and native dialogs with tested focus handling. Avoid state libraries, chart packages, remote fonts and UI frameworks. Select compatible stable package versions during scaffolding and commit the lockfile.
    
    Foundation tooling also includes Playwright for real-browser layout/navigation/dialog checks and Prettier for source formatting. Milestone 2 adds Zod 4.6.7 as a direct runtime dependency. TypeScript is pinned to 6.0.3 because the installed Next.js lint tooling rejects TypeScript 7; ESLint 9 matches the upstream React plugin's supported peer range. Exact dependency versions are recorded in `package-lock.json`.
    
    ### Required verification
    
    - **Money:** 100 cents across three participants yields 34/33/33; multiple payers; percentage rounding/ties; fixed totals; invalid inputs; zero-sum nets; deterministic transfers; settlement/reopening.
    - **Chores:** Completion identity/time; repeated completion without duplicate events for unchanged status; preserved history; rotation wraparound and archived members; yesterday/today comparisons.
    - **State/storage:** Sample and empty initialization; malformed/unsupported payloads; failed reads/writes/clears; roster limits; archive guards; currency blocked by any expenses.
    - **Browser:** Refresh every major flow, switch perspective, cancel dialogs, keyboard navigation/focus restoration, error feedback and every visible action.
    - **Layout:** 375, 768 and 1280 px; contained board scrolling; usable expense forms and dialogs.
    - **Release:** Lint, typecheck, tests and production build; deployed deep links and private-window first-run behavior.
    
    ### Main risks and mitigations
    
    | Risk | Mitigation |
    |---|---|
    | Expense-form complexity and rounding | Implement pure tested arithmetic first; preview exact contributions/shares before save |
    | Storage hydration and data loss | Client initialization gate, runtime validation, explicit recovery and save-before-publish |
    | Archived historical references | Retain member records and stable order; guard reopening and new assignments |
    | Dialog accessibility and mobile density | Reuse shared primitives; check keyboard, focus and small viewports early |
    | Short deadline | Small milestones; prioritize correct required behavior; defer optional visuals/uploads |

    // Serializable household facts. Runtime validation lives in validation.ts.
    export type Currency = "CAD" | "USD" | "EUR" | "GBP";
    export type ChoreStatus = "pending" | "completed" | "skipped";
    export type SplitMethod = "equal" | "percentage" | "fixed";
    export type ExpenseStatus = "open" | "settled";
    
    export type Member = {
      id: string;
      name: string;
      avatar: { kind: "initials" | "icon" | "image"; value: string };
      active: boolean;
      order: number;
    };
    export type CompletionEvent = {
      id: string;
      completedById: string;
      completedAt: string;
    };
    export type Chore = {
      id: string;
      title: string;
      notes: string;
      assigneeId: string;
      dueDate: string;
      status: ChoreStatus;
      completionHistory: CompletionEvent[];
      createdAt: string;
    };
    export type Contribution = { memberId: string; amountCents: number };
    export type ParticipantShare = { memberId: string; amountCents: number };
    export type Expense = {
      id: string;
      description: string;
      amountCents: number;
      date: string;
      category: string;
      notes: string;
      payers: Contribution[];
      participants: ParticipantShare[];
      splitMethod: SplitMethod;
      percentageBasisPoints?: Record<string, number>;
      status: ExpenseStatus;
      createdAt: string;
    };
    export type Agreement = { id: string; title: string; details: string };
    export type AppState = {
      schemaVersion: 1;
      household: { name: string; currency: Currency };
      members: Member[];
      selectedMemberId: string;
      chores: Chore[];
      expenses: Expense[];
      agreements: Agreement[];

    export function isCalendarDate(value: string): boolean {
      if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(value)) return false;
      const [year, month, day] = value.split("-").map(Number);
      if (year < 1 || month < 1 || month > 12) return false;
      const leap = year % 4 === 0 && (year % 100 !== 0 || year % 400 === 0);
      const days = [31, leap ? 29 : 28, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31];
      return day >= 1 && day <= days[month - 1];
    }
    
    export function localDate(date: Date): string {
      return `${String(date.getFullYear()).padStart(4, "0")}-${String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0")}-${String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, "0")}`;
    }
    
    export function relativeDate(now: Date, days: number): string {
      const date = new Date(now);
      date.setHours(12, 0, 0, 0);
      date.setDate(date.getDate() + days);
      return localDate(date);
    }
    
    export function displayDate(value: string): string {
      const [year, month, day] = value.split("-").map(Number);
      const date = new Date(0);
      date.setFullYear(year, month - 1, day);
      date.setHours(12, 0, 0, 0);
      return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en", {
        month: "short",
        day: "numeric",
        year: "numeric",
      }).format(date);
    }

    import type { AppState, Currency, Member } from "./types";
    import { MAX_ACTIVE_MEMBERS, MIN_ACTIVE_MEMBERS } from "./household-options";
    
    export type MemberDraft = Pick<Member, "name" | "avatar">;
    export type SetupInput = {
      name: string;
      currency: Currency;
      members: MemberDraft[];
    };
    export type HouseholdAction =
      | { type: "update-household"; name: string; currency: Currency }
      | { type: "add-member"; member: MemberDraft }
      | { type: "edit-member"; id: string; member: MemberDraft }
      | { type: "archive-member"; id: string }
      | { type: "restore-member"; id: string }
      | { type: "select-member"; id: string };
    
    export function activeMembers(state: AppState): Member[] {
      return state.members
        .filter((member) => member.active)
        .sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order);
    }
    
    export function archiveBlockReason(state: AppState, id: string): string | null {
      if (activeMembers(state).length <= MIN_ACTIVE_MEMBERS)
        return "At least two active roommates must remain.";
      const chores = state.chores.some(
        (chore) => chore.assigneeId === id && chore.status === "pending",
      );
      const expenses = state.expenses.some(
        (expense) =>
          expense.status === "open" &&
          [...expense.payers, ...expense.participants].some(
            (row) => row.memberId === id,
          ),
      );
      if (chores && expenses)
        return "Reassign this roommate's pending chores and settle their open expenses first.";
      if (chores) return "Reassign this roommate's pending chores first.";
      if (expenses) return "Settle this roommate's open expenses first.";
      return null;
    }
    
    export function createEmptyHousehold(
      input: SetupInput,
      makeId: () => string,
    ): AppState {
      const clean = setupSchema.parse({
        ...input,
        name: input.name.trim(),
        members: input.members.map((member) => ({
          ...member,
          name: member.name.trim(),
        })),
      });
      const members = clean.members.map((member, order) => ({
        ...member,
        id: makeId(),
        active: true,
        order,
      }));
      return validateState({
        schemaVersion: 1,
        household: { name: clean.name, currency: clean.currency },
        members,
        selectedMemberId: members[0].id,
        chores: [],
        expenses: [],
        agreements: [],
        starterMode: "empty",
      });
    }
    
    export function applyHouseholdAction(
      state: AppState,
      action: HouseholdAction,
      makeId: () => string,
    ): AppState {
      let next: AppState;
      if (action.type === "update-household") {
        const household = householdDraftSchema.parse({
          name: action.name.trim(),
          currency: action.currency,
        });
        if (
          household.currency !== state.household.currency &&
          state.expenses.length > 0
        )
          throw new Error(
            "Remove all expenses, including settled expenses, before changing currency.",
          );
        next = { ...state, household };
      } else if (action.type === "add-member") {
        if (activeMembers(state).length >= MAX_ACTIVE_MEMBERS)
          throw new Error(
            `A household can have at most ${MAX_ACTIVE_MEMBERS} active roommates.`,
          );
        const member = memberDraftSchema.parse({
          ...action.member,
          name: action.member.name.trim(),
        });
        next = {
          ...state,
          members: [
            ...state.members,
            {
              ...member,
              id: makeId(),
              active: true,
              order: Math.max(...state.members.map((item) => item.order)) + 1,
            },
          ],
        };
      } else {
        const member = state.members.find((item) => item.id === action.id);
        if (!member)
          throw new Error(
            "This roommate could not be found. Reload the household and try again.",
          );
        if (action.type === "select-member") {
          if (!member.active) throw new Error("Choose an active roommate.");
          next = { ...state, selectedMemberId: member.id };
        } else if (action.type === "edit-member") {
          const changes = memberDraftSchema.parse({
            ...action.member,
            name: action.member.name.trim(),
          });
          next = {
            ...state,
            members: state.members.map((item) =>
              item.id === member.id ? { ...item, ...changes } : item,
            ),
          };
        } else {
          const active = action.type === "restore-member";
          if (member.active === active) return state;
          if (active && activeMembers(state).length >= MAX_ACTIVE_MEMBERS)
            throw new Error(
              `Archive another roommate before restoring this one. The active limit is ${MAX_ACTIVE_MEMBERS}.`,
            );
          if (!active) {
            const reason = archiveBlockReason(state, member.id);
            if (reason) throw new Error(reason);
          }
          next = {
            ...state,
            members: state.members.map((item) =>
              item.id === member.id ? { ...item, active } : item,
            ),
          };
        }
      }
      return validateState(next);
    }
    import { ZodError } from "zod";
    import {
      applyHouseholdAction,
      createEmptyHousehold,
      type HouseholdAction,
      type SetupInput,

    import { createSampleHousehold } from "../domain/sample";
    import { validateState } from "../domain/validation";
    import type { AppState, Currency } from "../domain/types";
    
    export const STORAGE_KEY = "roomieos:v1";
    export type StoragePort = Pick<Storage, "getItem" | "setItem" | "removeItem">;
    export type CommandResult = { ok: true } | { ok: false; error: string };
    export type HouseholdSnapshot = {
      status: "loading" | "empty" | "ready" | "invalid" | "unavailable";
      state: AppState | null;
      error: string | null;
      conflict: boolean;
      notice: string | null;
    };
    export const initialSnapshot: HouseholdSnapshot = {
      status: "loading",
      state: null,
      error: null,
      conflict: false,
      notice: null,
    };
    
    export function createHouseholdStore(
      getStorage: () => StoragePort,
      makeId = () => crypto.randomUUID(),
      now = () => new Date(),
    ) {
      let snapshot = initialSnapshot;
      let lastRaw: string | null = null;
      const listeners = new Set<() => void>();
      const publish = (changes: Partial<HouseholdSnapshot>) => {
        snapshot = { ...snapshot, ...changes };
        listeners.forEach((listener) => listener());
      };
      const failure = (message: string): CommandResult => {
        publish({ error: message, notice: null });
        return { ok: false, error: message };
      };
      const messageFor = (error: unknown) =>
        error instanceof ZodError
          ? (error.issues[0]?.message ?? "Check the form and try again.")
          : error instanceof Error
            ? error.message
            : "The change could not be saved. Try again.";
    
      function initialize() {
        let raw: string | null;
        try {
          raw = getStorage().getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
        } catch {
          publish({
            status: "unavailable",
            state: null,
            error:
              "Browser storage is unavailable. Allow site storage and try again. Your saved data has not been replaced.",
            conflict: false,
            notice: null,
          });
          return;
        }
        lastRaw = raw;
        if (raw === null) {
          publish({
            status: "empty",
            state: null,
            error: null,
            conflict: false,
            notice: null,
          });
          return;
        }
        try {
          const state = validateState(JSON.parse(raw));
          publish({
            status: "ready",
            state,
            error: null,
            conflict: false,
            notice: null,
          });
        } catch {
          publish({
            status: "invalid",
            state: null,
            error:
              "Saved data couldn't be opened. It may be damaged or from an unsupported version. Nothing has been overwritten.",
            conflict: false,
            notice: null,
          });
        }
      }
    
      function checkCurrent(storage: StoragePort) {
        if (snapshot.conflict || storage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY) !== lastRaw) {
          publish({ conflict: true });
          throw new Error(
            "This household changed in another tab. Reload the saved household before making more changes.",
          );
        }
      }
    
      function write(next: AppState, notice: string): CommandResult {
        let state: AppState;
        try {
          state = validateState(next);
        } catch (error) {
          return failure(messageFor(error));
        }
        let storage: StoragePort;
        try {
          storage = getStorage();
          checkCurrent(storage);
        } catch (error) {
          return failure(
            snapshot.conflict
              ? messageFor(error)
              : "Couldn't access browser storage. Your change has not been saved. Allow site storage and retry.",
          );
        }
        const raw = JSON.stringify(state);
        try {
          storage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, raw);
        } catch {
          return failure(
            "Couldn't save changes. Browser storage may be full or blocked. Your previous household and form entries are unchanged. Free some space or allow site storage, then retry.",
          );
        }
        lastRaw = raw;
        publish({ status: "ready", state, error: null, notice, conflict: false });
        return { ok: true };
      }
    
      function dispatch(action: HouseholdAction, notice: string): CommandResult {
        if (snapshot.status !== "ready" || !snapshot.state)
          return failure("Open a valid household before making changes.");
        try {
          return write(
            applyHouseholdAction(snapshot.state, action, makeId),
            notice,
          );
        } catch (error) {
          return failure(messageFor(error));
        }
      }
    
      function setup(input: SetupInput): CommandResult {
        if (snapshot.status !== "empty")
          return failure(
            "A saved household already exists. Open it or use Start over in Settings.",
          );
        try {
          return write(
            createEmptyHousehold(input, makeId),
            "Your household is ready.",
          );
        } catch (error) {
          return failure(messageFor(error));
        }
      }
    
      function sample(currency: Currency, reset = false): CommandResult {
        if (
          (!reset && snapshot.status !== "empty") ||
          (reset && snapshot.status !== "ready")
        )
          return failure(
            "Open the household before resetting, or start from the welcome screen.",
          );
        return write(
          createSampleHousehold(now(), currency),
          reset ? "Sample household restored." : "Welcome to Maple House.",
        );
      }
    
      function clear(): CommandResult {
        if (snapshot.status !== "ready" && snapshot.status !== "invalid")
          return failure("No household is available to clear.");
        try {
          const storage = getStorage();
          checkCurrent(storage);
          storage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY);
        } catch (error) {
          return failure(
            snapshot.conflict
              ? messageFor(error)
              : "Couldn't clear saved data. Allow browser storage and try again. Your household has been kept.",
          );
        }
        lastRaw = null;
        publish({
          status: "empty",
          state: null,
          error: null,
          conflict: false,
          notice: "Saved household cleared.",
        });
        return { ok: true };
      }
    
      function checkForExternalChange() {
        if (snapshot.status === "loading" || snapshot.status === "unavailable")
          return;
        try {
          if (getStorage().getItem(STORAGE_KEY) !== lastRaw)
            publish({ conflict: true, notice: null });
        } catch {
          publish({
            error:
              "Couldn't check browser storage. Saving will verify it again before applying any change.",
            notice: null,
          });
        }
      }
    
      return {
        getSnapshot: () => snapshot,
        subscribe: (listener: () => void) => {
          listeners.add(listener);
          return () => {
            listeners.delete(listener);
          };
        },
        initialize,
        dispatch,
        setup,
        sample,
        clear,
        checkForExternalChange,
        dismissFeedback: () => publish({ error: null, notice: null }),
      };
    }

    - List view shows title, assignee, due date and status; supports status and assignee filters.
    - Kanban has **Pending / Completed / Skipped** columns and allows changing status using clear controls (drag/drop is optional polish, not a requirement).
    - Only Pending chores dated before today are marked **Overdue**; due today is not overdue. Responsive mobile view allows access to all columns without clipped inaccessible content.
    
    ### 5.4 Shared expenses and settlements
    ### 5.3 Chores
    
    Header: `Chores` / short description / right-aligned `+ New chore` button.
    
    Below: segmented `List | Board` control, status/roommate filters (compact). Persist view choice if easy, but not essential.
    
    **List view:** clean Notion-like table with columns: title, assigned to (avatar + name), due date, status; on narrow screens convert rows to cards. Notes visible in detail panel, not as wide text columns.
    
    **Kanban board:** exactly three columns with compact headers and counts: `Pending`, `Completed`, `Skipped`. Cards show title, assignee avatar, due date, optional one-line notes. Click opens details; status action reachable without drag/drop. Dragging between columns is **not necessary** and should not displace functional status controls.
    
    **Create/edit modal or drawer fields:** Title (required), Assignee (active member picker), Due date (native date control), Notes (multiline, optional). Clearly label `Save` and `Cancel`. Form errors are inline.
    
    **Details:** primary status action, `Rotate to next`, edit, delete. History panel shows `Completed by Avery • 22 Nov` in reverse chronological order. Rotation asks for the next due date and names the next assignee before confirmation.
    
    **Status visuals:**
    - Pending = neutral gray pill.
    - Completed = gentle green pill with check icon.
    - Skipped = amber neutral pill with skip icon.
    - Overdue = small red `Overdue` label alongside **Pending** status; no red full-screen treatment.

    # RoomieOS — Codex repository instructions
    
    ## Mission and source of truth
    
    Build **RoomieOS**, a polished, accessible **client-side prototype** for university students living with roommates. The app coordinates chores, shared expenses and household agreements. It is an ENTI 407 Creation Project with a Friday, 27 November 2026 deadline.
    
    Read the relevant sections of:
    - `docs/PRD.md` — product requirements, decisions, invariants and acceptance criteria. **Authoritative for behavior.**
    - `docs/DESIGN.md` — visual language, navigation, components and responsive behavior. **Authoritative for UI/UX.**
    - `PLAN.md` — approved architecture, implementation milestones, decisions and verification progress. **Authoritative for sequencing and progress.**
    
    These files contain the agreed decisions. Don't redesign features based on assumptions, or rewrite these documents unless the user explicitly asks. For a small scoped change, consult only the relevant sections rather than repeatedly reading every line.
    
    Read `PLAN.md` before implementation. Follow its approved milestones and update progress, actual verification results, blockers and approved decisions after each working slice. `docs/PRD.md` remains authoritative for behavior and `docs/DESIGN.md` for UI/UX; `PLAN.md` governs sequencing and progress. Surface conflicts rather than inventing requirements or silently expanding scope. Do not mark unchecked behavior as verified. Routine progress updates to `PLAN.md` are expected; changes to approved scope or decisions require user approval.
    
    ## Hard scope constraints
    
    - Stack: **Next.js + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS + Lucide icons (`lucide-react`)**; deploy on **Vercel**.
    - Persist a single versioned household in **browser `localStorage`**, key `roomieos:v1`.
    - **No backend, database service, authentication, user accounts, cloud storage, WebSockets, API keys, third-party AI, analytics or network integrations.**
    - **No fake collaboration.** A profile switcher represents a *local demo perspective*, not a real authenticated roommate.
    - **No actual money transfers.** Expense settlement is a manual whole-expense marker; don't imply an integrated payment system.
    - One household; **2–20 active roommates**. First-run must explicitly offer **sample household** or **empty household setup**.
    - Archived roommates do not count toward the active limit. Avatar selectors offer initials and 40 named, grouped local icon presets; see `PLAN.md` for the approved expansion.
    - Essential screens: Dashboard, Chores (List + Kanban), Expenses, Agreements, Settings, and first-run Welcome.
    - Household currency (CAD, USD, EUR, GBP) is chosen by the user; no exchange-rate calculation. Block currency changes while any expenses exist.
    - No activity feed, scheduled/background jobs, push notifications, drag-and-drop dependency, or additional features beyond PRD without approval.
    
    ## Rules that must not be broken
    
    1. **Do all expense arithmetic in integer cents.** Payer contributions and participant shares must separately sum exactly to total. Never use floating-point totals for stored financial amounts.
    2. Support **multiple payers** and all three participant split modes: equal, percentage, fixed. Use deterministic cent-allocation and validate every form.
    3. Only **open** expenses contribute to member net balances. `memberNet = totalPaid - totalShare`. Sum of nets must be zero. Debt simplification should preserve amounts and avoid invented payments.
    4. **Settling an expense means fully resolved outside the app**, excludes its net from outstanding balances, retains the record, and can be undone.
    5. Chore states are **pending, completed, skipped**. Completing writes an immutable completion event containing who and when; reopening/rotation doesn't delete history.
    6. Manual chore rotation walks the **stable active roommate roster order**, wraps around, reopens the chore as Pending and asks/confirms a new due date.
    7. Archive an active roommate only if >=2 active remain and the member has **no pending assigned chores or unsettled expense participation/contribution**. Historical records keep member identity; archived members are excluded from new selections.
    8. Every important change persists after refresh in the same browser. Refresh must not overwrite a visitor's modifications with seed data.
    9. Handle invalid input and storage failure gracefully; never silently corrupt saved state.
    10. Do not introduce dead buttons, placeholder interactions, fabricated dashboard statistics, or UI claims that contradict the local-only prototype.
    
    ## Implementation approach
    
    - Favor a clear structure (pages/features/components/domain utilities/state) over unnecessary layers, abstractions or frameworks.
    - Use typed, serializable state with `schemaVersion: 1`. Validate data on load and recover with a user-visible choice if the stored payload is invalid.
    - Put financial splitting, netting and chore rotation in **pure functions**; keep UI components thin.
    - Keep a single source of truth for the household state. Derived totals, balances and dashboard counts must be calculated from state, not persisted redundantly.
    - Use semantic HTML, accessible labeled forms and keyboard-operable dialogs. Maintain desktop and mobile usability.
    - Prefer reuse of a small set of components: app shell, member avatar/picker, modal, forms, status pill, table/cards, empty state.
    - Seed realistic *valid* demo data only when selected or reset. Use relative dates to keep overdue examples meaningful.
    - Avatar upload is optional and lower priority; initials/icons must always work without uploads or remote image URLs.
    - Avoid dependencies that are not justified for a four-day prototype.
    
    ## Workflow when implementing a task
    
    1. Identify the requested feature and consult the relevant PRD/DESIGN sections. **If the user says plan only, do not modify files.**
    2. Briefly state the intended files/behavior when the change is substantial; implement a narrow, testable slice.
    3. Test the change: run available project scripts (`npm run build`, tests, lint/typecheck if configured). Don't claim commands ran unless they actually ran.
    4. For expense math, test cent rounding, multiple payers, custom percentage/fixed splits, zero-sum nets, settlement/reopen and invalid totals.
    5. For chores, test completion history, rotation wraparound, archived members and overdue date comparisons.
    6. Manually outline UI checks the user should perform (especially refresh, empty state, Kanban, and mobile).
    7. Report succinctly: what changed, test results, known limitations, and the next suitable slice. If blocked, explain precisely.
    8. Preserve working functionality. Make small focused edits; do not casually rewrite unrelated modules.
    
    ## Suggested delivery order
    
    1. Project scaffold, visual shell, welcome sample/empty setup, household roster, local persistence.
    2. Chores CRUD, status/history, rotation, list/Kanban, overdue.
    3. Expenses CRUD, all contribution/split modes, cents math, simplified balances and settlement.
    4. Dashboard integration, agreements, settings, confirmations and reset.
    5. Responsive/accessibility polish, build/test verification, deploy.
    
    The PRD's must-have correctness and course deliverables outrank optional styling extras. Prioritize a usable, complete app by Thursday, leaving Friday as a buffer.
    
    ## Git and submission hygiene
    
    - Keep changes reviewable. Prefer commits at working milestones; **do not run destructive Git commands or overwrite user changes** without permission.
    - Never commit secrets, credentials or irrelevant personal data. No secrets are required by this project.
    - The course requests **the complete dated conversation with the AI builder** as a prompt log. Do **not** fabricate, summarize in place of, or retroactively invent prompts or dates. The user should export/save the **real Codex session transcript** from their Codex environment and review it before submission. `docs/PRD.md` and `docs/DESIGN.md` may accompany the log as appendices.
    - A passing build isn't proof of perfect UX: make it easy to verify functionality manually in a browser.

          if (chore.status === "completed" && chore.completionHistory.length === 0)

                (expense.status === "open" && !members.get(row.memberId)?.active),
            )
          )
            issue("Open expenses must reference active roommates.");
          for (const rows of [expense.payers, expense.participants]) {
            if (!unique(rows.map((row) => row.memberId)))
              issue("A roommate may occur only once in each expense role.");
            if (
              rows.reduce((total, row) => total + BigInt(row.amountCents), 0n) !==
              BigInt(expense.amountCents)
            )
              issue("Expense contributions and shares must each equal the total.");
          }
          if (
            expense.splitMethod !== "percentage" &&
            expense.percentageBasisPoints !== undefined
          )
            issue("Only percentage splits may have percentage weights.");
          if (expense.splitMethod === "fixed") continue;
          const participants = [...expense.participants].sort(
            (a, b) =>
              (members.get(a.memberId)?.order ?? 0) -
              (members.get(b.memberId)?.order ?? 0),
          );
          const weights = expense.percentageBasisPoints;
          if (
            expense.splitMethod === "percentage" &&
            (!weights ||
              Object.keys(weights).length !== participants.length ||
              participants.some((row) => weights[row.memberId] === undefined) ||
              Object.values(weights).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) !== 10000)

            issue("Percentages must match the participants and total 100.00%.");
            continue;
          }
          // BigInt protects validation of large saved amounts from unsafe intermediate products.
          const divisor = BigInt(
            expense.splitMethod === "equal" ? participants.length : 10000,
          );
          const allocations = participants.map((row, index) => {
            const product =
              BigInt(expense.amountCents) *
              BigInt(expense.splitMethod === "equal" ? 1 : weights![row.memberId]);
            return {
              row,
              index,
              amount: product / divisor,
              remainder: product % divisor,

          const remaining = Number(
            BigInt(expense.amountCents) -
              allocations.reduce(
                (total, allocation) => total + allocation.amount,
                0n,

          const ranked = [...allocations].sort((a, b) =>
            a.remainder === b.remainder
              ? a.index - b.index
              : a.remainder > b.remainder
                ? -1
                : 1,
          );
          ranked.slice(0, remaining).forEach((allocation) => {
            allocation.amount += 1n;
          });
          if (
            allocations.some(
              (allocation) =>
                BigInt(allocation.row.amountCents) !== allocation.amount,
            )
          )
            issue("Saved shares do not match the chosen split.");
        }
      });
    
    export function validateState(value: unknown): AppState {
      const state = stateSchema.parse(value);
      if (
        !state.members.find((member) => member.id === state.selectedMemberId)
          ?.active
      ) {
        state.selectedMemberId = [...state.members]
          .filter((member) => member.active)
          .sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order)[0].id;
      }
      return state;
    }

    function harness(initial: string | null = null) {
      let raw = initial;

        failWrite = false,
        failClear = false;
      let writes = 0;
      const storage: StoragePort = {
        getItem: () => {
          if (failRead) throw new Error("blocked");
          return raw;
        },
        setItem: (_key, value) => {
          if (failWrite) throw new Error("quota");
          raw = value;
          writes++;
        },
        removeItem: () => {
          if (failClear) throw new Error("blocked");
          raw = null;
        },
      };
      const store = createHouseholdStore(
        () => storage,
        () => "generated",
        () => now,
      );
      return {
        store,
        storage,
        raw: () => raw,
        writes: () => writes,
        external: (value: string | null) => {
          raw = value;
        },
        failReads: (value: boolean) => {
          failRead = value;
        },
        failWrites: (value: boolean) => {
          failWrite = value;
        },
        failClears: (value: boolean) => {
          failClear = value;
        },
      };
    }

      };

    "use client";
    
    import {
      createContext,
      useContext,
      useEffect,
      useState,
      useSyncExternalStore,
      type ReactNode,
    } from "react";
    import {
      createHouseholdStore,
      initialSnapshot,
      STORAGE_KEY,
      type HouseholdStore,
    } from "./household-store";
    
    const HouseholdContext = createContext<HouseholdStore | null>(null);
    
    export function HouseholdProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
      const [store] = useState(() =>
        createHouseholdStore(() => window.localStorage),
      );
      useEffect(() => {
        store.initialize();
        const onStorage = (event: StorageEvent) => {
          if (event.key === STORAGE_KEY || event.key === null)
            store.checkForExternalChange();
        };
        const onFocus = () => store.checkForExternalChange();
        window.addEventListener("storage", onStorage);
        window.addEventListener("focus", onFocus);
        return () => {
          window.removeEventListener("storage", onStorage);
          window.removeEventListener("focus", onFocus);
        };
      }, [store]);
      return (
        <HouseholdContext.Provider value={store}>
          {children}
        </HouseholdContext.Provider>
      );
    }
    
    export function useHousehold() {
      const store = useContext(HouseholdContext);
      if (!store) throw new Error("HouseholdProvider is missing.");
      const snapshot = useSyncExternalStore(
        store.subscribe,
        store.getSnapshot,
        () => initialSnapshot,
      );
      return { ...snapshot, store };
    }
    
    export function useReadyHousehold() {
      const household = useHousehold();
      if (!household.state)
        throw new Error("This view requires a loaded household.");
      return { ...household, state: household.state };
    }
    "use client";
    
    import { useEffect, useId, useRef, type ReactNode } from "react";
    import { X } from "lucide-react";
    import { Button } from "./button";
    import { InlineNotice } from "./inline-notice";
    
    type DialogProps = {
      open: boolean;
      onClose: () => void;
      title: string;
      description?: string;
      children: ReactNode;
      variant?: "modal" | "drawer";
      id?: string;
    };
    
    export function Dialog({
      open,
      onClose,
      title,
      description,
      children,
      variant = "modal",
      id,
    }: DialogProps) {
      const dialogRef = useRef<HTMLDialogElement>(null);
      const titleId = useId();
      const descriptionId = useId();
    
      useEffect(() => {
        const dialog = dialogRef.current;
        if (!dialog || !open) return;
        const trigger =
          document.activeElement instanceof HTMLElement
            ? document.activeElement
            : null;
        dialog.showModal();
        return () => {
          dialog.close();
          if (trigger?.isConnected) trigger.focus();
        };
      }, [open]);
    
      return (
        <dialog
          ref={dialogRef}
          id={id}

    ---
    title: use client
    description: Learn how to use the use client directive to render a component on the client.
    ---
    
    The `'use client'` directive declares an entry point for the components to be rendered on the **client side** and should be used when creating interactive user interfaces (UI) that require client-side JavaScript capabilities, such as state management, event handling, and access to browser APIs. This is a React feature.
    
    > **Good to know:**
    >
    > You do not need to add the `'use client'` directive to every file that contains Client Components. You only need to add it to the files whose components you want to render directly within Server Components. The `'use client'` directive defines the [server and client boundary](/docs/app/guides/server-and-client-boundary), and the components exported from such a file serve as entry points to the client.
    
    ## Usage
    
    To declare an entry point for the Client Components, add the `'use client'` directive **at the top of the file**, before any imports. The directive applies to the entire module and cannot be placed inside a component or function:
    
    ```tsx filename="app/components/counter.tsx" highlight={1} switcher
    'use client'
    
    import { useState } from 'react'
    
    export default function Counter() {
      const [count, setCount] = useState(0)
    
      return (
        <div>
          <p>Count: {count}</p>
          <button onClick={() => setCount(count + 1)}>Increment</button>
        </div>
      )
    }
    ```
    
    ```jsx filename="app/components/counter.js" highlight={1} switcher
    'use client'
    
    import { useState } from 'react'
    
    export default function Counter() {
      const [count, setCount] = useState(0)
    
      return (
        <div>
          <p>Count: {count}</p>
          <button onClick={() => setCount(count + 1)}>Increment</button>
        </div>
      )
    }
    ```
    
    When using the `'use client'` directive, the props of the Client Components must be [serializable](https://react.dev/reference/rsc/use-client#serializable-types). This means the props need to be in a format that React can serialize when sending data from the server to the client.
    
    ```tsx filename="app/components/counter.tsx" highlight={4} switcher
    'use client'
    
    export default function Counter({
      onClick /* ❌ Function is not serializable */,
    }) {
      return (
        <div>
          <button onClick={onClick}>Increment</button>
        </div>
      )
    }
    ```
    
    ```jsx filename="app/components/counter.js" highlight={4} switcher
    'use client'
    
    export default function Counter({
      onClick /* ❌ Function is not serializable */,
    }) {
      return (
        <div>
          <button onClick={onClick}>Increment</button>
        </div>
      )
    }
    ```
    
    ## Nesting Client Components within Server Components
    
    Combining Server and Client Components allows you to build applications that are both performant and interactive:
    
    1. **Server Components**: Use for static content, data fetching, and SEO-friendly elements.
    2. **Client Components**: Use for interactive elements that require state, effects, or browser APIs.
    3. **Component composition**: Nest Client Components within Server Components as needed for a clear separation of server and client logic.
    
    In the following example:
    
    - `Header` is a Server Component handling static content.
    - `Counter` is a Client Component enabling interactivity within the page.
    
    ```tsx filename="app/page.tsx" highlight={2,8} switcher
    import Header from './header'
    import Counter from './counter' // This is a Client Component
    
    export default function Page() {
      return (
        <div>
          <Header />
          <Counter />
        </div>
      )
    }
    ```
    
    ```jsx filename="app/page.js" highlight={2,8} switcher
    import Header from './header'
    import Counter from './counter' // This is a Client Component
    
    export default function Page() {
      return (
        <div>
          <Header />
          <Counter />
        </div>
      )
    }
    ```
    
    ## Reference
    
    See the [React documentation](https://react.dev/reference/rsc/use-client) for more information on `'use client'`.

    import { z } from "zod";
    import { isCalendarDate } from "./dates";
    import type { AppState } from "./types";
    import {
      avatarIcons,
      MAX_ACTIVE_MEMBERS,
      MIN_ACTIVE_MEMBERS,
    } from "./household-options";
    
    export const currencies = ["CAD", "USD", "EUR", "GBP"] as const;
    const id = z.string().min(1).max(100);
    const text = (max: number) =>
      z
        .string()
        .min(1)
        .max(max)
        .refine(
          (value) => value === value.trim(),
          "Remove spaces at the beginning or end.",
        );
    const cents = z.number().int().nonnegative().max(Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER);
    const calendarDate = z
      .string()
      .refine(isCalendarDate, "Choose a valid calendar date.");
    const timestamp = z.iso.datetime({ offset: true });
    
    export const avatarSchema = z.discriminatedUnion("kind", [
      z.strictObject({ kind: z.literal("initials"), value: z.literal("") }),
      z.strictObject({ kind: z.literal("icon"), value: z.enum(avatarIcons) }),
      z.strictObject({
        kind: z.literal("image"),
        value: z
          .string()
          .max(100_000)
          .regex(/^data:image\/(png|jpeg|webp);base64,[A-Za-z0-9+/=]+$/),
      }),
    ]);
    export const memberDraftSchema = z.strictObject({
      name: text(40),
      avatar: avatarSchema,
    });
    export const householdDraftSchema = z.strictObject({
      name: text(60),
      currency: z.enum(currencies),
    });
    export const setupSchema = householdDraftSchema.extend({
      members: z
        .array(memberDraftSchema)
        .min(MIN_ACTIVE_MEMBERS)
        .max(MAX_ACTIVE_MEMBERS),
    });
    
    const stateSchema = z
      .strictObject({
        schemaVersion: z.literal(1),
        household: householdDraftSchema,
        members: z.array(
          memberDraftSchema.extend({
            id,
            active: z.boolean(),
            order: z
              .number()
              .int()
              .nonnegative()
              .max(Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER - 1),
          }),
        ),
        selectedMemberId: id,
        chores: z.array(
          z.strictObject({
            id,
            title: text(100),
            notes: z.string().max(1000),
            assigneeId: id,
            dueDate: calendarDate,
            status: z.enum(["pending", "completed", "skipped"]),
            completionHistory: z.array(
              z.strictObject({ id, completedById: id, completedAt: timestamp }),
            ),
            createdAt: timestamp,
          }),
        ),
        expenses: z.array(
          z.strictObject({
            id,
            description: text(100),
            amountCents: cents.positive(),
            date: calendarDate,
            category: text(50),
            notes: z.string().max(1000),
            payers: z
              .array(
                z.strictObject({ memberId: id, amountCents: cents.positive() }),
              )
              .min(1),
            participants: z
              .array(z.strictObject({ memberId: id, amountCents: cents }))
              .min(1),
            splitMethod: z.enum(["equal", "percentage", "fixed"]),
            percentageBasisPoints: z
              .record(id, z.number().int().min(0).max(10000))
              .optional(),
            status: z.enum(["open", "settled"]),
            createdAt: timestamp,
          }),
        ),
        agreements: z.array(
          z.strictObject({ id, title: text(100), details: z.string().max(1000) }),
        ),
        starterMode: z.enum(["sample", "empty"]),
      })
      .superRefine((state, ctx) => {
        const issue = (message: string) =>
          ctx.addIssue({ code: "custom", message });
        const unique = (values: (string | number)[]) =>
          new Set(values).size === values.length;
        const members = new Map(state.members.map((member) => [member.id, member]));
        const active = state.members.filter((member) => member.active);
        if (
          active.length < MIN_ACTIVE_MEMBERS ||
          active.length > MAX_ACTIVE_MEMBERS
        )
          issue(
            `A household needs ${MIN_ACTIVE_MEMBERS}–${MAX_ACTIVE_MEMBERS} active roommates.`,
          );
        if (
          !unique(state.members.map((member) => member.id)) ||
          !unique(state.members.map((member) => member.order))
        )
          issue("Roommate identities and roster positions must be unique.");
        if (!members.has(state.selectedMemberId))
          issue("The selected roommate does not exist.");
        for (const collection of [state.chores, state.expenses, state.agreements]) {
          if (!unique(collection.map((item) => item.id)))
            issue("Record identities must be unique.");
        }
        const events = state.chores.flatMap((chore) => chore.completionHistory);
        if (!unique(events.map((event) => event.id)))
          issue("Completion identities must be unique.");
        for (const chore of state.chores) {
          if (
            !members.has(chore.assigneeId) ||
            (chore.status === "pending" && !members.get(chore.assigneeId)?.active)
          )
            issue("Pending chores must be assigned to active roommates.");
          if (chore.status === "completed" && chore.completionHistory.length === 0)
            issue("Completed chores need a completion event.");
          if (
            chore.completionHistory.some(
              (event) => !members.has(event.completedById),
            )
          )
            issue("Completion history references a missing roommate.");
        }
        for (const expense of state.expenses) {
          const all = [...expense.payers, ...expense.participants];
          if (
            all.some(
              (row) =>
                !members.has(row.memberId) ||
                (expense.status === "open" && !members.get(row.memberId)?.active),
            )
          )
            issue("Open expenses must reference active roommates.");
          for (const rows of [expense.payers, expense.participants]) {
            if (!unique(rows.map((row) => row.memberId)))
              issue("A roommate may occur only once in each expense role.");
            if (
              rows.reduce((total, row) => total + BigInt(row.amountCents), 0n) !==
              BigInt(expense.amountCents)
            )
              issue("Expense contributions and shares must each equal the total.");
          }
          if (
            expense.splitMethod !== "percentage" &&
            expense.percentageBasisPoints !== undefined
          )
            issue("Only percentage splits may have percentage weights.");
          if (expense.splitMethod === "fixed") continue;
          const participants = [...expense.participants].sort(
            (a, b) =>
              (members.get(a.memberId)?.order ?? 0) -
              (members.get(b.memberId)?.order ?? 0),
          );
          const weights = expense.percentageBasisPoints;
          if (
            expense.splitMethod === "percentage" &&
            (!weights ||
              Object.keys(weights).length !== participants.length ||
              participants.some((row) => weights[row.memberId] === undefined) ||
              Object.values(weights).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) !== 10000)
          ) {
            issue("Percentages must match the participants and total 100.00%.");
            continue;
          }
          // BigInt protects validation of large saved amounts from unsafe intermediate products.
          const divisor = BigInt(
            expense.splitMethod === "equal" ? participants.length : 10000,
          );
          const allocations = participants.map((row, index) => {
            const product =
              BigInt(expense.amountCents) *
              BigInt(expense.splitMethod === "equal" ? 1 : weights![row.memberId]);
            return {
              row,
              index,
              amount: product / divisor,
              remainder: product % divisor,
            };
          });
          const remaining = Number(
            BigInt(expense.amountCents) -
              allocations.reduce(
                (total, allocation) => total + allocation.amount,
                0n,
              ),
          );
          const ranked = [...allocations].sort((a, b) =>
            a.remainder === b.remainder
              ? a.index - b.index
              : a.remainder > b.remainder
                ? -1
                : 1,
          );
          ranked.slice(0, remaining).forEach((allocation) => {
            allocation.amount += 1n;
          });
          if (
            allocations.some(
              (allocation) =>
                BigInt(allocation.row.amountCents) !== allocation.amount,
            )
          )
            issue("Saved shares do not match the chosen split.");
        }
      });
    
    export function validateState(value: unknown): AppState {
      const state = stateSchema.parse(value);
      if (
        !state.members.find((member) => member.id === state.selectedMemberId)
          ?.active
      ) {
        state.selectedMemberId = [...state.members]
          .filter((member) => member.active)
          .sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order)[0].id;
      }
      return state;
    }

    import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
    import { createHouseholdStore, type StoragePort } from "./household-store";
    import { createSampleHousehold } from "../domain/sample";
    
    const now = new Date(2026, 10, 23, 12);
    function harness(initial: string | null = null) {
      let raw = initial;
      let failRead = false,
        failWrite = false,
        failClear = false;
      let writes = 0;
      const storage: StoragePort = {
        getItem: () => {
          if (failRead) throw new Error("blocked");
          return raw;
        },
        setItem: (_key, value) => {
          if (failWrite) throw new Error("quota");
          raw = value;
          writes++;
        },
        removeItem: () => {
          if (failClear) throw new Error("blocked");
          raw = null;
        },
      };
      const store = createHouseholdStore(
        () => storage,
        () => "generated",
        () => now,
      );
      return {
        store,
        storage,
        raw: () => raw,
        writes: () => writes,
        external: (value: string | null) => {
          raw = value;
        },
        failReads: (value: boolean) => {
          failRead = value;
        },
        failWrites: (value: boolean) => {
          failWrite = value;
        },
        failClears: (value: boolean) => {
          failClear = value;
        },
      };
    }
    
    describe("browser persistence transaction", () => {
      it("does not seed or write during initialization, including repeated initialization", () => {
        const h = harness();
        expect(h.store.getSnapshot().status).toBe("loading");
        h.store.initialize();
        h.store.initialize();

        expect(h.raw()).toBeNull();
        expect(h.writes()).toBe(0);
        expect(h.store.sample("USD").ok).toBe(true);
        const saved = h.raw();
        h.store.initialize();
        expect(h.raw()).toBe(saved);
        expect(h.writes()).toBe(1);
      });
      it("persists before notifying subscribers and retains all modified facts after refresh", () => {
        const h = harness();
        h.store.initialize();
        h.store.sample("EUR");
        const savedFacts = h.store.getSnapshot().state!;
        const unsubscribe = h.store.subscribe(() => {
          const snapshot = h.store.getSnapshot();
          if (snapshot.state?.household.name === "New name")
            expect(JSON.parse(h.raw()!).household.name).toBe("New name");
        });
        h.store.dispatch(
          { type: "update-household", name: "New name", currency: "EUR" },
          "Saved",
        );
        h.store.dispatch({ type: "select-member", id: "jordan" }, "Switched");
        unsubscribe();
        const refreshed = createHouseholdStore(() => h.storage);
        refreshed.initialize();
        expect(refreshed.getSnapshot().state).toEqual({

          household: { name: "New name", currency: "EUR" },
          selectedMemberId: "jordan",
        });
      });
      it.each(["{bad json", JSON.stringify({ schemaVersion: 99 }), "null", ""])(
        "keeps invalid data untouched until an explicit clear (%s)",

          expect(h.raw()).toBe(raw);
          expect(h.writes()).toBe(0);
          expect(h.store.clear().ok).toBe(true);

          expect(h.store.getSnapshot().status).toBe("empty");
        },
      );
      it("supports retry after storage reads are blocked", () => {

        h.failReads(true);
        h.store.initialize();
        expect(h.store.getSnapshot().status).toBe("unavailable");
        h.failReads(false);
        h.store.initialize();
        expect(h.store.getSnapshot().status).toBe("empty");
      });
      it("does not publish failed writes or show a successful save", () => {

        h.failWrites(false);
        expect(

      it("retains the household on failed start-over and reset writes", () => {

        expect(h.store.getSnapshot().conflict).toBe(false);

        expect(h.store.sample("CAD", true).ok).toBe(false);
        expect(h.raw()).toBeNull();
      });
    });

    function HouseholdForm({ state }: { state: AppState }) {
      const { store, conflict } = useReadyHousehold();
      const [name, setName] = useState(state.household.name);
      const [currency, setCurrency] = useState(state.household.currency);
      const [nameError, setNameError] = useState<string>();
      function submit(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
        event.preventDefault();
        const result = householdDraftSchema.safeParse({
          name: name.trim(),
          currency,
        });
        if (!result.success) {
          setNameError("Enter a household name (1–60 characters).");
          focusInvalid(event.currentTarget);
          return;
        }
        setNameError(undefined);
        store.dispatch(
          { type: "update-household", ...result.data },
          "Household saved.",
        );
      }
      return (
        <section className="border-t border-line py-7">
          <h2 className="mb-5 text-lg font-semibold">Household</h2>
          <form noValidate onSubmit={submit} className="max-w-xl space-y-5">
            <FormField
              id="settings-household-name"
              label="Household name"
              value={name}
              onChange={(event) => {
                setName(event.target.value);
                setNameError(undefined);
              }}
              required
              maxLength={60}
              error={nameError}
            />
            <CurrencyField
              value={currency}
              onChange={setCurrency}
              disabled={state.expenses.length > 0}
            />
            {state.expenses.length > 0 && (
              <p className="text-sm text-muted">
                Currency is locked while any expenses exist, including settled
                expenses. Remove all expenses before changing it.
              </p>
            )}
            <Button type="submit" disabled={conflict}>
              Save household
            </Button>
          </form>
        </section>
      );
    }
    
    function MemberEditor({

    }: {

    }) {
      const { store, conflict } = useReadyHousehold();
      const [draft, setDraft] = useState<MemberDraft>(
        member

      );

      function submit(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {

        if (saved.ok) onClose();
        else setSaveError(saved.error);

      return (

          title={title}
          description="This is a local demo profile, not a user account."

              value={draft.name}
              onChange={(event) => {

              required

            <AvatarField

        </Dialog>

    }

    import { isCalendarDate } from "./dates";
    import { activeMembers } from "./household";
    import type { AppState, Chore, ChoreStatus, Member } from "./types";
    import { choreDraftSchema, validateState } from "./validation";
    
    export const choreStatuses = ["pending", "completed", "skipped"] as const;
    export const choreStatusLabels: Record<ChoreStatus, string> = {
      pending: "Pending", completed: "Completed", skipped: "Skipped",
    };
    export type ChoreDraft = Pick<Chore, "title" | "notes" | "assigneeId" | "dueDate">;
    export type ChoreAction =
      | { type: "add-chore"; chore: ChoreDraft }
      | { type: "edit-chore"; id: string; chore: ChoreDraft }
      | { type: "delete-chore"; id: string }
      | { type: "set-chore-status"; id: string; status: ChoreStatus }
      | { type: "rotate-chore"; id: string; dueDate: string };
    
    export function isOverdue(chore: Pick<Chore, "status" | "dueDate">, today: string) {
      return chore.status === "pending" && chore.dueDate < today;
    }
    
    export function nextChoreAssignee(state: AppState, assigneeId: string): Member {
      const current = state.members.find((member) => member.id === assigneeId);
      if (!current) throw new Error("This chore's roommate could not be found.");
      const roster = activeMembers(state);
      const next = roster.find((member) => member.order > current.order) ?? roster[0];
      if (!next) throw new Error("Restore an active roommate before rotating.");
      return next;
    }
    
    export function suggestedRotationDate(dueDate: string, today: string): string {
      if (!isCalendarDate(dueDate) || !isCalendarDate(today))
        throw new Error("Choose a valid calendar date.");
      const base = dueDate < today ? today : dueDate;
      const [year, month, day] = base.split("-").map(Number);
      // Calendar arithmetic avoids UTC offsets, DST changes and the Date 0–99 year shorthand.
      const date = new Date(0);
      date.setUTCFullYear(year, month - 1, day + 7);
      const result = date.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
      return isCalendarDate(result) ? result : today;
    }
    
    export function applyChoreAction(
      state: AppState, action: ChoreAction, makeId: () => string, now: Date,
    ): AppState {
      const activeAssignee = (id: string) => {
        if (!state.members.some((member) => member.id === id && member.active))
          throw new Error("Choose an active roommate before saving this assignment.");
      };
      let chores: Chore[];
      if (action.type === "add-chore") {
        const draft = choreDraftSchema.parse({ ...action.chore, title: action.chore.title.trim() });
        activeAssignee(draft.assigneeId);
        chores = [...state.chores, {
          ...draft, id: makeId(), status: "pending", completionHistory: [], createdAt: now.toISOString(),
        }];
      } else {
        const chore = state.chores.find((item) => item.id === action.id);
        if (!chore) throw new Error("This chore could not be found. Reload the household and try again.");
        let updated = chore;
        if (action.type === "edit-chore") {
          const draft = choreDraftSchema.parse({ ...action.chore, title: action.chore.title.trim() });
          // Historical assignments may stay archived; new assignments must be active.
          if (draft.assigneeId !== chore.assigneeId || chore.status === "pending")
            activeAssignee(draft.assigneeId);
          updated = { ...chore, ...draft };
        } else if (action.type === "set-chore-status") {
          if (!choreStatuses.includes(action.status)) throw new Error("Choose a valid chore status.");
          if (action.status === chore.status) return state;
          if (action.status === "pending" && !state.members.find((member) => member.id === chore.assigneeId)?.active)
            throw new Error("Reassign this chore to an active roommate using Edit before reopening it, or rotate to the next active roommate.");
          const completionHistory = action.status === "completed"
            ? [...chore.completionHistory, { id: makeId(), completedById: state.selectedMemberId, completedAt: now.toISOString() }]
            : chore.completionHistory;
          updated = { ...chore, status: action.status, completionHistory };
        } else if (action.type === "rotate-chore") {
          if (!isCalendarDate(action.dueDate)) throw new Error("Choose a valid calendar date.");
          updated = { ...chore, status: "pending", assigneeId: nextChoreAssignee(state, chore.assigneeId).id, dueDate: action.dueDate };
        }
        chores = action.type === "delete-chore"
          ? state.chores.filter((item) => item.id !== chore.id)
          : state.chores.map((item) => item.id === chore.id ? updated : item);
      }
      return validateState({ ...state, chores });
    }

    "use client";
    
    import { useEffect, useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
    import { usePathname, useRouter } from "next/navigation";
    import { House } from "lucide-react";
    import { useHousehold } from "./household-provider";
    import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
    import { ConfirmDialog } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
    import { InlineNotice } from "@/components/ui/inline-notice";
    import { Wordmark } from "@/components/wordmark";
    
    export function HouseholdGate({
      children,
      welcome = false,
    }: {
      children: ReactNode;
      welcome?: boolean;
    }) {
      const { status, conflict, error, store } = useHousehold();
      const router = useRouter();
      const pathname = usePathname();
      const [confirmReset, setConfirmReset] = useState(false);
      const [resetError, setResetError] = useState<string>();
      const needsSetup = status === "empty" && !welcome;
      const hasHousehold = status === "ready" && welcome;
      useEffect(() => {
        if (needsSetup) router.replace("/welcome");
        if (hasHousehold) router.replace("/");
      }, [needsSetup, hasHousehold, router, pathname]);
    
      if (status === "loading" || needsSetup || hasHousehold)
        return (
          <main
            className="flex min-h-dvh items-center justify-center gap-3 px-5 text-sm text-muted"
            aria-busy="true"
          >
            <House aria-hidden="true" className="size-5" />
            <p>Opening your household…</p>
          </main>
        );
      if (status === "invalid" || status === "unavailable") {
        return (
          <main className="mx-auto flex min-h-dvh max-w-lg flex-col justify-center px-5 py-10">
            <div className="mb-10">
              <Wordmark />
            </div>
            <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold">
              {status === "invalid"
                ? "Saved data couldn't be opened"
                : "Browser storage is unavailable"}
            </h1>
            <div className="mt-5">
              <InlineNotice tone="error">{error}</InlineNotice>
            </div>
            {conflict && (
              <p className="mt-4 text-sm text-warning">
                Saved data changed in another tab. Retry before resetting.
              </p>
            )}
            <div className="mt-6 flex flex-wrap gap-3">
              <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => store.initialize()}>
                Retry opening saved data
              </Button>
              {status === "invalid" && (
                <Button
                  variant="danger"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setResetError(undefined);
                    setConfirmReset(true);
                  }}
                >
                  Reset saved data
                </Button>
              )}
            </div>
            <ConfirmDialog
              open={confirmReset}
              onClose={() => setConfirmReset(false)}
              title="Reset saved data?"
              description="This permanently removes this browser's RoomieOS household, including chores, expenses and agreements. You will return to the sample or empty household choice."
              confirmLabel="Erase saved household"
              destructive
              error={resetError}
              onConfirm={() => {
                const result = store.clear();
                if (result.ok) setConfirmReset(false);
                else setResetError(result.error);
              }}
            />
          </main>
        );
      }
      return (
        <>
          {conflict && (
            <div
              className="border-b border-warning bg-warning-bg px-4 py-3 text-sm text-warning"
              role="alert"
            >
              <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-[1120px] flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
                <p>
                  This household changed in another tab. Reload before saving;
                  unsaved form entries will be lost when you reload.
                </p>
                <Button
                  variant="secondary"
                  onClick={() => window.location.reload()}
                >
                  Reload saved household
                </Button>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
          {children}
        </>
      );
    }

    function Navigation({ onNavigate }: { onNavigate?: () => void }) {
      const pathname = usePathname();
      return (
        <nav aria-label="Main navigation" className="flex flex-col gap-1">
          {navigation.map(({ href, label, Icon }) => {
            const active = pathname === href || pathname === `${href}/`;
            return (
              <Link
                key={href}
                href={href}
                onClick={onNavigate}
                aria-current={active ? "page" : undefined}
                className={`flex min-h-11 items-center gap-3 rounded-[7px] px-3 text-sm font-medium transition-colors ${href === "/settings" ? "mt-6" : ""} ${active ? "bg-selected text-accent" : "text-muted hover:bg-hover hover:text-ink"}`}

                <Icon aria-hidden="true" className="size-[18px] shrink-0" />
                {label}

        </nav>
      );

    "use client";
    
    import { useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
    import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
    import { Dialog, ConfirmDialog } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
    import { FormField } from "@/components/ui/form-field";
    import { InlineNotice } from "@/components/ui/inline-notice";
    import { StatusPill } from "@/components/ui/status-pill";
    import { displayDate, isCalendarDate, localDate } from "@/domain/dates";
    import { isOverdue, nextChoreAssignee, suggestedRotationDate } from "@/domain/chores";
    import type { Chore, ChoreStatus } from "@/domain/types";
    import { useReadyHousehold } from "@/state/household-provider";
    import { focusInvalid } from "../household/fields";
    import { ChoreForm } from "./chore-form";
    
    function RotationForm({ chore, onClose }: { chore: Chore; onClose: () => void }) {
      const { state, store, conflict } = useReadyHousehold();
      const next = nextChoreAssignee(state, chore.assigneeId);
      const [date, setDate] = useState(() => suggestedRotationDate(chore.dueDate, localDate(new Date())));
      const [dateError, setDateError] = useState<string>();
      const [saveError, setSaveError] = useState<string>();
      function submit(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
        event.preventDefault();
        if (!isCalendarDate(date)) {
          setDateError("Choose a valid calendar date.");
          focusInvalid(event.currentTarget);
          return;
        }
        const result = store.dispatch({ type: "rotate-chore", id: chore.id, dueDate: date }, `Chore rotated to ${next.name}.`);
        if (result.ok) onClose();
        else setSaveError(result.error);
      }
      return (
        <Dialog open title="Rotate chore" onClose={onClose} description={`Assign “${chore.title}” to ${next.name} and reopen it as Pending. Completion history will be kept.`}>
          <form noValidate onSubmit={submit} className="space-y-5">
            <p className="text-sm">Next roommate: <strong>{next.name}</strong></p>
            <FormField id="rotation-date" type="date" min="0001-01-01" max="9999-12-31" label="New due date" required value={date} onChange={(event) => { setDate(event.target.value); setDateError(undefined); }} error={dateError} />
            {saveError && <InlineNotice tone="error">{saveError}</InlineNotice>}
            <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-end gap-3">
              <Button variant="secondary" onClick={onClose}>Cancel</Button>
              <Button type="submit" disabled={conflict}>Confirm rotation</Button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </Dialog>
      );
    }
    
    export function ChoreDetails({ chore, today, onClose }: { chore: Chore; today: string; onClose: () => void }) {
      const { state, store, conflict } = useReadyHousehold();
      const [overlay, setOverlay] = useState<"edit" | "rotate" | "delete" | null>(null);
      const [error, setError] = useState<string>();
      const assignee = state.members.find((member) => member.id === chore.assigneeId)!;
      const selected = state.members.find((member) => member.id === state.selectedMemberId)!;
      const changeStatus = (status: ChoreStatus) => {
        const result = store.dispatch({ type: "set-chore-status", id: chore.id, status }, status === "completed" ? "Chore completed." : status === "skipped" ? "Chore skipped." : "Chore reopened.");
        setError(result.ok ? undefined : result.error);
      };
      function openOverlay(value: typeof overlay) {
        setError(undefined);
        store.dismissFeedback();
        setOverlay(value);
      }
      return (
        <>
          <Dialog open title={chore.title} onClose={onClose}>
            <div className="space-y-6">
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2"><StatusPill status={chore.status} />{isOverdue(chore, today) && <span className="text-sm font-medium text-danger">Overdue</span>}</div>
              <dl className="grid gap-4 text-sm sm:grid-cols-2">
                <div><dt className="text-muted">Assigned to</dt><dd className="mt-1 break-words font-medium">{assignee.name}{!assignee.active && " (archived)"}</dd></div>
                <div><dt className="text-muted">Due date</dt><dd className="mt-1 font-medium">{displayDate(chore.dueDate)}</dd></div>
              </dl>
              {chore.notes && <div><h3 className="text-sm font-semibold">Notes</h3><p className="mt-2 whitespace-pre-wrap break-words text-sm text-muted">{chore.notes}</p></div>}
              {!assignee.active && <InlineNotice>To reopen, use Edit to assign an active roommate, or rotate to the next active roommate.</InlineNotice>}
              <div>
                <p className="mb-3 text-sm text-muted">Completions are recorded as {selected.name}, your current demo perspective.</p>
                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                  {chore.status !== "completed" && <Button disabled={conflict} onClick={() => changeStatus("completed")}>Mark completed</Button>}
                  {chore.status !== "pending" && <Button variant={chore.status === "completed" ? "primary" : "secondary"} disabled={conflict || !assignee.active} onClick={() => changeStatus("pending")}>Reopen as pending</Button>}
                  {chore.status !== "skipped" && <Button variant="secondary" disabled={conflict} onClick={() => changeStatus("skipped")}>Skip chore</Button>}
                  <Button variant="secondary" disabled={conflict} onClick={() => openOverlay("rotate")}>Rotate to next</Button>
                </div>
              </div>
              {error && <InlineNotice tone="error">{error}</InlineNotice>}
              <section className="border-t border-line pt-5" aria-label="Completion history">
                <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold">Completion history</h3>
                {chore.completionHistory.length ? <ol className="mt-3 space-y-3">
                  {[...chore.completionHistory].reverse().map((event) => {
                    const member = state.members.find((item) => item.id === event.completedById)!;
                    return <li key={event.id} className="break-words text-sm text-muted">Completed by <span className="font-medium text-ink">{member.name}{!member.active && " (archived)"}</span> · <time dateTime={event.completedAt}>{new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en", { dateStyle: "medium", timeStyle: "short" }).format(new Date(event.completedAt))}</time></li>;
                  })}
                </ol> : <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-muted">No completions yet.</p>}
              </section>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-between gap-3 border-t border-line pt-5">
                <Button variant="secondary" disabled={conflict} onClick={() => openOverlay("edit")}>Edit chore</Button>
                <Button variant="danger" disabled={conflict} onClick={() => openOverlay("delete")}>Delete chore</Button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </Dialog>
          {overlay === "edit" && <ChoreForm chore={chore} onClose={() => setOverlay(null)} />}
          {overlay === "rotate" && <RotationForm chore={chore} onClose={() => setOverlay(null)} />}
          <ConfirmDialog open={overlay === "delete"} title="Delete chore?" description={`Permanently delete “${chore.title}” and its completion history? This cannot be undone.`} confirmLabel="Delete chore" destructive onClose={() => setOverlay(null)} error={error} onConfirm={() => {
            const result = store.dispatch({ type: "delete-chore", id: chore.id }, "Chore deleted.");
            if (result.ok) onClose();
            else setError(result.error);
          }} />
        </>
      );
    }
