    "use client";
    
    import { useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
    import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
    import { Dialog } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
    import { FormField, controlStyles } from "@/components/ui/form-field";
    import { InlineNotice } from "@/components/ui/inline-notice";
    import { SelectField } from "@/components/ui/select-field";
    import { activeMembers } from "@/domain/household";
    import { localDate } from "@/domain/dates";
    import type { ChoreDraft } from "@/domain/chores";
    import type { Chore } from "@/domain/types";
    import { choreDraftSchema } from "@/domain/validation";
    import { useReadyHousehold } from "@/state/household-provider";
    import { focusInvalid } from "../household/fields";
    
    export function ChoreForm({ chore, onClose }: { chore: Chore | null; onClose: () => void }) {
      const { state, store, conflict } = useReadyHousehold();
      const [draft, setDraft] = useState<ChoreDraft>(chore ? {
        title: chore.title, notes: chore.notes, assigneeId: chore.assigneeId, dueDate: chore.dueDate,
      } : { title: "", notes: "", assigneeId: state.selectedMemberId, dueDate: localDate(new Date()) });
      const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Partial<Record<keyof ChoreDraft, string>>>({});
      const [saveError, setSaveError] = useState<string>();
      const archivedAssignee = chore && state.members.find((member) => member.id === chore.assigneeId && !member.active);
      function change(field: keyof ChoreDraft, value: string) {
        setDraft({ ...draft, [field]: value });
        setErrors({ ...errors, [field]: undefined });
        setSaveError(undefined);
      }
      function submit(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
        event.preventDefault();
        const parsed = choreDraftSchema.safeParse({ ...draft, title: draft.title.trim() });
        const nextErrors: typeof errors = {};
        if (!parsed.success) {
          for (const issue of parsed.error.issues) {
            const field = issue.path[0] as keyof ChoreDraft;
            nextErrors[field] = field === "title" ? "Enter a title (1–100 characters)." : field === "notes" ? "Keep notes to 1000 characters or fewer." : issue.message;
          }
        }
        if (!state.members.some((member) => member.id === draft.assigneeId && (member.active || member.id === archivedAssignee?.id)))
          nextErrors.assigneeId = "Choose an active roommate.";
        setErrors(nextErrors);
        if (Object.keys(nextErrors).length || !parsed.success) {
          focusInvalid(event.currentTarget);
          return;
        }
        const result = store.dispatch(chore ? { type: "edit-chore", id: chore.id, chore: parsed.data } : { type: "add-chore", chore: parsed.data }, chore ? "Chore updated." : "Chore saved.");
        if (result.ok) onClose();
        else setSaveError(result.error);
      }
      return (
        <Dialog open title={chore ? "Edit chore" : "New chore"} onClose={onClose}>
          <form noValidate onSubmit={submit} className="space-y-5">
            <FormField id="chore-title" label="Title" required maxLength={100} value={draft.title} onChange={(event) => change("title", event.target.value)} error={errors.title} />
            <SelectField id="chore-assignee" label="Assigned to (required)" required value={draft.assigneeId} onChange={(event) => change("assigneeId", event.target.value)} error={errors.assigneeId} help={archivedAssignee ? "Keep this historical assignment, or choose an active roommate before reopening." : undefined}>
              {archivedAssignee && <option value={archivedAssignee.id}>{archivedAssignee.name} (archived — current assignment)</option>}
              {activeMembers(state).map((member) => <option key={member.id} value={member.id}>{member.name}</option>)}
            </SelectField>
            <FormField id="chore-due-date" label="Due date" required type="date" min="0001-01-01" max="9999-12-31" value={draft.dueDate} onChange={(event) => change("dueDate", event.target.value)} error={errors.dueDate} />
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <label htmlFor="chore-notes" className="block text-sm font-medium">Notes (optional)</label>
              <textarea id="chore-notes" className={`${controlStyles} min-h-28 resize-y`} rows={4} maxLength={1000} value={draft.notes} onChange={(event) => change("notes", event.target.value)} aria-invalid={Boolean(errors.notes)} aria-describedby={errors.notes ? "chore-notes-error" : undefined} />
              {errors.notes && <p id="chore-notes-error" className="text-sm text-danger">{errors.notes}</p>}
            </div>
            {saveError && <InlineNotice tone="error">{saveError}</InlineNotice>}
            <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-end gap-3">
              <Button variant="secondary" onClick={onClose}>Cancel</Button>
              <Button type="submit" disabled={conflict}>Save chore</Button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </Dialog>
      );
    }

          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2"><StatusPill status={chore.status} />{isOverdue(chore, today) && <span className="text-xs font-medium text-danger">Overdue</span>}</div>
          <SelectField id={`${suffix}-${chore.id}-status`} label={`Change status for ${chore.title}`} value={chore.status} disabled={conflict} onChange={(event) => store.dispatch({ type: "set-chore-status", id: chore.id, status: event.target.value as ChoreStatus }, "Chore status updated.")}>
            {choreStatuses.map((value) => <option key={value} value={value}>{choreStatusLabels[value]}</option>)}
          </SelectField>
        </div>;
      }
      return <>
        <PageHeader title="Chores" description="A little clarity for the everyday things." icon={<CheckSquare className="size-6" />} action={<Button onClick={newChore} disabled={conflict}><Plus aria-hidden="true" className="size-4" />New chore</Button>} />
        <div className="mb-6 flex flex-wrap items-end gap-4">
          <div role="group" aria-label="Chore view" className="flex self-end rounded-[7px] border border-line bg-subtle p-1">
            <Button variant={view === "list" ? "secondary" : "ghost"} aria-pressed={view === "list"} onClick={() => setView("list")}><List aria-hidden="true" className="size-4" />List</Button>
            <Button variant={view === "board" ? "secondary" : "ghost"} aria-pressed={view === "board"} onClick={() => setView("board")}><Columns3 aria-hidden="true" className="size-4" />Board</Button>
          </div>
          <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 basis-40"><SelectField id="chore-status-filter" label="Filter by status" value={status} onChange={(event) => setStatus(event.target.value)}><option value="all">All statuses</option>{choreStatuses.map((value) => <option key={value} value={value}>{choreStatusLabels[value]}</option>)}</SelectField></div>
          <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 basis-44"><SelectField id="chore-member-filter" label="Filter by roommate" value={assigneeId} onChange={(event) => setAssigneeId(event.target.value)}><option value="all">All roommates</option>{members.filter((member) => member.active || state.chores.some((chore) => chore.assigneeId === member.id)).map((member) => <option key={member.id} value={member.id}>{member.name}{!member.active && " (archived)"}</option>)}</SelectField></div>
        </div>
        {state.chores.length === 0 ? <EmptyState icon={<CheckSquare className="size-6" />} title="Nothing on the chore board" action={<Button disabled={conflict} onClick={newChore}>Add a chore</Button>}><p>Add your first chore to get started.</p></EmptyState> : <>
          <p role="status" className="mb-4 text-sm text-muted">{chores.length} {chores.length === 1 ? "chore" : "chores"}{status !== "all" || assigneeId !== "all" ? " match your filters" : " in your household"}.</p>
          {chores.length === 0 ? <EmptyState icon={<CheckSquare className="size-6" />} title="No matching chores" action={<Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => { setStatus("all"); setAssigneeId("all"); }}>Clear filters</Button>}><p>Try a different status or roommate.</p></EmptyState> : view === "list" ? <>
            <div className="hidden rounded-[10px] border border-line md:block">
              <table className="w-full table-fixed text-left text-sm"><caption className="sr-only">Household chores</caption><thead className="border-b border-line bg-subtle text-muted"><tr>{["Chore", "Assigned to", "Due date", "Status"].map((label) => <th key={label} scope="col" className="p-4 font-medium">{label}</th>)}</tr></thead><tbody className="divide-y divide-line">{chores.map((chore) => <tr key={chore.id}><td className="p-4 align-top"><button onClick={() => openChore(chore)} className="min-h-11 max-w-full rounded text-left font-semibold text-accent underline-offset-4 hover:underline [overflow-wrap:anywhere]">{chore.title}</button></td><td className="p-4 align-top">{memberLabel(chore)}</td><td className="p-4 align-top"><time dateTime={chore.dueDate}>{displayDate(chore.dueDate)}</time></td><td className="p-4 align-top">{statusControl(chore, "table")}</td></tr>)}</tbody></table>

    "use client";
    
    import { useSyncExternalStore } from "react";
    import { localDate } from "@/domain/dates";
    
    function subscribeDate(listener: () => void) {
      window.addEventListener("focus", listener);
      document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", listener);
      document.addEventListener("pointerdown", listener);
      document.addEventListener("keydown", listener);
      return () => {
        window.removeEventListener("focus", listener);
        document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", listener);
        document.removeEventListener("pointerdown", listener);
        document.removeEventListener("keydown", listener);
      };
    }
    
    export function useToday() {
      return useSyncExternalStore(subscribeDate, () => localDate(new Date()), () => "");
    }

    import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
    import { applyChoreAction, isOverdue, nextChoreAssignee, suggestedRotationDate, type ChoreAction } from "./chores";
    import { applyHouseholdAction } from "./household";
    import { createSampleHousehold } from "./sample";
    import { localDate } from "./dates";
    import type { AppState } from "./types";
    
    const now = new Date("2026-11-24T02:30:00Z");
    const draft = { title: "  Water plants  ", notes: "A little water.", assigneeId: "jordan", dueDate: "2026-11-25" };
    function run(state: AppState, action: ChoreAction, id = "generated", date = now) {
      return applyChoreAction(state, action, () => id, date);
    }
    function sample() { return createSampleHousehold(now); }
    function archivedSample() {
      const state = sample();
      state.expenses = [];
      state.chores = state.chores.filter((chore) => chore.id === "vacuum");
      state.members.find((member) => member.id === "avery")!.active = false;
      state.selectedMemberId = "jordan";
      return state;
    }
    
    describe("chore facts and completion events", () => {
      it("creates a pending chore with trimmed title, then edits only draft fields without mutating input", () => {
        const initial = sample();
        const saved = run(initial, { type: "add-chore", chore: draft });
        const added = saved.chores.at(-1)!;
        expect(added).toEqual({ ...draft, title: "Water plants", id: "generated", status: "pending", completionHistory: [], createdAt: now.toISOString() });
        expect(initial.chores).toHaveLength(5);
        const completed = run(saved, { type: "set-chore-status", id: added.id, status: "completed" }, "event");
        const edited = run(completed, { type: "edit-chore", id: added.id, chore: { ...draft, title: "Plants", assigneeId: "sam" } });
        expect(edited.chores.at(-1)).toEqual({ ...completed.chores.at(-1), title: "Plants", assigneeId: "sam" });
        expect(saved.chores.at(-1)?.completionHistory).toEqual([]);
      });
      it("uses the selected profile and injected timestamp, avoids duplicate completion, and appends on recompletion", () => {
        const initial = sample();
        initial.selectedMemberId = "sam";
        const completed = run(initial, { type: "set-chore-status", id: "kitchen", status: "completed" }, "first");
        const first = completed.chores[0].completionHistory[0];
        expect(first).toEqual({ id: "first", completedById: "sam", completedAt: now.toISOString() });
        expect(run(completed, { type: "set-chore-status", id: "kitchen", status: "completed" })).toBe(completed);
        const reopened = run(completed, { type: "set-chore-status", id: "kitchen", status: "pending" });
        const skipped = run(reopened, { type: "set-chore-status", id: "kitchen", status: "skipped" });
        const again = run(skipped, { type: "set-chore-status", id: "kitchen", status: "completed" }, "second", new Date("2026-11-25T12:00:00Z"));
        expect(again.chores[0].completionHistory).toEqual([first, { id: "second", completedById: "sam", completedAt: "2026-11-25T12:00:00.000Z" }]);
        expect(completed.chores[0].completionHistory).toHaveLength(1);
      });
      it("deletes only the selected chore and its history", () => {
        const state = sample();
        const next = run(state, { type: "delete-chore", id: "vacuum" });
        expect(next.chores).toEqual(state.chores.filter((chore) => chore.id !== "vacuum"));
        expect(state.chores.find((chore) => chore.id === "vacuum")?.completionHistory).toHaveLength(1);
      });
      it.each([
        { ...draft, title: " " }, { ...draft, title: "x".repeat(101) },
        { ...draft, notes: "x".repeat(1001) }, { ...draft, assigneeId: "missing" },
        { ...draft, dueDate: "2026-02-29" }, { ...draft, dueDate: "2026-13-01" }, { ...draft, dueDate: "" },
      ])("rejects invalid chore input without changing state (%j)", (chore) => {
        const state = sample();
        const before = structuredClone(state);
        expect(() => run(state, { type: "add-chore", chore })).toThrow();
        expect(() => run(state, { type: "edit-chore", id: "kitchen", chore })).toThrow();
        expect(state).toEqual(before);
      });
      it("rejects missing records and invalid rotation dates", () => {
        expect(() => run(sample(), { type: "delete-chore", id: "missing" })).toThrow(/could not be found/);
        expect(() => run(sample(), { type: "rotate-chore", id: "kitchen", dueDate: "2026-02-30" })).toThrow(/valid calendar/);
      });
    });
    
    describe("active roster rotation and historical members", () => {
      it("follows stable order regardless of array order, wraps, and reopens while preserving notes/history", () => {
        const state = sample();
        state.members.reverse();
        expect(nextChoreAssignee(state, "avery").id).toBe("jordan");
        expect(nextChoreAssignee(state, "sam").id).toBe("avery");
        const chore = state.chores.find((item) => item.id === "vacuum")!;
        const next = run(state, { type: "rotate-chore", id: chore.id, dueDate: "2026-12-01" });
        expect(next.chores.find((item) => item.id === chore.id)).toEqual({ ...chore, assigneeId: "jordan", dueDate: "2026-12-01", status: "pending" });
        expect(chore.status).toBe("completed");
      });

        expect(nextChoreAssignee(restored, "sam").id).toBe("avery");
        expect(run(state, { type: "rotate-chore", id: "vacuum", dueDate: "2026-12-01" }).chores[0]).toMatchObject({ status: "pending", assigneeId: "jordan" });

              >

                  .map((member) => (

            </>
          )}
          {creating && (

              key={selected.id}
              chore={selected}
              today={today}
              onClose={() => setSelectedId(null)}
            />
          )}
        </>
      );

    export function ProfileSwitcher() {

          </label>
        </div>
      );
    }

    # RoomieOS
    
    Your shared home, organized. An ENTI 407 client-side household prototype built with Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and Lucide.
    
    ## Local development
    
    Use Node.js 22.12 or newer and npm:
    
    ```sh
    npm ci
    npm run dev
    ```
    
    Open <http://localhost:3000>. Choose a sample household or create an empty household with a name, currency and 2–20 active roommates. Settings supports household edits, roommate names/avatars, archive/restore, reset demo and start over. The profile switcher changes your local demo perspective.
    
    Household data is validated and saved only in this browser under `roomieos:v1`. Refresh preserves changes; sample data is never silently regenerated. Invalid/unsupported data requires explicit confirmed recovery. Storage errors keep the previous household and form entries. If another tab changes the saved household, reload before editing further.
    
    Chores, expenses and agreements currently show saved records without editing controls. Their CRUD tools, Kanban, expense balances and settlement actions belong to the next milestones. Photo uploads remain deferred; initials and 40 named icon avatars work locally, grouped by nature, animals, food/drink, hobbies and home/favorites.
    
    ## Current checkpoint
    
    Milestone 2 and its feedback loop are complete as of 23 November 2026. Next is Milestone 3: chore CRUD, immutable completion history, manual rotation, filters and List/Kanban. The final dashboard will add personal balances and a fuller personal/household arrangement during expense/integration work. See [PLAN.md](PLAN.md) for the handoff and actual verification results.
    
    ## Checks
    
    ```sh
    npm run lint
    npm run typecheck
    npm test
    npm run build
    npm run test:browser
    ```
    
    Vitest checks setup, sample validity, roster/currency guards, saved-payload validation and storage transactions/failures. Browser tests cover setup and persistence, profile switching, roster management, recovery, failed-save retries, reset confirmations, cross-tab conflicts, responsive overflow and native-dialog keyboard behavior at 375, 768 and 1280 px. Install Playwright Chromium once with `npx playwright install chromium`, or use an existing compatible Chromium executable:
    
    ```sh
    CHROMIUM_PATH=/usr/bin/chromium-browser npm run test:browser
    ```
    
    The browser suite starts its own local dev server on port 3100 with an isolated `.next-e2e/` build directory, leaving a running preview on port 3000 alone. Override the test port with `ROOMIEOS_TEST_PORT` if necessary. Screenshots and failure traces are saved under the ignored `test-results/` directory.
    
    ## Hydration troubleshooting
    
    If the development overlay shows unexpected HTML attributes such as `bis_skin_checked` or `bis_register`, a browser extension may have modified the page before React hydrated it. Those attributes are not generated by RoomieOS. Try a fresh browser profile with extensions disabled, or a private window where no extensions are allowed. If the warning disappears, disable the responsible extension for localhost and reload. See the [Next.js hydration guide](https://nextjs.org/docs/messages/react-hydration-error).
    
    Keep hydration diagnostics enabled. The route browser test checks both uncaught errors and console errors, including React hydration warnings, in an isolated browser context. If the warning persists with extensions disabled, inspect the new diff for an application mismatch.
    
    ## Structure and deployment
    
    - `src/app`: static App Router pages and household route-group layout.
    - `src/components`: shared shell and UI primitives.
    - `src/features`: feature views; foundation views will be replaced incrementally.
    - `src/domain`: serializable types, runtime validation, household actions, date helpers and sample generation.
    - `src/state`: household provider, hydration gate and save-before-publish storage store.
    - `src/styles`: design tokens mapped into Tailwind.
    
    `npm run build` exports static files to `out/`, suitable for Vercel. There are no backend API routes, server mutations, remote fonts or service integrations. No deployment is performed by the foundation scripts.
    
    Read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md), [PLAN.md](PLAN.md), [PRD](docs/PRD.md) and [DESIGN](docs/DESIGN.md) before implementation. PLAN tracks verified progress; PRD and DESIGN remain authoritative for behavior and UI/UX.

    import { expect, test, type Page } from "@playwright/test";
    import { createSampleHousehold } from "../../src/domain/sample";
    import { localDate, relativeDate } from "../../src/domain/dates";
    import { suggestedRotationDate } from "../../src/domain/chores";
    import type { AppState } from "../../src/domain/types";
    
    async function seed(page: Page, state = createSampleHousehold(new Date())) {
      await page.addInitScript((value) => {
        if (localStorage.getItem("roomieos:v1") === null)
          localStorage.setItem("roomieos:v1", JSON.stringify(value));
      }, state);
      await page.goto("/chores/");
      await expect(page.getByRole("heading", { level: 1 })).toHaveText("Chores");
    }
    async function saved(page: Page): Promise<AppState> {
      return page.evaluate(() => JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("roomieos:v1")!));
    }
    function titleButton(page: Page, title: string) {
      return page.getByRole("button", { name: title, exact: true }).filter({ visible: true });
    }
    async function noOverflow(page: Page) {
      expect(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth > innerWidth)).toBe(false);
    }

      expect((await saved(page)).chores).toHaveLength(1);
      await updated.getByRole("button", { name: "Delete chore", exact: true }).click();

    test("filters, overdue and board status controls agree with list and fit the viewport", async ({ page }, testInfo) => {
      await seed(page);
      await expect(page.getByText("Overdue", { exact: true }).filter({ visible: true })).toHaveCount(1);
      await page.getByLabel("Filter by roommate").selectOption("jordan");
      await expect(titleButton(page, "Take out recycling")).toBeVisible();
      await expect(page.getByText("Overdue", { exact: true }).filter({ visible: true })).toHaveCount(0);
      await page.getByLabel("Filter by status").selectOption("completed");
      await expect(page.getByText("No matching chores")).toBeVisible();
      await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Clear filters", exact: true }).click();
      await page.screenshot({ path: testInfo.outputPath("chore-list.png"), fullPage: true });
      await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Board", exact: true }).click();
      const board = page.getByRole("region", { name: "Chore board", exact: true });
      await expect(board.getByRole("heading", { level: 2 })).toHaveCount(3);
      await noOverflow(page);
      await page.screenshot({ path: testInfo.outputPath("chore-board.png"), fullPage: true });
      if (page.viewportSize()!.width < 1024) {
        expect(await board.evaluate((element) => element.scrollWidth > element.clientWidth)).toBe(true);
        await board.focus();
        await page.keyboard.press("ArrowRight");
        await expect.poll(() => board.evaluate((element) => element.scrollLeft)).toBeGreaterThan(0);
      }
      await page.getByLabel("Change status for Clean the kitchen").selectOption("skipped");
      await expect(page.getByRole("region", { name: "Skipped chores", exact: true }).getByRole("button", { name: "Clean the kitchen" })).toBeVisible();
      await expect(page.getByText("Overdue", { exact: true })).toHaveCount(0);
      await page.getByRole("button", { name: "List", exact: true }).click();
      await expect(page.getByLabel("Change status for Clean the kitchen").filter({ visible: true })).toHaveValue("skipped");
      await page.reload();
      await expect(page.getByLabel("Change status for Clean the kitchen").filter({ visible: true })).toHaveValue("skipped");
      await noOverflow(page);
    });
    
    test("historical archived assignments remain editable and rotate through a large active roster", async ({ page }) => {
      const state = createSampleHousehold(new Date());
      state.expenses = [];
      state.chores = state.chores.filter((chore) => chore.id === "vacuum");
      state.members[0].active = false;
      state.selectedMemberId = "jordan";
      state.members.push(...Array.from({ length: 18 }, (_, index) => ({ id: `extra-${index}`, name: `Roommate ${index + 4}`, avatar: { kind: "initials" as const, value: "" }, active: true, order: index + 3 })));
      await seed(page, state);

      const details = page.getByRole("dialog", { name: "Vacuum the living room", exact: true });
      await expect(details.getByRole("button", { name: "Reopen as pending" })).toBeDisabled();
      await expect(details.getByRole("region", { name: "Completion history" })).toContainText("Avery (archived)");
      await details.getByRole("button", { name: "Edit chore", exact: true }).click();
      const editor = page.getByRole("dialog", { name: "Edit chore", exact: true });
      await expect(editor.getByLabel("Assigned to")).toHaveValue("avery");
      await editor.getByLabel("Notes").fill("Keep the historical assignment.");
      await editor.getByRole("button", { name: "Save chore", exact: true }).click();
      expect((await saved(page)).chores[0].assigneeId).toBe("avery");
      await details.getByRole("button", { name: "Rotate to next" }).click();

      await expect(rotate.getByText("Next roommate:")).toContainText("Jordan");
      await rotate.getByRole("button", { name: "Confirm rotation" }).click();
      await expect(rotate).not.toBeVisible();
      await expect(details.getByRole("region", { name: "Completion history" })).toContainText("Avery (archived)");
      await page.keyboard.press("Escape");
      await page.getByRole("button", { name: "New chore", exact: true }).click();
      const form = page.getByRole("dialog", { name: "New chore", exact: true });
      await expect(form.getByLabel("Assigned to").getByRole("option")).toHaveCount(20);
      await expect(form.getByLabel("Assigned to").getByRole("option", { name: /Avery/ })).toHaveCount(0);
      await form.getByRole("button", { name: "Cancel", exact: true }).click();
      await page.reload();
      expect((await saved(page)).chores[0]).toMatchObject({ assigneeId: "jordan", status: "pending", notes: "Keep the historical assignment.", completionHistory: state.chores[0].completionHistory });
    });
    
    test("failed storage saves retain chore drafts and history until retry succeeds", async ({ page }) => {
      await seed(page);
      await page.evaluate(() => {
        const original = Storage.prototype.setItem;
        Storage.prototype.setItem = function (key, value) {
          if (key === "roomieos:v1" && sessionStorage.getItem("fail-chore-save") === "yes") throw new DOMException("Storage full", "QuotaExceededError");
          return original.call(this, key, value);
        };
        sessionStorage.setItem("fail-chore-save", "yes");
      });
      const before = await saved(page);
      await page.getByRole("button", { name: "New chore", exact: true }).click();
      const form = page.getByRole("dialog", { name: "New chore", exact: true });
      await form.getByLabel("Title", { exact: false }).fill("Water the plants");
      await form.getByRole("button", { name: "Save chore", exact: true }).click();
      await expect(form.getByText(/Couldn't save changes/)).toBeVisible();
      await expect(form.getByLabel("Title", { exact: false })).toHaveValue("Water the plants");
      expect(await saved(page)).toEqual(before);
      await page.evaluate(() => sessionStorage.removeItem("fail-chore-save"));
      await form.getByRole("button", { name: "Save chore", exact: true }).click();
      await expect(form).not.toBeVisible();
      await titleButton(page, "Water the plants").click();
      const details = page.getByRole("dialog", { name: "Water the plants", exact: true });
      await page.evaluate(() => sessionStorage.setItem("fail-chore-save", "yes"));
      await details.getByRole("button", { name: "Mark completed", exact: true }).click();
      await expect(details.getByText(/Couldn't save changes/)).toBeVisible();
      await expect(details.getByText("No completions yet.")).toBeVisible();
      await page.evaluate(() => sessionStorage.removeItem("fail-chore-save"));
      await details.getByRole("button", { name: "Mark completed", exact: true }).click();
      await expect(details.getByRole("region", { name: "Completion history" }).getByRole("listitem")).toHaveCount(1);
      await page.evaluate(() => sessionStorage.setItem("fail-chore-save", "yes"));
      await details.getByRole("button", { name: "Delete chore", exact: true }).click();
      const confirmation = page.getByRole("dialog", { name: "Delete chore?", exact: true });
      await confirmation.getByRole("button", { name: "Delete chore", exact: true }).click();
      await expect(confirmation.getByText(/Couldn't save changes/)).toBeVisible();
      expect((await saved(page)).chores.at(-1)?.completionHistory).toHaveLength(1);
      await page.evaluate(() => sessionStorage.removeItem("fail-chore-save"));
      await confirmation.getByRole("button", { name: "Delete chore", exact: true }).click();
      await expect(confirmation).not.toBeVisible();
      expect((await saved(page)).chores).toHaveLength(before.chores.length);
    });
    
    test("overdue updates after a local date change on window focus", async ({ page }) => {
      const time = new Date(2026, 10, 23, 23, 59);
      await page.clock.install({ time });
      await seed(page, createSampleHousehold(time));
      await expect(page.getByText("Overdue", { exact: true }).filter({ visible: true })).toHaveCount(1);
      await page.clock.setSystemTime(new Date(2026, 10, 24, 0, 1));
      await page.evaluate(() => window.dispatchEvent(new Event("focus")));
      await expect(page.getByText("Overdue", { exact: true }).filter({ visible: true })).toHaveCount(2);
    });

    "use client";
    
    import Link from "next/link";
    import { useSyncExternalStore } from "react";
    import { BookOpen, CheckSquare, House, Wallet } from "lucide-react";
    import { buttonStyles } from "@/components/ui/button";

    import { useReadyHousehold } from "@/state/household-provider";
    import { activeMembers } from "@/domain/household";
    import { displayDate, localDate } from "@/domain/dates";
    
    function subscribeDate(listener: () => void) {
      window.addEventListener("focus", listener);
      document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", listener);
      return () => {
        window.removeEventListener("focus", listener);
        document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", listener);
      };
    }
    function useToday() {
      return useSyncExternalStore(
        subscribeDate,
        () => localDate(new Date()),
        () => "",
      );
    }
    const sections = {
      chores: {
        title: "Chores",
        description: "A little clarity for the everyday things.",
        Icon: CheckSquare,
      },
      expenses: {
        title: "Expenses",
        description: "Track shared spending without the spreadsheet.",
        Icon: Wallet,
      },
      agreements: {
        title: "House agreements",
        description: "Keep the expectations you share in one place.",
        Icon: BookOpen,
      },
    };
    
    export function FoundationScreen({
      section,
    }: {
      section: keyof typeof sections;
    }) {
      const { state } = useReadyHousehold();
      const today = useToday();
      const { title, description, Icon } = sections[section];
      const records =
        section === "chores"
          ? state.chores
          : section === "expenses"
            ? state.expenses
            : state.agreements;
      const nameFor = (id: string) =>
        state.members.find((member) => member.id === id)!.name;
      const money = (cents: number) =>
        new Intl.NumberFormat("en", {
          style: "currency",
          currency: state.household.currency,
          currencyDisplay: "code",
        }).format(cents / 100);
      return (
        <>
          <PageHeader
            title={title}
            description={description}
            icon={<Icon className="size-6" />}
          />
          <InlineNotice>
            Household data is saved locally.{" "}
            {section === "chores"
              ? "Chore editing, history details and the board are coming next."
              : section === "expenses"
                ? "Expense editing, balances and settlement controls are coming soon."
                : "Agreement editing is coming soon."}
          </InlineNotice>
          <div className="mt-6">
            {records.length === 0 ? (
              <EmptyState
                icon={<Icon className="size-6" />}
                title={
                  section === "chores"
                    ? "Nothing on the chore board"
                    : section === "expenses"
                      ? "No shared expenses yet"
                      : "Set the ground rules"
                }
              >
                <p>
                  Your empty household is ready. Editing tools will appear as the
                  next milestones are completed.
                </p>
              </EmptyState>
            ) : (
              <ul
                className="divide-y divide-line rounded-[10px] border border-line"
                aria-label={title}
              >
                {section === "chores" &&
                  state.chores.map((chore) => (
                    <li
                      key={chore.id}
                      className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3 p-5"
                    >
                      <div className="min-w-0">
                        <h2 className="break-words text-base font-semibold">
                          {chore.title}
                        </h2>
                        <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-muted">
                          {nameFor(chore.assigneeId)} · {displayDate(chore.dueDate)}
                        </p>
                        {chore.notes && (
                          <p className="mt-2 break-words text-sm text-muted">
                            {chore.notes}
                          </p>
                        )}
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                        <StatusPill status={chore.status} />
                        {chore.status === "pending" && chore.dueDate < today && (
                          <span className="text-sm font-medium text-danger">
                            Overdue
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </li>
                  ))}

    import { isCalendarDate } from "./dates";
    import { activeMembers } from "./household";
    import type { AppState, Chore, ChoreStatus, Member } from "./types";
    import { choreDraftSchema, validateState } from "./validation";
    
    export const choreStatuses = ["pending", "completed", "skipped"] as const;
    export const choreStatusLabels: Record<ChoreStatus, string> = {
      pending: "Pending",
      completed: "Completed",
      skipped: "Skipped",
    };
    export type ChoreDraft = Pick<
      Chore,
      "title" | "notes" | "assigneeId" | "dueDate"
    >;
    export type ChoreAction =
      | { type: "add-chore"; chore: ChoreDraft }
      | { type: "edit-chore"; id: string; chore: ChoreDraft }
      | { type: "delete-chore"; id: string }
      | { type: "set-chore-status"; id: string; status: ChoreStatus }
      | { type: "rotate-chore"; id: string; dueDate: string };
    
    export function isOverdue(
      chore: Pick<Chore, "status" | "dueDate">,
      today: string,
    ) {
      return chore.status === "pending" && chore.dueDate < today;
    }
    
    export function nextChoreAssignee(state: AppState, assigneeId: string): Member {
      const current = state.members.find((member) => member.id === assigneeId);
      if (!current) throw new Error("This chore's roommate could not be found.");
      const roster = activeMembers(state);
      const next =
        roster.find((member) => member.order > current.order) ?? roster[0];
      if (!next) throw new Error("Restore an active roommate before rotating.");
      return next;
    }
    
    export function suggestedRotationDate(dueDate: string, today: string): string {
      if (!isCalendarDate(dueDate) || !isCalendarDate(today))
        throw new Error("Choose a valid calendar date.");
      const base = dueDate < today ? today : dueDate;
      const [year, month, day] = base.split("-").map(Number);
      // Calendar arithmetic avoids UTC offsets, DST changes and the Date 0–99 year shorthand.
      const date = new Date(0);
      date.setUTCFullYear(year, month - 1, day + 7);
      const result = date.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
      return isCalendarDate(result) ? result : today;
    }
    
    export function applyChoreAction(
      state: AppState,
      action: ChoreAction,
      makeId: () => string,
      now: Date,
    ): AppState {
      const activeAssignee = (id: string) => {
        if (!state.members.some((member) => member.id === id && member.active))
          throw new Error(
            "Choose an active roommate before saving this assignment.",
          );
      };
      let chores: Chore[];
      if (action.type === "add-chore") {
        const draft = choreDraftSchema.parse({
          ...action.chore,
          title: action.chore.title.trim(),
        });
        activeAssignee(draft.assigneeId);
        chores = [
          ...state.chores,
          {
            ...draft,
            id: makeId(),
            status: "pending",
            completionHistory: [],
            createdAt: now.toISOString(),
          },
        ];
      } else {
        const chore = state.chores.find((item) => item.id === action.id);
        if (!chore)
          throw new Error(
            "This chore could not be found. Reload the household and try again.",
          );
        let updated = chore;
        if (action.type === "edit-chore") {
          const draft = choreDraftSchema.parse({
            ...action.chore,
            title: action.chore.title.trim(),
          });
          // Historical assignments may stay archived; new assignments must be active.
          if (draft.assigneeId !== chore.assigneeId || chore.status === "pending")
            activeAssignee(draft.assigneeId);
          updated = { ...chore, ...draft };
        } else if (action.type === "set-chore-status") {
          if (!choreStatuses.includes(action.status))
            throw new Error("Choose a valid chore status.");
          if (action.status === chore.status) return state;
          if (
            action.status === "pending" &&
            !state.members.find((member) => member.id === chore.assigneeId)?.active
          )
            throw new Error(
              "Reassign this chore to an active roommate using Edit before reopening it, or rotate to the next active roommate.",
            );
          const completionHistory =
            action.status === "completed"
              ? [
                  ...chore.completionHistory,
                  {
                    id: makeId(),
                    completedById: state.selectedMemberId,
                    completedAt: now.toISOString(),
                  },
                ]
              : chore.completionHistory;
          updated = { ...chore, status: action.status, completionHistory };
        } else if (action.type === "rotate-chore") {
          if (!isCalendarDate(action.dueDate))
            throw new Error("Choose a valid calendar date.");
          updated = {
            ...chore,
            status: "pending",
            assigneeId: nextChoreAssignee(state, chore.assigneeId).id,
            dueDate: action.dueDate,
          };
        }
        chores =
          action.type === "delete-chore"
            ? state.chores.filter((item) => item.id !== chore.id)
            : state.chores.map((item) => (item.id === chore.id ? updated : item));
      }
      return validateState({ ...state, chores });
    }
    "use client";
    
    import { useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
    import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
    import { Dialog } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
    import { FormField, controlStyles } from "@/components/ui/form-field";
    import { InlineNotice } from "@/components/ui/inline-notice";
    import { SelectField } from "@/components/ui/select-field";
    import { activeMembers } from "@/domain/household";
    import { localDate } from "@/domain/dates";
    import type { ChoreDraft } from "@/domain/chores";
    import type { Chore } from "@/domain/types";
    import { choreDraftSchema } from "@/domain/validation";
    import { useReadyHousehold } from "@/state/household-provider";
    import { focusInvalid } from "../household/fields";
    
    export function ChoreForm({
      chore,
      onClose,
    }: {
      chore: Chore | null;
      onClose: () => void;
    }) {
      const { state, store, conflict } = useReadyHousehold();
      const [draft, setDraft] = useState<ChoreDraft>(
        chore
          ? {
              title: chore.title,
              notes: chore.notes,
              assigneeId: chore.assigneeId,
              dueDate: chore.dueDate,
            }
          : {
              title: "",
              notes: "",
              assigneeId: state.selectedMemberId,
              dueDate: localDate(new Date()),
            },
      );
      const [errors, setErrors] = useState<
        Partial<Record<keyof ChoreDraft, string>>
      >({});
      const [saveError, setSaveError] = useState<string>();
      const archivedAssignee =
        chore &&
        state.members.find(
          (member) => member.id === chore.assigneeId && !member.active,
        );
      function change(field: keyof ChoreDraft, value: string) {
        setDraft({ ...draft, [field]: value });
        setErrors({ ...errors, [field]: undefined });
        setSaveError(undefined);
      }
      function submit(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
        event.preventDefault();
        const parsed = choreDraftSchema.safeParse({
          ...draft,
          title: draft.title.trim(),
        });
        const nextErrors: typeof errors = {};
        if (!parsed.success) {
          for (const issue of parsed.error.issues) {
            const field = issue.path[0] as keyof ChoreDraft;
            nextErrors[field] =
              field === "title"
                ? "Enter a title (1–100 characters)."
                : field === "notes"
                  ? "Keep notes to 1000 characters or fewer."
                  : issue.message;
          }
        }
        if (
          !state.members.some(
            (member) =>
              member.id === draft.assigneeId &&
              (member.active || member.id === archivedAssignee?.id),
          )
        )
          nextErrors.assigneeId = "Choose an active roommate.";
        setErrors(nextErrors);
        if (Object.keys(nextErrors).length || !parsed.success) {
          focusInvalid(event.currentTarget);
          return;
        }
        const result = store.dispatch(
          chore
            ? { type: "edit-chore", id: chore.id, chore: parsed.data }
            : { type: "add-chore", chore: parsed.data },
          chore ? "Chore updated." : "Chore saved.",
        );
        if (result.ok) onClose();
        else setSaveError(result.error);
      }
      return (
        <Dialog open title={chore ? "Edit chore" : "New chore"} onClose={onClose}>
          <form noValidate onSubmit={submit} className="space-y-5">
            <FormField
              id="chore-title"
              label="Title"
              required
              maxLength={100}
              value={draft.title}
              onChange={(event) => change("title", event.target.value)}
              error={errors.title}
            />
            <SelectField
              id="chore-assignee"
              label="Assigned to (required)"
              required
              value={draft.assigneeId}
              onChange={(event) => change("assigneeId", event.target.value)}
              error={errors.assigneeId}
              help={
                archivedAssignee
                  ? "Keep this historical assignment, or choose an active roommate before reopening."
                  : undefined
              }
            >
              {archivedAssignee && (
                <option value={archivedAssignee.id}>
                  {archivedAssignee.name} (archived — current assignment)
                </option>
              )}
              {activeMembers(state).map((member) => (
                <option key={member.id} value={member.id}>
                  {member.name}
                </option>
              ))}
            </SelectField>
            <FormField
              id="chore-due-date"
              label="Due date"
              required
              type="date"
              min="0001-01-01"
              max="9999-12-31"
              value={draft.dueDate}
              onChange={(event) => change("dueDate", event.target.value)}
              error={errors.dueDate}
            />
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <label htmlFor="chore-notes" className="block text-sm font-medium">
                Notes (optional)
              </label>
              <textarea
                id="chore-notes"
                className={`${controlStyles} min-h-28 resize-y`}
                rows={4}
                maxLength={1000}
                value={draft.notes}
                onChange={(event) => change("notes", event.target.value)}
                aria-invalid={Boolean(errors.notes)}
                aria-describedby={errors.notes ? "chore-notes-error" : undefined}
              />
              {errors.notes && (
                <p id="chore-notes-error" className="text-sm text-danger">
                  {errors.notes}
                </p>
              )}
            </div>
            {conflict && (
              <InlineNotice tone="error">
                This household changed in another tab. Close this dialog and reload
                the saved household before saving.
              </InlineNotice>
            )}
            {saveError && <InlineNotice tone="error">{saveError}</InlineNotice>}
            <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-end gap-3">
              <Button variant="secondary" onClick={onClose}>
                Cancel
              </Button>
              <Button type="submit" disabled={conflict}>
                Save chore
              </Button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </Dialog>
      );
    }
    "use client";
    
    import { useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
    import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
    import { Dialog, ConfirmDialog } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
    import { FormField } from "@/components/ui/form-field";
    import { InlineNotice } from "@/components/ui/inline-notice";
    import { StatusPill } from "@/components/ui/status-pill";
    import { displayDate, isCalendarDate, localDate } from "@/domain/dates";

      suggestedRotationDate,

    import { ChoreForm } from "./chore-form";
    
    function RotationForm({
      chore,
      onClose,
    }: {
      chore: Chore;
      onClose: () => void;
    }) {
      const { state, store, conflict } = useReadyHousehold();
      const next = nextChoreAssignee(state, chore.assigneeId);
      const [date, setDate] = useState(() =>
        suggestedRotationDate(chore.dueDate, localDate(new Date())),
      );
      const [dateError, setDateError] = useState<string>();
      const [saveError, setSaveError] = useState<string>();
      function submit(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
        event.preventDefault();
        if (!isCalendarDate(date)) {
          setDateError("Choose a valid calendar date.");
          focusInvalid(event.currentTarget);
          return;
        }
        const result = store.dispatch(
          { type: "rotate-chore", id: chore.id, dueDate: date },
          `Chore rotated to ${next.name}.`,
        );
        if (result.ok) onClose();
        else setSaveError(result.error);
      }
      return (
        <Dialog
          open
          title="Rotate chore"
          onClose={onClose}
          description={`Assign “${chore.title}” to ${next.name} and reopen it as Pending. Completion history will be kept.`}
        >
          <form noValidate onSubmit={submit} className="space-y-5">
            <p className="break-words text-sm">
              Next roommate: <strong>{next.name}</strong>
            </p>
            <FormField
              id="rotation-date"
              type="date"
              min="0001-01-01"
              max="9999-12-31"
              label="New due date"
              required
              value={date}
              onChange={(event) => {
                setDate(event.target.value);
                setDateError(undefined);
              }}
              error={dateError}
            />
            {conflict && (
              <InlineNotice tone="error">
                This household changed in another tab. Close this dialog and reload
                the saved household before saving.
              </InlineNotice>
            )}
            {saveError && <InlineNotice tone="error">{saveError}</InlineNotice>}
            <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-end gap-3">
              <Button variant="secondary" onClick={onClose}>
                Cancel
              </Button>
              <Button type="submit" disabled={conflict}>
                Confirm rotation
              </Button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </Dialog>
      );
    }
    
    export function ChoreDetails({
      chore,
      today,
      onClose,
      onDeleted,
    }: {
      chore: Chore;
      today: string;
      onClose: () => void;
      onDeleted: () => void;
    }) {
      const { state, store, conflict } = useReadyHousehold();
      const [overlay, setOverlay] = useState<"edit" | "rotate" | "delete" | null>(
        null,
      );
      const [error, setError] = useState<string>();
      const assignee = state.members.find(
        (member) => member.id === chore.assigneeId,
      )!;
      const selected = state.members.find(
        (member) => member.id === state.selectedMemberId,
      )!;
      const changeStatus = (status: ChoreStatus) => {
        const result = store.dispatch(
          { type: "set-chore-status", id: chore.id, status },
          status === "completed"
            ? "Chore completed."
            : status === "skipped"
              ? "Chore skipped."
              : "Chore reopened.",
        );
        setError(result.ok ? undefined : result.error);
      };
      function openOverlay(value: typeof overlay) {
        setError(undefined);
        store.dismissFeedback();
        setOverlay(value);
      }
      return (
        <>
          <Dialog open title={chore.title} onClose={onClose}>
            <div className="space-y-6">
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                <StatusPill status={chore.status} />
                {isOverdue(chore, today) && (
                  <span className="text-sm font-medium text-danger">Overdue</span>
                )}
              </div>
              <dl className="grid gap-4 text-sm sm:grid-cols-2">
                <div>
                  <dt className="text-muted">Assigned to</dt>
                  <dd className="mt-1 break-words font-medium">
                    {assignee.name}
                    {!assignee.active && " (archived)"}
                  </dd>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <dt className="text-muted">Due date</dt>
                  <dd className="mt-1 font-medium">{displayDate(chore.dueDate)}</dd>
                </div>
              </dl>
              {chore.notes && (
                <div>
                  <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold">Notes</h3>
                  <p className="mt-2 whitespace-pre-wrap break-words text-sm text-muted">
                    {chore.notes}
                  </p>
                </div>
              )}
              {!assignee.active && (
                <InlineNotice>
                  To reopen, use Edit to assign an active roommate, or rotate to the
                  next active roommate.
                </InlineNotice>
              )}
              <div>
                <p className="mb-3 text-sm text-muted">
                  Completions are recorded as {selected.name}, your current demo
                  perspective.
                </p>
                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                  {chore.status !== "completed" && (
                    <Button
                      disabled={conflict}
                      onClick={() => changeStatus("completed")}
                    >
                      Mark completed
                    </Button>
                  )}
                  {chore.status !== "pending" && (
                    <Button
                      variant={
                        chore.status === "completed" ? "primary" : "secondary"
                      }
                      disabled={conflict || !assignee.active}
                      onClick={() => changeStatus("pending")}
                    >
                      Reopen as pending
                    </Button>
                  )}
                  {chore.status !== "skipped" && (
                    <Button
                      variant="secondary"
                      disabled={conflict}
                      onClick={() => changeStatus("skipped")}
                    >
                      Skip chore
                    </Button>
                  )}
                  <Button
                    variant="secondary"
                    disabled={conflict}
                    onClick={() => openOverlay("rotate")}
                  >
                    Rotate to next
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </div>
              {conflict && (
                <InlineNotice tone="error">
                  This household changed in another tab. Close this dialog and
                  reload the saved household before saving.
                </InlineNotice>
              )}
              {error && <InlineNotice tone="error">{error}</InlineNotice>}
              <section
                className="border-t border-line pt-5"
                aria-label="Completion history"
              >
                <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold">Completion history</h3>
                {chore.completionHistory.length ? (
                  <ol className="mt-3 space-y-3">
                    {[...chore.completionHistory].reverse().map((event) => {
                      const member = state.members.find(
                        (item) => item.id === event.completedById,
                      )!;
                      return (
                        <li
                          key={event.id}
                          className="break-words text-sm text-muted"
                        >
                          Completed by{" "}
                          <span className="font-medium text-ink">
                            {member.name}
                            {!member.active && " (archived)"}
                          </span>{" "}
                          ·{" "}
                          <time dateTime={event.completedAt}>
                            {new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en", {
                              dateStyle: "medium",
                              timeStyle: "short",
                            }).format(new Date(event.completedAt))}
                          </time>
                        </li>
                      );
                    })}
                  </ol>
                ) : (
                  <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-muted">No completions yet.</p>
                )}
              </section>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-between gap-3 border-t border-line pt-5">
                <Button
                  variant="secondary"
                  disabled={conflict}
                  onClick={() => openOverlay("edit")}
                >
                  Edit chore
                </Button>
                <Button
                  variant="danger"
                  disabled={conflict}
                  onClick={() => openOverlay("delete")}
                >
                  Delete chore
                </Button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </Dialog>
          {overlay === "edit" && (
            <ChoreForm chore={chore} onClose={() => setOverlay(null)} />
          )}
          {overlay === "rotate" && (
            <RotationForm chore={chore} onClose={() => setOverlay(null)} />
          )}
          <ConfirmDialog
            open={overlay === "delete"}
            title="Delete chore?"
            description={`Permanently delete “${chore.title}” and its completion history? This cannot be undone.`}
            confirmLabel="Delete chore"
            destructive
            onClose={() => setOverlay(null)}
            error={error}
            onConfirm={() => {
              const result = store.dispatch(
                { type: "delete-chore", id: chore.id },
                "Chore deleted.",
              );
              if (result.ok) onDeleted();
              else setError(result.error);
            }}
          />
        </>
      );
    }

    # Household state boundary
    
    `HouseholdProvider` lives in the root layout above both Welcome and household routes. It owns one external store consumed through `useSyncExternalStore`, with a stable loading snapshot for server rendering and initial hydration. Feature components keep temporary form drafts locally.
    
    `household-store.ts` accepts a storage getter, ID factory and clock so transactions can be tested without React or a browser. Initialization reads and validates `roomieos:v1` without writing or seeding. Commands derive a new state with pure domain functions, validate it, compare the stored payload with the last observed payload, persist, then notify subscribers. Failed writes retain the last saved state. Invalid data stays untouched until confirmed clearing; storage failures are explicit.
    
    `HouseholdGate` handles loading, setup redirects, recovery and cross-tab reload notices. Storage events and window focus detect external changes; every write checks again before saving. Conflict reloads are user initiated, not automatic synchronization. No derived dashboard totals or balances are persisted.

    Build a polished Next.js client-side prototype for ENTI 407. `docs/PRD.md` is authoritative for behavior; `docs/DESIGN.md` is authoritative for UI/UX. This document records approved architecture, sequencing and actual progress. It does not override those requirements.
    
    ### 5.3 Chores
    
    Header: `Chores` / short description / right-aligned `+ New chore` button.
    
    Below: segmented `List | Board` control, status/roommate filters (compact). Persist view choice if easy, but not essential.
    
    **List view:** clean Notion-like table with columns: title, assigned to (avatar + name), due date, status; on narrow screens convert rows to cards. Notes visible in detail panel, not as wide text columns.
    
    **Kanban board:** exactly three columns with compact headers and counts: `Pending`, `Completed`, `Skipped`. Cards show title, assignee avatar, due date, optional one-line notes. Click opens details; status action reachable without drag/drop. Dragging between columns is **not necessary** and should not displace functional status controls.
    
    **Create/edit modal or drawer fields:** Title (required), Assignee (active member picker), Due date (native date control), Notes (multiline, optional). Clearly label `Save` and `Cancel`. Form errors are inline.
    
    **Details:** primary status action, `Rotate to next`, edit, delete. History panel shows `Completed by Avery • 22 Nov` in reverse chronological order. Rotation asks for the next due date and names the next assignee before confirmation.
    
    **Status visuals:**
    - Pending = neutral gray pill.
    - Completed = gentle green pill with check icon.
    - Skipped = amber neutral pill with skip icon.
    - Overdue = small red `Overdue` label alongside **Pending** status; no red full-screen treatment.
    **FR-10 — Views, filtering and overdue**
    - List view shows title, assignee, due date and status; supports status and assignee filters.
    - Kanban has **Pending / Completed / Skipped** columns and allows changing status using clear controls (drag/drop is optional polish, not a requirement).
    - Only Pending chores dated before today are marked **Overdue**; due today is not overdue. Responsive mobile view allows access to all columns without clipped inaccessible content.

    ---
    title: use client
    description: Learn how to use the use client directive to render a component on the client.
    ---
    
    The `'use client'` directive declares an entry point for the components to be rendered on the **client side** and should be used when creating interactive user interfaces (UI) that require client-side JavaScript capabilities, such as state management, event handling, and access to browser APIs. This is a React feature.
    
    > **Good to know:**
    >
    > You do not need to add the `'use client'` directive to every file that contains Client Components. You only need to add it to the files whose components you want to render directly within Server Components. The `'use client'` directive defines the [server and client boundary](/docs/app/guides/server-and-client-boundary), and the components exported from such a file serve as entry points to the client.
    
    ## Usage
    
    To declare an entry point for the Client Components, add the `'use client'` directive **at the top of the file**, before any imports. The directive applies to the entire module and cannot be placed inside a component or function:
    
    ```tsx filename="app/components/counter.tsx" highlight={1} switcher
    'use client'
    
    import { useState } from 'react'
    
    export default function Counter() {
      const [count, setCount] = useState(0)
    
      return (
        <div>
          <p>Count: {count}</p>
          <button onClick={() => setCount(count + 1)}>Increment</button>
        </div>
      )
    }
    ```
    
    ```jsx filename="app/components/counter.js" highlight={1} switcher
    'use client'
    
    import { useState } from 'react'
    
    export default function Counter() {
      const [count, setCount] = useState(0)
    
      return (
        <div>
          <p>Count: {count}</p>
          <button onClick={() => setCount(count + 1)}>Increment</button>
        </div>
      )
    }
    ```
    
    When using the `'use client'` directive, the props of the Client Components must be [serializable](https://react.dev/reference/rsc/use-client#serializable-types). This means the props need to be in a format that React can serialize when sending data from the server to the client.
    
    ```tsx filename="app/components/counter.tsx" highlight={4} switcher
    'use client'
    
    export default function Counter({
      onClick /* ❌ Function is not serializable */,
    }) {
      return (
        <div>
          <button onClick={onClick}>Increment</button>
        </div>
      )
    }
    ```
    
    ```jsx filename="app/components/counter.js" highlight={4} switcher
    'use client'
    
    export default function Counter({
      onClick /* ❌ Function is not serializable */,
    }) {
      return (
        <div>
          <button onClick={onClick}>Increment</button>
        </div>
      )
    }
    ```
    
    ## Nesting Client Components within Server Components
    
    Combining Server and Client Components allows you to build applications that are both performant and interactive:
    
    1. **Server Components**: Use for static content, data fetching, and SEO-friendly elements.
    2. **Client Components**: Use for interactive elements that require state, effects, or browser APIs.
    3. **Component composition**: Nest Client Components within Server Components as needed for a clear separation of server and client logic.
    
    In the following example:
    
    - `Header` is a Server Component handling static content.
    - `Counter` is a Client Component enabling interactivity within the page.
    
    ```tsx filename="app/page.tsx" highlight={2,8} switcher
    import Header from './header'
    import Counter from './counter' // This is a Client Component
    
    export default function Page() {
      return (
        <div>
          <Header />
          <Counter />
        </div>
      )
    }
    ```
    
    ```jsx filename="app/page.js" highlight={2,8} switcher
    import Header from './header'
    import Counter from './counter' // This is a Client Component
    
    export default function Page() {
      return (
        <div>
          <Header />
          <Counter />
        </div>
      )
    }
    ```
    
    ## Reference
    
    See the [React documentation](https://react.dev/reference/rsc/use-client) for more information on `'use client'`.

    # RoomieOS implementation plan
    
    **Last updated:** 23 November 2026
    
    **Status:** Milestone 3 implementation and verification complete. No deployment performed.
    
    **Current milestone:** Milestone 3 — chores complete.
    
    **Next milestone:** Milestone 4 — expense arithmetic, CRUD, balances and settlement.
    
    **Delivery target:** Thursday, 26 November 2026; Friday, 27 November is the submission/fix buffer.
    
    ## 1. Purpose, authority and decisions
    
    Build a polished Next.js client-side prototype for ENTI 407. `docs/PRD.md` is authoritative for behavior; `docs/DESIGN.md` is authoritative for UI/UX. This document records approved architecture, sequencing and actual progress. It does not override those requirements.
    
    At plan approval, the repository contained documentation and a README, with no application scaffold. The foundation, household setup/persistence and chores are now implemented; see the progress record below. Update this record after each working slice: check only completed work, record actual verification, and keep the current/next milestone accurate. Surface conflicts or new scope for user review rather than inventing requirements.
    
    ### Resolved requirements and defaults
    
    - **Approved Milestone 2 expansion:** The user raised the active-roommate limit from 5 to 20 and requested more avatar choices. The current limit is **2–20 active roommates**, with 40 named/grouped emoji presets plus initials. PRD and DESIGN version 1.1 now reflect this explicit user-approved change from the original 2–5 limit. Existing saved avatar values and `schemaVersion: 1` remain compatible.
    - **Backend conflict resolved:** The user selected the approved local-only scope. Use Next.js App Router without backend API routes, Server Actions, authentication or a database. Household operations run in the browser.
    - **History ordering:** Preserve completion events in append order; display newest first, as DESIGN specifies.
    - **Archived-member edge cases:** Historical records remain viewable and editable without losing member references. Before reopening an expense involving archived members, require their restoration. Before reopening a chore assigned to an archived member, require reassignment to an active member. Rotation can directly select the next active member.
    - **Design contrast:** Preserve the visual palette, but use sufficiently dark text variants where muted tokens fail contrast requirements.
    - **Priority:** All PRD must-haves remain MVP requirements. Defer photo uploads, drag-and-drop and decorative animation.
    
    ## 2. Architecture and state
    
    Use Next.js App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and `lucide-react`, with static deployment on Vercel.
    
    ### Application structure
    
    - **Routes (`src/app`):** `/` for Dashboard, plus `/welcome`, `/chores`, `/expenses`, `/agreements` and `/settings`. A client initialization gate shows loading until storage is read, then presents setup, recovery or the requested screen.
    - **Shared UI (`src/components`, `src/styles`):** App shell, page header, avatar/picker, fields, status pills, accessible dialogs, confirmations, notices and empty states. Desktop sidebar; mobile navigation drawer. Tables become cards on phones; Kanban scrolls within its own region.
    - **Feature modules (`src/features`):** Setup, household, chores, expenses, agreements and dashboard. Keep form drafts local to their feature.
    - **Domain utilities (`src/domain`):** Types, runtime validation, money parsing/allocation, balances, rotation, date helpers and sample generation. These functions must not depend on React or browser storage.
    - **State layer (`src/state`):** One client provider with typed domain actions and shared selectors. Route changes must preserve the provider. Keep browser storage access behind a small adapter.
    
    Follow the PRD's `AppState` model with `schemaVersion: 1`. Use stable IDs and member ordering; retain archived members. Persist facts, selected profile and settings. Calculate balances, transfer suggestions, overdue indicators and dashboard counts from those facts.
    
    ### Important interfaces
    
    - Domain actions cover CRUD, status changes, rotation, archive/restore, profile selection and resets.
    - Commands return success or actionable validation/storage errors.
    - Storage exposes load, save and clear operations with explicit failure results.
    - Inject time and ID generation into domain operations where needed for deterministic tests.
    
    ### Financial rules
    
    - Parse currency input as decimal strings into integer cents; percentages into integer basis points.
    - Require safe integer amounts and reject inputs whose calculations exceed supported integer bounds.
    - Allocate equal-split remainder cents by stable roster order. Use largest remainder for percentages, with the same stable tie-breaker.
    - Validate payer and participant totals independently. Reject duplicate entries for the same member within each role.
    - Generate advisory transfers from open-expense nets, matching largest balances first with stable member-ID ties.
    - Settlement is a confirmed whole-expense marker for resolution outside the app, never an integrated payment action.
    
    ## 3. Persistence and recovery
    
    Use only `localStorage["roomieos:v1"]`.
    
    - Read storage once after client mount. Do not render household-dependent content or save defaults before initialization completes.
    - Distinguish absent data, valid data, malformed/unsupported data and unavailable storage.
    - Validate structure, references, roster constraints, dates and financial invariants on load and before persistence.
    - Generate sample data only after explicit selection or confirmed reset. Base dates on the local date at that moment.
    - For each change, calculate and validate the next state, persist it, then publish it to React. Show success only after saving succeeds.
    - If saving fails, preserve the prior household and the user's form input. Show a useful error and allow retry.
    - Invalid data remains untouched until the user confirms reset. Unsupported versions must not silently become sample data.
    - Reset demo replaces saved state only after confirmation. Start over clears it only after confirmation and successful storage removal.
    - On another tab's storage change, stop stale writes and offer reload before further editing.
    - Store calendar dates as `YYYY-MM-DD`; use timestamps for completion events. Recompute date-sensitive displays on focus and relevant interactions.
    
    ## 4. Milestones and implementation order
    
    Each milestone ends with relevant checks, a reviewable commit and a progress update here. Introduce polish with each feature rather than postponing the entire visual design until release. During intermediate milestones, hide unavailable actions instead of exposing dead buttons.
    
    | Done | Milestone | Deliverable and acceptance gate | Target |
    |---|---|---|---|
    | [x] | 0. Planning record | Save approved plan; add document precedence and progress rules to AGENTS | Monday |
    | [x] | 1. Foundation | Scaffold, design tokens, responsive shell, shared controls/dialogs, test scripts; build passes | Completed Monday |
    | [x] | 2. Setup and persistence | Sample/empty setup, roster, profile switching, household settings, storage validation/recovery, reset/start over; refresh preserves edits | Completed Monday |
    | [x] | 3. Chores | CRUD, status/history, rotation/date confirmation, filters, List/Kanban, overdue; both views use identical state | Completed Monday |
    | [ ] | 4. Expenses | Money utilities/tests first; then CRUD, multiple payers, three split modes, breakdowns, balances and settle/reopen | Wednesday |
    | [ ] | 5. Integration | Agreements CRUD, derived dashboard, complete sample data, consistent empty/error states and feedback | Wednesday |
    | [ ] | 6. Release | Accessibility/mobile checks, production build, Vercel verification, video and real prompt transcript | Thursday |

    ## 5. Dependencies, tests and risks
    
    ### Dependencies
    
    Next.js, React, React DOM, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and Lucide. Add Zod for runtime validation and Vitest for domain/storage tests. Use native forms and native dialogs with tested focus handling. Avoid state libraries, chart packages, remote fonts and UI frameworks. Select compatible stable package versions during scaffolding and commit the lockfile.
    
    Foundation tooling also includes Playwright for real-browser layout/navigation/dialog checks and Prettier for source formatting. Milestone 2 adds Zod 4.6.7 as a direct runtime dependency. TypeScript is pinned to 6.0.3 because the installed Next.js lint tooling rejects TypeScript 7; ESLint 9 matches the upstream React plugin's supported peer range. Exact dependency versions are recorded in `package-lock.json`.
    
    ### Required verification
    
    - **Money:** 100 cents across three participants yields 34/33/33; multiple payers; percentage rounding/ties; fixed totals; invalid inputs; zero-sum nets; deterministic transfers; settlement/reopening.
    - **Chores:** Completion identity/time; repeated completion without duplicate events for unchanged status; preserved history; rotation wraparound and archived members; yesterday/today comparisons.
    - **State/storage:** Sample and empty initialization; malformed/unsupported payloads; failed reads/writes/clears; roster limits; archive guards; currency blocked by any expenses.
    - **Browser:** Refresh every major flow, switch perspective, cancel dialogs, keyboard navigation/focus restoration, error feedback and every visible action.
    - **Layout:** 375, 768 and 1280 px; contained board scrolling; usable expense forms and dialogs.
    - **Release:** Lint, typecheck, tests and production build; deployed deep links and private-window first-run behavior.
    
    ### Main risks and mitigations
    
    | Risk | Mitigation |
    |---|---|
    | Expense-form complexity and rounding | Implement pure tested arithmetic first; preview exact contributions/shares before save |
    | Storage hydration and data loss | Client initialization gate, runtime validation, explicit recovery and save-before-publish |
    | Archived historical references | Retain member records and stable order; guard reopening and new assignments |
    | Dialog accessibility and mobile density | Reuse shared primitives; check keyboard, focus and small viewports early |
    | Short deadline | Small milestones; prioritize correct required behavior; defer optional visuals/uploads |
