    # RoomieOS
    
    Your shared home, organized. An ENTI 407 client-side household prototype built with Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and Lucide.
    
    ## Local development
    
    Use Node.js 22.12 or newer and npm:
    
    ```sh
    npm ci
    npm run dev
    ```
    
    Open <http://localhost:3000>. Choose a sample household or create an empty household with a name, currency and 2–20 active roommates. Settings supports household edits, roommate names/avatars, archive/restore, reset demo and start over. The profile switcher changes your local demo perspective.
    
    Household data is validated and saved only in this browser under `roomieos:v1`. Refresh preserves changes; sample data is never silently regenerated. Invalid/unsupported data requires explicit confirmed recovery. Storage errors keep the previous household and form entries. If another tab changes the saved household, reload before editing further.
    
    Chores support create/edit/delete, List and Board views, roommate/status filters, completion history and manual rotation with a confirmed due date. Click a chore title for details and actions. Completing a chore records the current demo perspective; reopening and rotating preserve its history. Expenses and agreements currently show saved records without editing controls; expense balances and settlement belong to later milestones. Photo uploads remain deferred; initials and 40 named icon avatars work locally, grouped by nature, animals, food/drink, hobbies and home/favorites.
    
    ## Current checkpoint
    
    Milestone 3 implements chores as of 23 November 2026. Next is Milestone 4: expense arithmetic, CRUD, multiple payers, equal/percentage/fixed splits, balances and settle/reopen. The final dashboard will add personal balances and a fuller personal/household arrangement during expense/integration work. See [PLAN.md](PLAN.md) for progress and actual verification results.
    
    ## Checks
    
    ```sh
    npm run lint
    npm run typecheck
    npm test
    npm run build
    npm run test:browser
    ```
    
    Vitest checks chore CRUD, completion identity/history, rotation, archived members, local-calendar dates, setup, sample validity, roster/currency guards, saved-payload validation and storage transactions/failures. Browser tests cover chore CRUD/List/Board/filters/history, rotation confirmations, overdue date changes, long content, setup and persistence, profile switching, roster management, recovery, failed-save retries, reset confirmations, cross-tab conflicts, responsive overflow and native-dialog keyboard behavior at 375, 768 and 1280 px. Install Playwright Chromium once with `npx playwright install chromium`, or use an existing compatible Chromium executable:
    
    ```sh
    CHROMIUM_PATH=/usr/bin/chromium-browser npm run test:browser
    ```
    
    The browser suite starts its own local dev server on port 3100 with an isolated `.next-e2e/` build directory, leaving a running preview on port 3000 alone. Override the test port with `ROOMIEOS_TEST_PORT` if necessary. Screenshots and failure traces are saved under the ignored `test-results/` directory.
    
    ## Hydration troubleshooting
    
    If the development overlay shows unexpected HTML attributes such as `bis_skin_checked` or `bis_register`, a browser extension may have modified the page before React hydrated it. Those attributes are not generated by RoomieOS. Try a fresh browser profile with extensions disabled, or a private window where no extensions are allowed. If the warning disappears, disable the responsible extension for localhost and reload. See the [Next.js hydration guide](https://nextjs.org/docs/messages/react-hydration-error).
    
    Keep hydration diagnostics enabled. The route browser test checks both uncaught errors and console errors, including React hydration warnings, in an isolated browser context. If the warning persists with extensions disabled, inspect the new diff for an application mismatch.
    
    ## Structure and deployment
    
    - `src/app`: static App Router pages and household route-group layout.
    - `src/components`: shared shell and UI primitives.
    - `src/features`: feature views; foundation views will be replaced incrementally.
    - `src/domain`: serializable types, runtime validation, household actions, date helpers and sample generation.
    - `src/state`: household provider, hydration gate and save-before-publish storage store.
    - `src/styles`: design tokens mapped into Tailwind.
    
    `npm run build` exports static files to `out/`, suitable for Vercel. There are no backend API routes, server mutations, remote fonts or service integrations. No deployment is performed by the foundation scripts.
    
    Read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md), [PLAN.md](PLAN.md), [PRD](docs/PRD.md) and [DESIGN](docs/DESIGN.md) before implementation. PLAN tracks verified progress; PRD and DESIGN remain authoritative for behavior and UI/UX.

## Assistant

I found why matching the timezone name wasn’t enough: Node and the installed Chromium report different daylight-saving offsets for Edmonton on this date. General tests now use UTC on both sides, and the separate Edmonton midnight check remains. The app itself still uses the visitor’s browser-local date.

    Structure:

    2. Three summary cards on desktop: **My pending chores**, **My balance**, **Open household expenses** (counts/amounts derived from app state).
    3. Two-column section: **My upcoming chores** (title, due date, status) + **Household at a glance** (pending/completed counts and optional quick link to agreements).
    4. One contextual call to action (e.g. `Add a chore`) with no competing button cluster.
    
    Keep numbers defensible and labels precise: outstanding expense total is different from total net balances. Prefer open-expense **count** rather than a misleading 'total debt' if unclear. Personal net: `You are owed CAD 12.50` or `You owe CAD 12.50`; show `All settled` when zero.

    - **Roommates:** vertical list with avatar, name, Edit and Remove (archive), plus `Add roommate`; separate small archived-member area with Restore where applicable. Explain why deletion may be blocked.
    - **Prototype data:** note `Stored on this browser only`; `Reset demo` and `Start over` (both confirmation dialogs, with destructive wording). Do not expose opaque localStorage/debug details to ordinary users.
    
    ## 6. Components and reusable patterns
    
    - `AppShell`: navigation, sidebar/drawer, top bar.
    - `PageHeader`: title, subtitle, primary action.
    - `MemberAvatar`: icon / initials / local photo with consistent circle geometry; use accessible alt text.
    - `MemberPicker`: select active roommate with avatar.
    - `StatusPill`: reusable statuses with text and icon.
    - `EmptyState`: simple title, supporting sentence, one action.
    - `ConfirmDialog`: destructive/settlement confirmation; escape, focus, keyboard handling.
    - `FormField`: label, help text, error, control.
    - `InlineNotice`: a clear and calm explanation for constraints (e.g. currency locked).
    - `DataTable` or table-like layout: only as complex as needed; mobile cards.
    - `Modal/Sheet`: focused editing flow with clear save/cancel, not full-screen arbitrary complexity.
    
    **Interaction details:**
    - Hover: subtle gray; active: pale accent.
    - Loading: only where actual waiting exists; localStorage actions are immediate.
    - Saving: close modal and show toast like `Chore saved`; don't show fake spinners.
    - Destructive: always confirm, explain consequences, avoid accidentally deleting data.
    - Form errors: show beside fields; preserve typed values and focus first invalid field on attempted save.
    - Date: human-readable display (e.g. `Tue, Nov 24`) but store ISO date and compare local dates correctly.
    - Balance: tabular numerals; consistent currency code; never use color alone to indicate owed/owing.

    | Storage failure | `Couldn't save changes` | `Your browser storage may be full. Try using an icon avatar instead of a photo.` |
    | Invalid stored data | `Saved data couldn't be opened` | `You can start again, but resetting will erase this browser's RoomieOS data.` |

    ---
    title: use client
    description: Learn how to use the use client directive to render a component on the client.
    ---
    
    The `'use client'` directive declares an entry point for the components to be rendered on the **client side** and should be used when creating interactive user interfaces (UI) that require client-side JavaScript capabilities, such as state management, event handling, and access to browser APIs. This is a React feature.
    
    > **Good to know:**
    >
    > You do not need to add the `'use client'` directive to every file that contains Client Components. You only need to add it to the files whose components you want to render directly within Server Components. The `'use client'` directive defines the [server and client boundary](/docs/app/guides/server-and-client-boundary), and the components exported from such a file serve as entry points to the client.
    
    ## Usage
    
    To declare an entry point for the Client Components, add the `'use client'` directive **at the top of the file**, before any imports. The directive applies to the entire module and cannot be placed inside a component or function:
    
    ```tsx filename="app/components/counter.tsx" highlight={1} switcher
    'use client'
    
    import { useState } from 'react'
    
    export default function Counter() {
      const [count, setCount] = useState(0)
    
      return (
        <div>
          <p>Count: {count}</p>
          <button onClick={() => setCount(count + 1)}>Increment</button>
        </div>
      )
    }
    ```
    
    ```jsx filename="app/components/counter.js" highlight={1} switcher
    'use client'
    
    import { useState } from 'react'
    
    export default function Counter() {
      const [count, setCount] = useState(0)
    
      return (
        <div>
          <p>Count: {count}</p>
          <button onClick={() => setCount(count + 1)}>Increment</button>
        </div>
      )
    }
    ```
    
    When using the `'use client'` directive, the props of the Client Components must be [serializable](https://react.dev/reference/rsc/use-client#serializable-types). This means the props need to be in a format that React can serialize when sending data from the server to the client.
    
    ```tsx filename="app/components/counter.tsx" highlight={4} switcher
    'use client'
    
    export default function Counter({
      onClick /* ❌ Function is not serializable */,
    }) {
      return (
        <div>
          <button onClick={onClick}>Increment</button>
        </div>
      )
    }
    ```
    
    ```jsx filename="app/components/counter.js" highlight={4} switcher
    'use client'
    
    export default function Counter({
      onClick /* ❌ Function is not serializable */,
    }) {
      return (
        <div>
          <button onClick={onClick}>Increment</button>
        </div>
      )
    }
    ```
    
    ## Nesting Client Components within Server Components
    
    Combining Server and Client Components allows you to build applications that are both performant and interactive:
    
    1. **Server Components**: Use for static content, data fetching, and SEO-friendly elements.
    2. **Client Components**: Use for interactive elements that require state, effects, or browser APIs.
    3. **Component composition**: Nest Client Components within Server Components as needed for a clear separation of server and client logic.
    
    In the following example:
    
    - `Header` is a Server Component handling static content.
    - `Counter` is a Client Component enabling interactivity within the page.
    
    ```tsx filename="app/page.tsx" highlight={2,8} switcher
    import Header from './header'
    import Counter from './counter' // This is a Client Component
    
    export default function Page() {
      return (
        <div>
          <Header />
          <Counter />
        </div>
      )
    }
    ```
    
    ```jsx filename="app/page.js" highlight={2,8} switcher
    import Header from './header'
    import Counter from './counter' // This is a Client Component
    
    export default function Page() {
      return (
        <div>
          <Header />
          <Counter />
        </div>
      )
    }
    ```
    
    ## Reference
    
    See the [React documentation](https://react.dev/reference/rsc/use-client) for more information on `'use client'`.

    Build a polished Next.js client-side prototype for ENTI 407. `docs/PRD.md` is authoritative for behavior; `docs/DESIGN.md` is authoritative for UI/UX. This document records approved architecture, sequencing and actual progress. It does not override those requirements.

Update this record after each working slice: check only completed work, record actual verification, and keep the current/next milestone accurate.     ### Resolved requirements and defaults
    
    - **Approved Milestone 2 expansion:** The user raised the active-roommate limit from 5 to 20 and requested more avatar choices. The current limit is **2–20 active roommates**, with 40 named/grouped emoji presets plus initials. PRD and DESIGN version 1.1 now reflect this explicit user-approved change from the original 2–5 limit. Existing saved avatar values and `schemaVersion: 1` remain compatible.
    - **Backend conflict resolved:** The user selected the approved local-only scope. Use Next.js App Router without backend API routes, Server Actions, authentication or a database. Household operations run in the browser.
    - **History ordering:** Preserve completion events in append order; display newest first, as DESIGN specifies.
    - **Archived-member edge cases:** Historical records remain viewable and editable without losing member references. Before reopening an expense involving archived members, require their restoration. Before reopening a chore assigned to an archived member, require reassignment to an active member. Rotation can directly select the next active member.
    - **Design contrast:** Preserve the visual palette, but use sufficiently dark text variants where muted tokens fail contrast requirements.
    - **Priority:** All PRD must-haves remain MVP requirements. Defer photo uploads, drag-and-drop and decorative animation.
    
    ## 2. Architecture and state
    
    Use Next.js App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and `lucide-react`, with static deployment on Vercel.
    
    ### Application structure
    
    - **Routes (`src/app`):** `/` for Dashboard, plus `/welcome`, `/chores`, `/expenses`, `/agreements` and `/settings`. A client initialization gate shows loading until storage is read, then presents setup, recovery or the requested screen.
    - **Shared UI (`src/components`, `src/styles`):** App shell, page header, avatar/picker, fields, status pills, accessible dialogs, confirmations, notices and empty states. Desktop sidebar; mobile navigation drawer. Tables become cards on phones; Kanban scrolls within its own region.
    - **Feature modules (`src/features`):** Setup, household, chores, expenses, agreements and dashboard. Keep form drafts local to their feature.
    - **Domain utilities (`src/domain`):** Types, runtime validation, money parsing/allocation, balances, rotation, date helpers and sample generation. These functions must not depend on React or browser storage.
    - **State layer (`src/state`):** One client provider with typed domain actions and shared selectors. Route changes must preserve the provider. Keep browser storage access behind a small adapter.
    
    Follow the PRD's `AppState` model with `schemaVersion: 1`. Use stable IDs and member ordering; retain archived members. Persist facts, selected profile and settings. Calculate balances, transfer suggestions, overdue indicators and dashboard counts from those facts.
    
    ### Important interfaces
    
    - Domain actions cover CRUD, status changes, rotation, archive/restore, profile selection and resets.
    - Commands return success or actionable validation/storage errors.
    - Storage exposes load, save and clear operations with explicit failure results.
    - Inject time and ID generation into domain operations where needed for deterministic tests.
    
    ### Financial rules
    
    - Parse currency input as decimal strings into integer cents; percentages into integer basis points.
    - Require safe integer amounts and reject inputs whose calculations exceed supported integer bounds.
    - Allocate equal-split remainder cents by stable roster order. Use largest remainder for percentages, with the same stable tie-breaker.
    - Validate payer and participant totals independently. Reject duplicate entries for the same member within each role.
    - Generate advisory transfers from open-expense nets, matching largest balances first with stable member-ID ties.
    - Settlement is a confirmed whole-expense marker for resolution outside the app, never an integrated payment action.
    
    ## 3. Persistence and recovery
    
    Use only `localStorage["roomieos:v1"]`.
    
    - Read storage once after client mount. Do not render household-dependent content or save defaults before initialization completes.
    - Distinguish absent data, valid data, malformed/unsupported data and unavailable storage.
    - Validate structure, references, roster constraints, dates and financial invariants on load and before persistence.
    - Generate sample data only after explicit selection or confirmed reset. Base dates on the local date at that moment.
    - For each change, calculate and validate the next state, persist it, then publish it to React. Show success only after saving succeeds.
    - If saving fails, preserve the prior household and the user's form input. Show a useful error and allow retry.
    - Invalid data remains untouched until the user confirms reset. Unsupported versions must not silently become sample data.
    - Reset demo replaces saved state only after confirmation. Start over clears it only after confirmation and successful storage removal.
    - On another tab's storage change, stop stale writes and offer reload before further editing.
    - Store calendar dates as `YYYY-MM-DD`; use timestamps for completion events. Recompute date-sensitive displays on focus and relevant interactions.

    "use client";
    
    import { useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
    import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
    import { Dialog } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
    import { FormField, controlStyles } from "@/components/ui/form-field";
    import { InlineNotice } from "@/components/ui/inline-notice";
    import { SelectField } from "@/components/ui/select-field";
    import { activeMembers } from "@/domain/household";
    import { localDate } from "@/domain/dates";
    import type { ChoreDraft } from "@/domain/chores";
    import type { Chore } from "@/domain/types";
    import { choreDraftSchema } from "@/domain/validation";
    import { useReadyHousehold } from "@/state/household-provider";
    import { focusInvalid } from "../household/fields";
    
    export function ChoreForm({
      chore,
      onClose,
    }: {
      chore: Chore | null;
      onClose: () => void;
    }) {
      const { state, store, conflict } = useReadyHousehold();
      const [draft, setDraft] = useState<ChoreDraft>(
        chore
          ? {
              title: chore.title,
              notes: chore.notes,
              assigneeId: chore.assigneeId,
              dueDate: chore.dueDate,
            }
          : {
              title: "",
              notes: "",
              assigneeId: state.selectedMemberId,
              dueDate: localDate(new Date()),
            },
      );
      const [errors, setErrors] = useState<
        Partial<Record<keyof ChoreDraft, string>>
      >({});
      const [saveError, setSaveError] = useState<string>();
      const archivedAssignee =
        chore &&
        state.members.find(
          (member) => member.id === chore.assigneeId && !member.active,
        );
      function change(field: keyof ChoreDraft, value: string) {
        setDraft({ ...draft, [field]: value });
        setErrors({ ...errors, [field]: undefined });
        setSaveError(undefined);
      }
      function submit(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
        event.preventDefault();
        const parsed = choreDraftSchema.safeParse({
          ...draft,
          title: draft.title.trim(),
        });
        const nextErrors: typeof errors = {};
        if (!parsed.success) {
          for (const issue of parsed.error.issues) {
            const field = issue.path[0] as keyof ChoreDraft;
            nextErrors[field] =
              field === "title"
                ? "Enter a title (1–100 characters)."
                : field === "notes"
                  ? "Keep notes to 1000 characters or fewer."
                  : issue.message;
          }
        }
        if (
          !state.members.some(
            (member) =>
              member.id === draft.assigneeId &&
              (member.active || member.id === archivedAssignee?.id),
          )
        )
          nextErrors.assigneeId = "Choose an active roommate.";
        setErrors(nextErrors);
        if (Object.keys(nextErrors).length || !parsed.success) {
          focusInvalid(event.currentTarget);
          return;
        }
        const result = store.dispatch(
          chore
            ? { type: "edit-chore", id: chore.id, chore: parsed.data }
            : { type: "add-chore", chore: parsed.data },
          chore ? "Chore updated." : "Chore saved.",
        );
        if (result.ok) onClose();
        else setSaveError(result.error);
      }
      return (
        <Dialog open title={chore ? "Edit chore" : "New chore"} onClose={onClose}>
          <form noValidate onSubmit={submit} className="space-y-5">
            <FormField
              id="chore-title"
              label="Title"
              required
              maxLength={100}
              value={draft.title}
              onChange={(event) => change("title", event.target.value)}
              error={errors.title}
            />
            <SelectField
              id="chore-assignee"
              label="Assigned to (required)"
              required
              value={draft.assigneeId}
              onChange={(event) => change("assigneeId", event.target.value)}
              error={errors.assigneeId}
              help={
                archivedAssignee
                  ? "Keep this historical assignment, or choose an active roommate before reopening."
                  : undefined
              }
            >
              {archivedAssignee && (
                <option value={archivedAssignee.id}>
                  {archivedAssignee.name} (archived — current assignment)
                </option>
              )}
              {activeMembers(state).map((member) => (
                <option key={member.id} value={member.id}>
                  {member.name}
                </option>
              ))}
            </SelectField>
            <FormField
              id="chore-due-date"
              label="Due date"
              required
              type="date"
              min="0001-01-01"
              max="9999-12-31"
              value={draft.dueDate}
              onChange={(event) => change("dueDate", event.target.value)}
              error={errors.dueDate}
            />
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <label htmlFor="chore-notes" className="block text-sm font-medium">
                Notes (optional)
              </label>
              <textarea
                id="chore-notes"
                className={`${controlStyles} min-h-28 resize-y`}
                rows={4}
                maxLength={1000}
                value={draft.notes}
                onChange={(event) => change("notes", event.target.value)}
                aria-invalid={Boolean(errors.notes)}
                aria-describedby={errors.notes ? "chore-notes-error" : undefined}
              />
              {errors.notes && (
                <p id="chore-notes-error" className="text-sm text-danger">
                  {errors.notes}
                </p>
              )}
            </div>
            {conflict && (
              <InlineNotice tone="error">
                This household changed in another tab. Close this dialog and reload
                the saved household before saving.
              </InlineNotice>
            )}
            {saveError && <InlineNotice tone="error">{saveError}</InlineNotice>}
            <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-end gap-3">
              <Button variant="secondary" onClick={onClose}>
                Cancel
              </Button>
              <Button type="submit" disabled={conflict}>
                Save chore
              </Button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </Dialog>
      );
    }

    import { focusInvalid } from "../household/fields";
    import { ChoreForm } from "./chore-form";
    
    function RotationForm({
      chore,
      onClose,
    }: {
      chore: Chore;
      onClose: () => void;
    }) {
      const { state, store, conflict } = useReadyHousehold();
      const next = nextChoreAssignee(state, chore.assigneeId);
      const [date, setDate] = useState(() =>
        suggestedRotationDate(chore.dueDate, localDate(new Date())),
      );
      const [dateError, setDateError] = useState<string>();
      const [saveError, setSaveError] = useState<string>();
      function submit(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
        event.preventDefault();
        if (!isCalendarDate(date)) {
          setDateError("Choose a valid calendar date.");
          focusInvalid(event.currentTarget);
          return;
        }
        const result = store.dispatch(
          { type: "rotate-chore", id: chore.id, dueDate: date },
          `Chore rotated to ${next.name}.`,
        );
        if (result.ok) onClose();
        else setSaveError(result.error);
      }
      return (
        <Dialog
          open
          title="Rotate chore"
          onClose={onClose}
          description={`Assign “${chore.title}” to ${next.name} and reopen it as Pending. Completion history will be kept.`}
        >
          <form noValidate onSubmit={submit} className="space-y-5">
            <p className="break-words text-sm">
              Next roommate: <strong>{next.name}</strong>
            </p>
            <FormField
              id="rotation-date"
              type="date"
              min="0001-01-01"
              max="9999-12-31"
              label="New due date"
              required
              value={date}
              onChange={(event) => {
                setDate(event.target.value);
                setDateError(undefined);
              }}
              error={dateError}
            />
            {conflict && (
              <InlineNotice tone="error">
                This household changed in another tab. Close this dialog and reload
                the saved household before saving.
              </InlineNotice>
            )}
            {saveError && <InlineNotice tone="error">{saveError}</InlineNotice>}
            <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-end gap-3">
              <Button variant="secondary" onClick={onClose}>
                Cancel
              </Button>
              <Button type="submit" disabled={conflict}>
                Confirm rotation
              </Button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </Dialog>
      );
    }
    
    export function ChoreDetails({
      chore,
      today,
      onClose,
      onDeleted,
    }: {
      chore: Chore;
      today: string;
      onClose: () => void;
      onDeleted: () => void;
    }) {
      const { state, store, conflict } = useReadyHousehold();
      const [overlay, setOverlay] = useState<"edit" | "rotate" | "delete" | null>(
        null,
      );
      const [error, setError] = useState<string>();
      const assignee = state.members.find(
        (member) => member.id === chore.assigneeId,
      )!;
      const selected = state.members.find(
        (member) => member.id === state.selectedMemberId,
      )!;
      const changeStatus = (status: ChoreStatus) => {
        const result = store.dispatch(
          { type: "set-chore-status", id: chore.id, status },
          status === "completed"
            ? "Chore completed."
            : status === "skipped"
              ? "Chore skipped."
              : "Chore reopened.",
        );
        setError(result.ok ? undefined : result.error);
      };
      function openOverlay(value: typeof overlay) {
        setError(undefined);
        store.dismissFeedback();
        setOverlay(value);
      }
      return (
        <>
          <Dialog open title={chore.title} onClose={onClose}>
            <div className="space-y-6">
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                <StatusPill status={chore.status} />
                {isOverdue(chore, today) && (
                  <span className="text-sm font-medium text-danger">Overdue</span>
                )}
              </div>
              <dl className="grid gap-4 text-sm sm:grid-cols-2">
                <div>
                  <dt className="text-muted">Assigned to</dt>
                  <dd className="mt-1 break-words font-medium">
                    {assignee.name}
                    {!assignee.active && " (archived)"}
                  </dd>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <dt className="text-muted">Due date</dt>
                  <dd className="mt-1 font-medium">{displayDate(chore.dueDate)}</dd>
                </div>
              </dl>
              {chore.notes && (
                <div>
                  <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold">Notes</h3>
                  <p className="mt-2 whitespace-pre-wrap break-words text-sm text-muted">
                    {chore.notes}
                  </p>
                </div>
              )}
              {!assignee.active && (
                <InlineNotice>
                  To reopen, use Edit to assign an active roommate, or rotate to the
                  next active roommate.
                </InlineNotice>
              )}
              <div>
                <p className="mb-3 text-sm text-muted">
                  Completions are recorded as {selected.name}, your current demo
                  perspective.
                </p>
                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                  {chore.status !== "completed" && (
                    <Button
                      disabled={conflict}
                      onClick={() => changeStatus("completed")}
                    >
                      Mark completed
                    </Button>
                  )}
                  {chore.status !== "pending" && (
                    <Button
                      variant={
                        chore.status === "completed" ? "primary" : "secondary"
                      }
                      disabled={conflict || !assignee.active}
                      onClick={() => changeStatus("pending")}
                    >
                      Reopen as pending
                    </Button>
                  )}
                  {chore.status !== "skipped" && (
                    <Button
                      variant="secondary"
                      disabled={conflict}
                      onClick={() => changeStatus("skipped")}
                    >
                      Skip chore
                    </Button>
                  )}
                  <Button
                    variant="secondary"
                    disabled={conflict}
                    onClick={() => openOverlay("rotate")}
                  >
                    Rotate to next
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </div>
              {conflict && (
                <InlineNotice tone="error">
                  This household changed in another tab. Close this dialog and
                  reload the saved household before saving.
                </InlineNotice>
              )}
              {error && <InlineNotice tone="error">{error}</InlineNotice>}
              <section
                className="border-t border-line pt-5"
                aria-label="Completion history"
              >
                <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold">Completion history</h3>
                {chore.completionHistory.length ? (
                  <ol className="mt-3 space-y-3">
                    {[...chore.completionHistory].reverse().map((event) => {
                      const member = state.members.find(
                        (item) => item.id === event.completedById,
                      )!;
                      return (
                        <li
                          key={event.id}
                          className="break-words text-sm text-muted"
                        >
                          Completed by{" "}
                          <span className="font-medium text-ink">
                            {member.name}
                            {!member.active && " (archived)"}
                          </span>{" "}
                          ·{" "}
                          <time dateTime={event.completedAt}>
                            {new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en", {
                              dateStyle: "medium",
                              timeStyle: "short",
                            }).format(new Date(event.completedAt))}
                          </time>
                        </li>
                      );
                    })}
                  </ol>
                ) : (
                  <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-muted">No completions yet.</p>
                )}
              </section>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-between gap-3 border-t border-line pt-5">
                <Button
                  variant="secondary"
                  disabled={conflict}
                  onClick={() => openOverlay("edit")}
                >
                  Edit chore
                </Button>
                <Button
                  variant="danger"
                  disabled={conflict}
                  onClick={() => openOverlay("delete")}
                >
                  Delete chore
                </Button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </Dialog>
          {overlay === "edit" && (
            <ChoreForm chore={chore} onClose={() => setOverlay(null)} />
          )}
          {overlay === "rotate" && (
            <RotationForm chore={chore} onClose={() => setOverlay(null)} />
          )}
          <ConfirmDialog
            open={overlay === "delete"}
            title="Delete chore?"
            description={`Permanently delete “${chore.title}” and its completion history? This cannot be undone.`}
            confirmLabel="Delete chore"
            destructive
            onClose={() => setOverlay(null)}
            error={error}
            onConfirm={() => {
              const result = store.dispatch(
                { type: "delete-chore", id: chore.id },
                "Chore deleted.",
              );
              if (result.ok) onDeleted();
              else setError(result.error);
            }}
          />
        </>
      );
    }
    import { ZodError } from "zod";
    import { applyChoreAction, type ChoreAction } from "../domain/chores";
    import { applyExpenseAction, type ExpenseAction } from "../domain/expenses";
    import {
      applyHouseholdAction,
      createEmptyHousehold,
      type HouseholdAction,
      type SetupInput,
    } from "../domain/household";
    import { createSampleHousehold } from "../domain/sample";
    import { validateState } from "../domain/validation";
    import type { AppState, Currency } from "../domain/types";
    
    export const STORAGE_KEY = "roomieos:v1";
    export type StoragePort = Pick<Storage, "getItem" | "setItem" | "removeItem">;
    export type CommandResult = { ok: true } | { ok: false; error: string };
    export type HouseholdSnapshot = {
      status: "loading" | "empty" | "ready" | "invalid" | "unavailable";
      state: AppState | null;
      error: string | null;
      conflict: boolean;
      notice: string | null;
    };
    export const initialSnapshot: HouseholdSnapshot = {
      status: "loading",
      state: null,
      error: null,
      conflict: false,
      notice: null,
    };
    
    export function createHouseholdStore(
      getStorage: () => StoragePort,
      makeId = () => crypto.randomUUID(),
      now = () => new Date(),
    ) {
      let snapshot = initialSnapshot;
      let lastRaw: string | null = null;
      const listeners = new Set<() => void>();
      const publish = (changes: Partial<HouseholdSnapshot>) => {
        snapshot = { ...snapshot, ...changes };
        listeners.forEach((listener) => listener());
      };
      const failure = (message: string): CommandResult => {
        publish({ error: message, notice: null });
        return { ok: false, error: message };
      };
      const messageFor = (error: unknown) =>
        error instanceof ZodError
          ? (error.issues[0]?.message ?? "Check the form and try again.")
          : error instanceof Error
            ? error.message
            : "The change could not be saved. Try again.";
    
      function initialize() {
        let raw: string | null;
        try {
          raw = getStorage().getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
        } catch {
          publish({
            status: "unavailable",
            state: null,
            error:
              "Browser storage is unavailable. Allow site storage and try again. Your saved data has not been replaced.",
            conflict: false,
            notice: null,
          });
          return;
        }
        lastRaw = raw;
        if (raw === null) {
          publish({
            status: "empty",
            state: null,
            error: null,
            conflict: false,
            notice: null,
          });
          return;
        }
        try {
          const state = validateState(JSON.parse(raw));
          publish({
            status: "ready",
            state,
            error: null,
            conflict: false,
            notice: null,
          });
        } catch {
          publish({
            status: "invalid",
            state: null,
            error:
              "Saved data couldn't be opened. It may be damaged or from an unsupported version. Nothing has been overwritten.",
            conflict: false,
            notice: null,
          });
        }
      }
    
      function checkCurrent(storage: StoragePort) {
        if (snapshot.conflict || storage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY) !== lastRaw) {
          publish({ conflict: true });
          throw new Error(
            "This household changed in another tab. Reload the saved household before making more changes.",
          );
        }
      }
    
      function write(next: AppState, notice: string): CommandResult {
        let state: AppState;
        try {
          state = validateState(next);
        } catch (error) {
          return failure(messageFor(error));
        }
        let storage: StoragePort;
        try {
          storage = getStorage();
          checkCurrent(storage);
        } catch (error) {
          return failure(
            snapshot.conflict
              ? messageFor(error)
              : "Couldn't access browser storage. Your change has not been saved. Allow site storage and retry.",
          );
        }
        const raw = JSON.stringify(state);
        try {
          storage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, raw);
        } catch {
          return failure(
            "Couldn't save changes. Browser storage may be full or blocked. Your previous household and form entries are unchanged. Free some space or allow site storage, then retry.",
          );
        }
        lastRaw = raw;
        publish({ status: "ready", state, error: null, notice, conflict: false });
        return { ok: true };
      }
    
      function dispatch(
        action: HouseholdAction | ChoreAction | ExpenseAction,
        notice: string,
      ): CommandResult {
        if (snapshot.status !== "ready" || !snapshot.state)
          return failure("Open a valid household before making changes.");
        try {
          return write(
            action.type === "add-chore" ||
              action.type === "edit-chore" ||
              action.type === "delete-chore" ||
              action.type === "set-chore-status" ||
              action.type === "rotate-chore"
              ? applyChoreAction(snapshot.state, action, makeId, now())
              : action.type === "add-expense" ||
                  action.type === "edit-expense" ||
                  action.type === "delete-expense" ||
                  action.type === "set-expense-status"
                ? applyExpenseAction(snapshot.state, action, makeId, now())
                : applyHouseholdAction(snapshot.state, action, makeId),
            notice,
          );
        } catch (error) {
          return failure(messageFor(error));
        }
      }
    
      function setup(input: SetupInput): CommandResult {
        if (snapshot.status !== "empty")
          return failure(
            "A saved household already exists. Open it or use Start over in Settings.",
          );
        try {
          return write(
            createEmptyHousehold(input, makeId),
            "Your household is ready.",
          );
        } catch (error) {
          return failure(messageFor(error));
        }
      }
    
      function sample(currency: Currency, reset = false): CommandResult {
        if (
          (!reset && snapshot.status !== "empty") ||
          (reset && snapshot.status !== "ready")
        )
          return failure(
            "Open the household before resetting, or start from the welcome screen.",
          );
        return write(
          createSampleHousehold(now(), currency),
          reset ? "Sample household restored." : "Welcome to Maple House.",
        );
      }
    
      function clear(): CommandResult {
        if (snapshot.status !== "ready" && snapshot.status !== "invalid")
          return failure("No household is available to clear.");
        try {
          const storage = getStorage();
          checkCurrent(storage);
          storage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY);
        } catch (error) {
          return failure(
            snapshot.conflict
              ? messageFor(error)
              : "Couldn't clear saved data. Allow browser storage and try again. Your household has been kept.",
          );
        }
        lastRaw = null;
        publish({
          status: "empty",
          state: null,
          error: null,
          conflict: false,
          notice: "Saved household cleared.",
        });
        return { ok: true };
      }
    
      function checkForExternalChange() {
        if (snapshot.status === "loading" || snapshot.status === "unavailable")
          return;
        try {
          if (getStorage().getItem(STORAGE_KEY) !== lastRaw)
            publish({ conflict: true, notice: null });
        } catch {
          publish({
            error:
              "Couldn't check browser storage. Saving will verify it again before applying any change.",
            notice: null,
          });
        }
      }
    
      return {
        getSnapshot: () => snapshot,
        subscribe: (listener: () => void) => {
          listeners.add(listener);
          return () => {
            listeners.delete(listener);
          };
        },
        initialize,
        dispatch,
        setup,
        sample,
        clear,
        checkForExternalChange,
        dismissFeedback: () => publish({ error: null, notice: null }),
      };
    }
    
    export type HouseholdStore = ReturnType<typeof createHouseholdStore>;
    import { z } from "zod";
    import { isCalendarDate } from "./dates";
    import type { AppState } from "./types";
    import { calculateBalances, splitEqual, splitPercentage } from "./money";
    import {
      avatarIcons,
      MAX_ACTIVE_MEMBERS,
      MIN_ACTIVE_MEMBERS,
    } from "./household-options";
    
    export const currencies = ["CAD", "USD", "EUR", "GBP"] as const;
    const id = z.string().min(1).max(100);
    const text = (max: number) =>
      z
        .string()
        .min(1)
        .max(max)
        .refine(
          (value) => value === value.trim(),
          "Remove spaces at the beginning or end.",
        );
    const cents = z.number().int().nonnegative().max(Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER);
    const calendarDate = z
      .string()
      .refine(isCalendarDate, "Choose a valid calendar date.");
    const timestamp = z.iso.datetime({ offset: true });
    
    export const choreDraftSchema = z.strictObject({
      title: text(100),
      notes: z.string().max(1000),
      assigneeId: id,
      dueDate: calendarDate,
    });
    
    export const expenseDraftSchema = z.strictObject({
      description: text(100),
      amountCents: cents.positive(),
      date: calendarDate,
      category: text(50),
      notes: z.string().max(1000),
      payers: z
        .array(z.strictObject({ memberId: id, amountCents: cents.positive() }))
        .min(1),
      participants: z
        .array(z.strictObject({ memberId: id, amountCents: cents }))
        .min(1),
      splitMethod: z.enum(["equal", "percentage", "fixed"]),
      percentageBasisPoints: z
        .record(id, z.number().int().min(0).max(10000))
        .optional(),
    });
    
    export const avatarSchema = z.discriminatedUnion("kind", [
      z.strictObject({ kind: z.literal("initials"), value: z.literal("") }),
      z.strictObject({ kind: z.literal("icon"), value: z.enum(avatarIcons) }),
      z.strictObject({
        kind: z.literal("image"),
        value: z
          .string()
          .max(100_000)
          .regex(/^data:image\/(png|jpeg|webp);base64,[A-Za-z0-9+/=]+$/),
      }),
    ]);
    export const memberDraftSchema = z.strictObject({
      name: text(40),
      avatar: avatarSchema,
    });
    export const householdDraftSchema = z.strictObject({
      name: text(60),
      currency: z.enum(currencies),
    });
    export const setupSchema = householdDraftSchema.extend({
      members: z
        .array(memberDraftSchema)
        .min(MIN_ACTIVE_MEMBERS)
        .max(MAX_ACTIVE_MEMBERS),
    });
    
    const stateSchema = z
      .strictObject({
        schemaVersion: z.literal(1),
        household: householdDraftSchema,
        members: z.array(
          memberDraftSchema.extend({
            id,
            active: z.boolean(),
            order: z
              .number()
              .int()
              .nonnegative()
              .max(Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER - 1),
          }),
        ),
        selectedMemberId: id,
        chores: z.array(
          choreDraftSchema.extend({
            id,
            status: z.enum(["pending", "completed", "skipped"]),
            completionHistory: z.array(
              z.strictObject({ id, completedById: id, completedAt: timestamp }),
            ),
            createdAt: timestamp,
          }),
        ),
        expenses: z.array(
          expenseDraftSchema.extend({
            id,
            status: z.enum(["open", "settled"]),
            createdAt: timestamp,
          }),
        ),
        agreements: z.array(
          z.strictObject({ id, title: text(100), details: z.string().max(1000) }),
        ),
        starterMode: z.enum(["sample", "empty"]),
      })
      .superRefine((state, ctx) => {
        const issue = (message: string) =>
          ctx.addIssue({ code: "custom", message });
        const unique = (values: (string | number)[]) =>
          new Set(values).size === values.length;
        const members = new Map(state.members.map((member) => [member.id, member]));
        const active = state.members.filter((member) => member.active);
        if (
          active.length < MIN_ACTIVE_MEMBERS ||
          active.length > MAX_ACTIVE_MEMBERS
        )
          issue(
            `A household needs ${MIN_ACTIVE_MEMBERS}–${MAX_ACTIVE_MEMBERS} active roommates.`,
          );
        if (
          !unique(state.members.map((member) => member.id)) ||
          !unique(state.members.map((member) => member.order))
        )
          issue("Roommate identities and roster positions must be unique.");
        if (!members.has(state.selectedMemberId))
          issue("The selected roommate does not exist.");
        for (const collection of [state.chores, state.expenses, state.agreements]) {
          if (!unique(collection.map((item) => item.id)))
            issue("Record identities must be unique.");
        }
        const events = state.chores.flatMap((chore) => chore.completionHistory);
        if (!unique(events.map((event) => event.id)))
          issue("Completion identities must be unique.");
        for (const chore of state.chores) {
          if (
            !members.has(chore.assigneeId) ||
            (chore.status === "pending" && !members.get(chore.assigneeId)?.active)
          )
            issue("Pending chores must be assigned to active roommates.");
          if (chore.status === "completed" && chore.completionHistory.length === 0)
            issue("Completed chores need a completion event.");
          if (
            chore.completionHistory.some(
              (event) => !members.has(event.completedById),
            )
          )
            issue("Completion history references a missing roommate.");
        }
        for (const expense of state.expenses) {
          const all = [...expense.payers, ...expense.participants];
          if (
            all.some(
              (row) =>
                !members.has(row.memberId) ||
                (expense.status === "open" && !members.get(row.memberId)?.active),
            )
          )
            issue("Open expenses must reference active roommates.");
          for (const rows of [expense.payers, expense.participants]) {
            if (!unique(rows.map((row) => row.memberId)))
              issue("A roommate may occur only once in each expense role.");
            if (
              rows.reduce((total, row) => total + BigInt(row.amountCents), 0n) !==
              BigInt(expense.amountCents)
            )
              issue("Expense contributions and shares must each equal the total.");
          }
          if (
            expense.splitMethod !== "percentage" &&
            expense.percentageBasisPoints !== undefined
          )
            issue("Only percentage splits may have percentage weights.");
          if (expense.splitMethod === "fixed") continue;
          const participants = [...expense.participants].sort(
            (a, b) =>
              (members.get(a.memberId)?.order ?? 0) -
              (members.get(b.memberId)?.order ?? 0),
          );
          const weights = expense.percentageBasisPoints;
          if (
            expense.splitMethod === "percentage" &&
            (!weights ||
              Object.keys(weights).length !== participants.length ||
              participants.some((row) => weights[row.memberId] === undefined) ||
              Object.values(weights).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) !== 10000)
          ) {
            issue("Percentages must match the participants and total 100.00%.");
            continue;
          }
          try {
            const ids = participants.map((row) => row.memberId);
            const expected =
              expense.splitMethod === "equal"
                ? splitEqual(expense.amountCents, ids)
                : splitPercentage(expense.amountCents, ids, weights!);
            if (
              expected.some(
                (row, index) => row.amountCents !== participants[index].amountCents,
              )
            )
              issue("Saved shares do not match the chosen split.");
          } catch {
            issue("Saved shares do not match the chosen split.");
          }
        }
        try {
          calculateBalances(state.members, state.expenses);
        } catch (error) {
          issue(
            error instanceof Error
              ? error.message
              : "Expense balances are invalid.",
          );
        }
      });
    
    export function validateState(value: unknown): AppState {
      const state = stateSchema.parse(value);
      if (
        !state.members.find((member) => member.id === state.selectedMemberId)
          ?.active
      ) {
        state.selectedMemberId = [...state.members]
          .filter((member) => member.active)
          .sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order)[0].id;
      }
      return state;
    }
    import { relativeDate } from "./dates";
    import { validateState } from "./validation";
    import type { AppState, Currency, Expense } from "./types";
    
    export function createSampleHousehold(
      now: Date,
      currency: Currency = "CAD",
    ): AppState {
      const createdAt = now.toISOString();
      const choreCreatedAt = new Date(now.getTime() - 7 * 86400000).toISOString();
      const day = (offset: number) => relativeDate(now, offset);
      const expense = (
        id: string,
        description: string,
        amountCents: number,
        daysAgo: number,
        category: string,
        payers: Expense["payers"],
        participants: Expense["participants"],
        options: Partial<Expense> = {},
      ): Expense => ({
        id,
        description,
        amountCents,
        date: day(-daysAgo),
        category,
        notes: "",

    export function Dialog({
      open,
      onClose,
      title,
      description,
      children,
      variant = "modal",
      id,
      size = "default",
    }: DialogProps) {
      const dialogRef = useRef<HTMLDialogElement>(null);
      const titleId = useId();
      const descriptionId = useId();
    
      useEffect(() => {
        const dialog = dialogRef.current;
        if (!dialog || !open) return;
        const trigger =
          document.activeElement instanceof HTMLElement
            ? document.activeElement
            : null;
        dialog.showModal();
        return () => {
          dialog.close();
          if (trigger?.isConnected) trigger.focus();
        };
      }, [open]);
    
      return (
        <dialog
          ref={dialogRef}
          id={id}
          aria-labelledby={titleId}
          aria-describedby={description ? descriptionId : undefined}
          onCancel={(event) => {
            event.preventDefault();

"inset-y-0 left-0 m-0 h-dvh max-h-dvh w-80 max-w-[calc(100%-2rem)] rounded-r-xl" : `inset-0 m-auto max-h-[calc(100dvh-2rem)] w-[calc(100%-2rem)] rounded-xl ${size === "wide" ? "max-w-2xl" : "max-w-lg"}`}`}

            <h2 id={titleId} className="min-w-0 break-words text-lg font-semibold">
              {title}
            </h2>
            <Button
              variant="ghost"
              onClick={onClose}
              aria-label={`Close ${title}`}
              title="Close"
              size="icon"
            >
              <X aria-hidden="true" className="size-5" />
            </Button>
          </div>
          <div className="overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain p-5">
            {description && (
              <p id={descriptionId} className="mb-5 break-words text-sm text-muted">
                {description}
              </p>
            )}
            {children}
          </div>
        </dialog>
      );
    }
    
    export function ConfirmDialog({
      open,
      onClose,
      onConfirm,
      title,
      description,
      confirmLabel,
      destructive = false,
      error,
    }: Omit<DialogProps, "children" | "variant" | "id"> & {
      onConfirm: () => void;
      confirmLabel: string;
      destructive?: boolean;
      error?: string;
    }) {
      return (
        <Dialog
          open={open}
          onClose={onClose}
          title={title}
          description={description}
        >
          {error && (
            <div className="mb-4">
              <InlineNotice tone="error">{error}</InlineNotice>
            </div>
          )}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-end gap-3">
            <Button variant="secondary" onClick={onClose}>
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button
              variant={destructive ? "danger" : "primary"}
              onClick={onConfirm}
            >
              {confirmLabel}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </Dialog>
      );
    }

    export function buttonStyles(

    ) {
      const variants: Record<Variant, string> = {
        primary: "border-transparent bg-accent text-white hover:bg-accent-hover",
        secondary: "border-line-strong bg-page text-ink hover:bg-subtle",
        ghost: "border-transparent text-muted hover:bg-hover hover:text-ink",

      return `inline-flex min-h-11 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-[7px] border text-sm font-medium transition-colors disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 ${spacing} ${variants[variant]} ${className}`;
    }
    
    export function Button({
      variant = "primary",
      className,
      type = "button",
      size = "default",
      ...props
    }: ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> & {
      variant?: Variant;
      size?: "default" | "icon";
    }) {
      return (
        <button
          type={type}
          className={buttonStyles(variant, className, size)}
          {...props}
        />
      );

    function subscribeDate(listener: () => void) {
      window.addEventListener("focus", listener);
      document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", listener);
      document.addEventListener("pointerdown", listener);
      document.addEventListener("keydown", listener);
      return () => {
        window.removeEventListener("focus", listener);
        document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", listener);
        document.removeEventListener("pointerdown", listener);
        document.removeEventListener("keydown", listener);
      };
    }

    export function activeMembers(state: AppState): Member[] {
      return state.members
        .filter((member) => member.active)
        .sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order);
    }
    
    export function archiveBlockReason(state: AppState, id: string): string | null {
      if (activeMembers(state).length <= MIN_ACTIVE_MEMBERS)
        return "At least two active roommates must remain.";
      const chores = state.chores.some(
        (chore) => chore.assigneeId === id && chore.status === "pending",
      );
      const expenses = state.expenses.some(
        (expense) =>
          expense.status === "open" &&
          [...expense.payers, ...expense.participants].some(
            (row) => row.memberId === id,
          ),
      );
      if (chores && expenses)
        return "Reassign this roommate's pending chores and settle their open expenses first.";
      if (chores) return "Reassign this roommate's pending chores first.";
      if (expenses) return "Settle this roommate's open expenses first.";
      return null;
    }
    
    export function createEmptyHousehold(
      input: SetupInput,
      makeId: () => string,
    ): AppState {
      const clean = setupSchema.parse({
        ...input,
        name: input.name.trim(),
        members: input.members.map((member) => ({
          ...member,
          name: member.name.trim(),
        })),
      });
      const members = clean.members.map((member, order) => ({
        ...member,
        id: makeId(),
        active: true,
        order,
      }));
      return validateState({
        schemaVersion: 1,
        household: { name: clean.name, currency: clean.currency },
        members,
        selectedMemberId: members[0].id,
        chores: [],
        expenses: [],
        agreements: [],
        starterMode: "empty",
      });
    }
    
    export function applyHouseholdAction(
      state: AppState,
      action: HouseholdAction,
      makeId: () => string,
    ): AppState {
      let next: AppState;
      if (action.type === "update-household") {
        const household = householdDraftSchema.parse({
          name: action.name.trim(),
          currency: action.currency,
        });
        if (
          household.currency !== state.household.currency &&
          state.expenses.length > 0
        )
          throw new Error(
            "Remove all expenses, including settled expenses, before changing currency.",
          );
        next = { ...state, household };
      } else if (action.type === "add-member") {
        if (activeMembers(state).length >= MAX_ACTIVE_MEMBERS)
          throw new Error(
            `A household can have at most ${MAX_ACTIVE_MEMBERS} active roommates.`,
          );
        const member = memberDraftSchema.parse({
          ...action.member,
          name: action.member.name.trim(),
        });
        next = {
          ...state,
          members: [
            ...state.members,
            {
              ...member,
              id: makeId(),
              active: true,
              order: Math.max(...state.members.map((item) => item.order)) + 1,
            },
          ],
        };
      } else {
        const member = state.members.find((item) => item.id === action.id);
        if (!member)
          throw new Error(
            "This roommate could not be found. Reload the household and try again.",
          );
        if (action.type === "select-member") {
          if (!member.active) throw new Error("Choose an active roommate.");
          next = { ...state, selectedMemberId: member.id };
        } else if (action.type === "edit-member") {
          const changes = memberDraftSchema.parse({
            ...action.member,
            name: action.member.name.trim(),
          });
          next = {
            ...state,
            members: state.members.map((item) =>
              item.id === member.id ? { ...item, ...changes } : item,
            ),
          };
        } else {
          const active = action.type === "restore-member";
          if (member.active === active) return state;
          if (active && activeMembers(state).length >= MAX_ACTIVE_MEMBERS)
            throw new Error(
              `Archive another roommate before restoring this one. The active limit is ${MAX_ACTIVE_MEMBERS}.`,
            );
          if (!active) {
            const reason = archiveBlockReason(state, member.id);
            if (reason) throw new Error(reason);
          }
          next = {
            ...state,
            members: state.members.map((item) =>
              item.id === member.id ? { ...item, active } : item,
            ),
          };
        }
      }
      return validateState(next);
    }

    const now = new Date(2026, 10, 23, 12);
    function harness(initial: string | null = null) {
      let raw = initial;
      let failRead = false,
        failWrite = false,
        failClear = false;
      let writes = 0;
      const storage: StoragePort = {
        getItem: () => {
          if (failRead) throw new Error("blocked");
          return raw;
        },
        setItem: (_key, value) => {
          if (failWrite) throw new Error("quota");
          raw = value;
          writes++;
        },
        removeItem: () => {
          if (failClear) throw new Error("blocked");
          raw = null;
        },
      };
      const store = createHouseholdStore(
        () => storage,
        () => "generated",
        () => now,
      );
      return {
        store,
        storage,
        raw: () => raw,
        writes: () => writes,
        external: (value: string | null) => {
          raw = value;
        },
        failReads: (value: boolean) => {
          failRead = value;
        },
        failWrites: (value: boolean) => {
          failWrite = value;
        },
        failClears: (value: boolean) => {
          failClear = value;
        },
      };
    }

    import type { Agreement, AppState } from "./types";
    import { agreementDraftSchema, validateState } from "./validation";
    
    export type AgreementDraft = Pick<Agreement, "title" | "details">;
    export type AgreementAction =
      | { type: "add-agreement"; agreement: AgreementDraft }
      | { type: "edit-agreement"; id: string; agreement: AgreementDraft }
      | { type: "delete-agreement"; id: string };
    
    export function applyAgreementAction(state: AppState, action: AgreementAction, makeId: () => string): AppState {
      const existing = action.type === "add-agreement" ? undefined : state.agreements.find((agreement) => agreement.id === action.id);
      if (action.type !== "add-agreement" && !existing) throw new Error("This agreement could not be found. Reload the household and try again.");
      if (action.type === "delete-agreement") return validateState({ ...state, agreements: state.agreements.filter((agreement) => agreement.id !== existing!.id) });
      const draft = agreementDraftSchema.parse({ ...action.agreement, title: action.agreement.title.trim() });
      const updated = { ...draft, id: existing?.id ?? makeId() };
      return validateState({ ...state, agreements: existing ? state.agreements.map((agreement) => agreement.id === existing.id ? updated : agreement) : [...state.agreements, updated] });
    }

    import { activeMembers } from "./household";

    import type { AppState } from "./types";
    
    export function dashboardSummary(state: AppState) {
      const selected = state.members.find((member) => member.id === state.selectedMemberId)!;
      const pendingChores = state.chores.filter((chore) => chore.assigneeId === selected.id && chore.status === "pending").sort((a, b) => a.dueDate.localeCompare(b.dueDate));
      return {
        selected,
        pendingChores,
        netCents: calculateBalances(state.members, state.expenses).find((row) => row.memberId === selected.id)!.netCents,
        openExpenseCount: state.expenses.filter((expense) => expense.status === "open").length,
        choreCounts: {
          pending: state.chores.filter((chore) => chore.status === "pending").length,
          completed: state.chores.filter((chore) => chore.status === "completed").length,
          skipped: state.chores.filter((chore) => chore.status === "skipped").length,
        },
        activeMemberCount: activeMembers(state).length,
        agreementCount: state.agreements.length,
      };
    }

    "use client";
    
    import { useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
    import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
    import { Dialog } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
    import { FormField, controlStyles } from "@/components/ui/form-field";
    import { InlineNotice } from "@/components/ui/inline-notice";
    import type { AgreementDraft } from "@/domain/agreements";
    import type { Agreement } from "@/domain/types";
    import { agreementDraftSchema } from "@/domain/validation";
    import { useReadyHousehold } from "@/state/household-provider";
    import { focusInvalid } from "../household/fields";
    
    export function AgreementForm({ agreement, onClose }: { agreement?: Agreement; onClose: () => void }) {
      const { store, conflict } = useReadyHousehold();
      const [draft, setDraft] = useState<AgreementDraft>({ title: agreement?.title ?? "", details: agreement?.details ?? "" });
      const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Partial<Record<keyof AgreementDraft, string>>>({});
      const [saveError, setSaveError] = useState<string>();
      function change(field: keyof AgreementDraft, value: string) {
        setDraft({ ...draft, [field]: value }); setErrors({ ...errors, [field]: undefined }); setSaveError(undefined);
      }
      function submit(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
        event.preventDefault();
        const parsed = agreementDraftSchema.safeParse({ ...draft, title: draft.title.trim() });
        if (!parsed.success) {
          const next: typeof errors = {};
          for (const issue of parsed.error.issues) next[issue.path[0] as keyof AgreementDraft] = issue.path[0] === "title" ? "Enter a title (1–100 characters)." : "Keep details to 1000 characters or fewer.";
          setErrors(next); focusInvalid(event.currentTarget); return;
        }
        setErrors({});
        const result = store.dispatch(agreement ? { type: "edit-agreement", id: agreement.id, agreement: parsed.data } : { type: "add-agreement", agreement: parsed.data }, agreement ? "Agreement updated." : "Agreement saved.");
        if (result.ok) onClose(); else setSaveError(result.error);
      }
      return <Dialog open title={agreement ? "Edit agreement" : "New agreement"} onClose={onClose}>
        <form noValidate onSubmit={submit} className="space-y-5">
          <FormField id="agreement-title" label="Title" required maxLength={100} value={draft.title} onChange={(event) => change("title", event.target.value)} error={errors.title} />
          <div className="space-y-2"><label htmlFor="agreement-details" className="block text-sm font-medium">Details (optional)</label><textarea id="agreement-details" className={`${controlStyles} min-h-36 resize-y`} rows={6} maxLength={1000} value={draft.details} onChange={(event) => change("details", event.target.value)} aria-invalid={Boolean(errors.details)} aria-describedby={errors.details ? "agreement-details-error" : "agreement-details-help"} /><p id="agreement-details-help" className="text-sm text-muted">For example, agree on quiet hours or how to handle overnight guests.</p>{errors.details && <p id="agreement-details-error" className="text-sm text-danger">{errors.details}</p>}</div>
          {conflict && <InlineNotice tone="error">This household changed in another tab. Close this dialog and reload the saved household before saving.</InlineNotice>}
          {saveError && <InlineNotice tone="error">{saveError}</InlineNotice>}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-end gap-3"><Button variant="secondary" onClick={onClose}>Cancel</Button><Button type="submit" disabled={conflict}>Save agreement</Button></div>
        </form>
      </Dialog>;
    }

    "use client";
    
    import Link from "next/link";
    import { BookOpen, CheckSquare, House } from "lucide-react";
    import { buttonStyles } from "@/components/ui/button";
    import { EmptyState } from "@/components/ui/empty-state";
    import { InlineNotice } from "@/components/ui/inline-notice";
    import { PageHeader } from "@/components/ui/page-header";
    import { useReadyHousehold } from "@/state/household-provider";
    import { calculateBalances, formatMoney } from "@/domain/money";
    import { displayDate } from "@/domain/dates";
    
    const sections = {
      agreements: {
        title: "House agreements",
        description: "Keep the expectations you share in one place.",
        Icon: BookOpen,
      },
    };
    
    export function FoundationScreen({
      section,
    }: {
      section: keyof typeof sections;
    }) {
      const { state } = useReadyHousehold();
      const { title, description, Icon } = sections[section];
      const records = state.agreements;
      return (
        <>
          <PageHeader
            title={title}
            description={description}
            icon={<Icon className="size-6" />}
          />
          <InlineNotice>
            Household data is saved locally. Agreement editing is coming soon.
          </InlineNotice>
          <div className="mt-6">
            {records.length === 0 ? (
              <EmptyState
                icon={<Icon className="size-6" />}
                title="Set the ground rules"
              >
                <p>
                  Your empty household is ready. Editing tools will appear as the
                  next milestones are completed.
                </p>
              </EmptyState>
            ) : (
              <ul
                className="divide-y divide-line rounded-[10px] border border-line"
                aria-label={title}
              >
                {section === "agreements" &&
                  state.agreements.map((agreement) => (
                    <li key={agreement.id} className="p-5">
                      <h2 className="break-words text-base font-semibold">
                        {agreement.title}
                      </h2>
                      <p className="mt-2 whitespace-pre-wrap break-words text-sm text-muted">
                        {agreement.details}
                      </p>
                    </li>
                  ))}
              </ul>
            )}
          </div>
        </>
      );
    }
    
    export function FoundationDashboard() {
      const { state } = useReadyHousehold();
      const selected = state.members.find(
        (member) => member.id === state.selectedMemberId,
      )!;
      const net = calculateBalances(state.members, state.expenses).find(
        (row) => row.memberId === selected.id,
      )!.netCents;
      const upcoming = state.chores
        .filter(
          (chore) => chore.assigneeId === selected.id && chore.status === "pending",
        )
        .sort((a, b) => a.dueDate.localeCompare(b.dueDate));
      return (
        <>
          <PageHeader
            title={state.household.name}
            description={`Your household from ${selected.name}'s perspective.`}
            icon={<House className="size-6" />}
          />
          <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-3">
            {[
              { label: "My pending chores", value: upcoming.length },
              {
                label: "My balance",
                value: formatMoney(Math.abs(net), state.household.currency),
                help:
                  net > 0 ? "You are owed" : net < 0 ? "You owe" : "You are even",
              },
              {
                label: "Open household expenses",
                value: state.expenses.filter((expense) => expense.status === "open")
                  .length,
              },
            ].map(({ label, value, help }) => (
              <section
                key={label}
                aria-label={label}
                className="min-w-0 rounded-[10px] border border-line p-5"
              >
                <h2 className="text-sm text-muted">{label}</h2>
                <p className="mt-3 break-words text-[28px] font-semibold leading-tight tabular-nums">
                  {value}
                </p>
                {help && <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-muted">{help}</p>}
              </section>
            ))}
          </div>
          <section className="mt-9">
            <div className="mb-4 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
              <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">My upcoming chores</h2>
              <Link href="/chores" className={buttonStyles("ghost")}>
                View chores
              </Link>
            </div>
            {upcoming.length ? (
              <ul className="divide-y divide-line rounded-[10px] border border-line">
                {upcoming.map((chore) => (
                  <li
                    key={chore.id}
                    className="flex flex-wrap justify-between gap-2 p-4"
                  >
                    <span className="font-medium">{chore.title}</span>
                    <span className="text-sm text-muted">
                      {displayDate(chore.dueDate)}
                    </span>
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            ) : (
              <EmptyState
                icon={<CheckSquare className="size-6" />}
                title="No pending chores assigned"
              >
                <p>There are no pending chores for {selected.name}.</p>
              </EmptyState>
            )}
          </section>
          <div className="mt-8">
            <InlineNotice>
              Saved on this browser only. Agreement editing is still in development.{" "}
              <Link
                href="/settings"
                className="font-medium text-accent underline underline-offset-4"
              >
                Manage your household in Settings.
              </Link>
            </InlineNotice>
          </div>
        </>
      );
    }

    import { applyAgreementAction, type AgreementAction } from "./agreements";

    const sample = () => createSampleHousehold(new Date(2026, 10, 24, 12));
    function act(action: AgreementAction) { return applyAgreementAction(sample(), action, () => "new-agreement"); }
    describe("house agreement facts", () => {
      it("creates a trimmed title, preserves multiline details and leaves unrelated facts unchanged", () => {
        const state = sample();
        const next = applyAgreementAction(state, { type: "add-agreement", agreement: { title: "  Quiet weekends  ", details: "Keep it calm.\n  Ask before a party.  " } }, () => "new-agreement");
        expect(next.agreements.at(-1)).toEqual({ id: "new-agreement", title: "Quiet weekends", details: "Keep it calm.\n  Ask before a party.  " });
        expect(state.agreements).toHaveLength(3);
        expect({ ...next, agreements: state.agreements }).toEqual(state);
      });
      it("edits only the selected agreement, keeps its identity/order and allows empty details", () => {
        const state = sample();
        const next = applyAgreementAction(state, { type: "edit-agreement", id: "quiet", agreement: { title: "Evening noise", details: "" } }, () => { throw new Error("An edit must not request a new ID."); });
        expect(next.agreements[0]).toEqual({ id: "quiet", title: "Evening noise", details: "" });
        expect(next.agreements.slice(1)).toEqual(state.agreements.slice(1));
        expect(state.agreements[0].title).toBe("Quiet hours");
      });
      it("deletes exactly one agreement", () => {
        expect(act({ type: "delete-agreement", id: "quiet" }).agreements).toEqual(sample().agreements.slice(1));
      });
      it.each([{ title: "", details: "" }, { title: "  ", details: "" }, { title: "x".repeat(101), details: "" }, { title: "Valid", details: "x".repeat(1001) }])("rejects invalid create/edit input (%j)", (agreement) => {
        expect(() => act({ type: "add-agreement", agreement })).toThrow();
        expect(() => act({ type: "edit-agreement", id: "quiet", agreement })).toThrow();
      });
      it("accepts the exact title/details limits", () => {
        expect(act({ type: "add-agreement", agreement: { title: "x".repeat(100), details: "y".repeat(1000) } }).agreements.at(-1)?.details).toHaveLength(1000);
      });
      it.each(["edit-agreement", "delete-agreement"] as const)("rejects missing records for %s", (type) => {

      });
    });

        expect(summary.selected.id).toBe("avery");
        expect(summary.pendingChores.map((chore) => chore.id)).toEqual(["kitchen"]);
        expect(summary.choreCounts).toEqual({ pending: 3, completed: 1, skipped: 1 });
        expect(summary.openExpenseCount).toBe(3);
        expect(summary.activeMemberCount).toBe(3);
        expect(summary.agreementCount).toBe(3);
        expect(summary.netCents).toBe(1000);
        const sam = dashboardSummary({ ...state, selectedMemberId: "sam" });
        expect(sam.netCents).toBe(1500);
        expect(sam.pendingChores.map((chore) => chore.id)).toEqual(["bathroom"]);
        expect(sam.choreCounts).toEqual(summary.choreCounts);
        expect(sam.openExpenseCount).toBe(summary.openExpenseCount);
      });
      it("sorts pending chores by due date and excludes completed/skipped/other assignments without mutating state", () => {
