        const before = structuredClone(state);
        expect(dashboardSummary(state).pendingChores.map((chore) => chore.id)).toEqual(["earlier", "kitchen", "later"]);

      });
      it("updates after real chore, expense and agreement actions without persisting derived counts", () => {

        state = applyExpenseAction(state, { type: "set-expense-status", id: "groceries", status: "settled" }, () => "unused", now);
        state = applyAgreementAction(state, { type: "delete-agreement", id: "quiet" }, () => "unused");

        expect(Object.keys(state).sort()).toEqual(Object.keys(createSampleHousehold(now)).sort());

    import { expect, test, type Page } from "@playwright/test";
    import { createSampleHousehold } from "../../src/domain/sample";
    import type { AppState } from "../../src/domain/types";
    
    const errorsByPage = new WeakMap<Page, string[]>();
    test.beforeEach(({ page }) => {
      const errors: string[] = []; errorsByPage.set(page, errors);
      page.on("pageerror", (error) => errors.push(error.message));
      page.on("console", (message) => { if (message.type() === "error") errors.push(message.text()); });
    });
    test.afterEach(({ page }) => expect(errorsByPage.get(page)).toEqual([]));
    async function seed(page: Page, path = "/agreements/", state = createSampleHousehold(new Date())) {
      await page.addInitScript((value) => {
        if (localStorage.getItem("roomieos:v1") === null) localStorage.setItem("roomieos:v1", JSON.stringify(value));
      }, state);
      await page.goto(path);
      await expect(page.getByRole("heading", { level: 1 })).toBeVisible();
    }
    function empty() { const state = createSampleHousehold(new Date()); state.chores = []; state.expenses = []; state.agreements = []; state.starterMode = "empty"; return state; }
    async function saved(page: Page): Promise<AppState> { return page.evaluate(() => JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("roomieos:v1")!)); }
    function agreementForm(page: Page, edit = false) { return page.getByRole("dialog", { name: edit ? "Edit agreement" : "New agreement", exact: true }); }
    function agreementActions(page: Page, title: string) { return page.getByRole("button", { name: `Actions for ${title}`, exact: true }); }
    async function action(page: Page, title: string, name: "Edit agreement" | "Delete agreement") {
      await agreementActions(page, title).click();
      await page.getByRole("group", { name: `Actions for ${title}`, exact: true }).getByRole("button", { name, exact: true }).click();
    }
    async function createAgreement(page: Page, title: string) {
      await page.getByRole("button", { name: "New agreement", exact: true }).click();
      await agreementForm(page).getByLabel("Title").fill(title);
      await agreementForm(page).getByRole("button", { name: "Save agreement", exact: true }).click();
      await expect(agreementForm(page)).not.toBeVisible();
    }
    async function noOverflow(page: Page) { expect(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth > innerWidth)).toBe(false); }
    function summaryCard(page: Page, name: string) { return page.getByRole("region", { name, exact: true }); }

    test("agreement storage failures preserve create/edit drafts and confirmed deletion until retry", async ({ page }) => {
      await seed(page, "/agreements/", empty());
      await page.evaluate(() => {
        const original = Storage.prototype.setItem;
        Storage.prototype.setItem = function (key, value) { if (key === "roomieos:v1" && sessionStorage.getItem("fail-agreement") === "yes") throw new DOMException("Full", "QuotaExceededError"); return original.call(this, key, value); };
      });
      const fail = (yes: boolean) => page.evaluate((blocked) => sessionStorage.setItem("fail-agreement", blocked ? "yes" : "no"), yes);
      await page.getByRole("button", { name: "New agreement", exact: true }).click();
      await agreementForm(page).getByLabel("Title").fill("Kitchen reset");
      await agreementForm(page).getByLabel("Details").fill("Wipe the counter.");
      await fail(true);
      await agreementForm(page).getByRole("button", { name: "Save agreement", exact: true }).click();
      await expect(agreementForm(page).getByText(/Couldn't save changes/)).toBeVisible();
      await expect(agreementForm(page).getByLabel("Details")).toHaveValue("Wipe the counter.");
      expect((await saved(page)).agreements).toEqual([]);
      await fail(false);
      await agreementForm(page).getByRole("button", { name: "Save agreement", exact: true }).click();
      await expect(agreementForm(page)).not.toBeVisible();
      await action(page, "Kitchen reset", "Edit agreement");
      await agreementForm(page, true).getByLabel("Details").fill("Clean the stove too.");
      await fail(true);
      await agreementForm(page, true).getByRole("button", { name: "Save agreement", exact: true }).click();
      await expect(agreementForm(page, true).getByText(/Couldn't save changes/)).toBeVisible();
      expect((await saved(page)).agreements[0].details).toBe("Wipe the counter.");
      await fail(false);
      await agreementForm(page, true).getByRole("button", { name: "Save agreement", exact: true }).click();
      await expect(agreementForm(page, true)).not.toBeVisible();
      await action(page, "Kitchen reset", "Delete agreement");
      const confirmation = page.getByRole("dialog", { name: "Delete agreement?", exact: true });
      await fail(true);
      await confirmation.getByRole("button", { name: "Delete agreement", exact: true }).click();
      await expect(confirmation.getByText(/Couldn't save changes/)).toBeVisible();
      expect((await saved(page)).agreements[0].details).toBe("Clean the stove too.");
      await fail(false);
      await confirmation.getByRole("button", { name: "Delete agreement", exact: true }).click();
      await expect(confirmation).not.toBeVisible();
      expect((await saved(page)).agreements).toEqual([]);
    });

      onDelete,

      agreement: Agreement;

      onDelete: () => void;
    }) {
      return (
        <details
          className="relative shrink-0"
          onKeyDown={(event) => {
            if (event.key === "Escape" && event.currentTarget.open) {
              event.preventDefault();
              event.stopPropagation();
              event.currentTarget.open = false;
              event.currentTarget.querySelector("summary")?.focus();

            if (!event.currentTarget.contains(event.relatedTarget))

          }}

            <MoreHorizontal aria-hidden="true" className="size-5" />

          <div

            aria-label={`Actions for ${agreement.title}`}

          >
            <Button
              variant="ghost"
              className="w-full justify-start"
              disabled={disabled}

              Edit agreement

            <Button

              onClick={(event) => {

                menu.open = false;

                onDelete();

            >
              <Trash2 aria-hidden="true" className="size-4" />

    }

    "use client";
    
    import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState } from "react";
    import { BookOpen, MoreHorizontal, Pencil, Plus, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";
    import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
    import { ConfirmDialog } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
    import { EmptyState } from "@/components/ui/empty-state";
    import { PageHeader } from "@/components/ui/page-header";
    import type { Agreement } from "@/domain/types";
    import { useReadyHousehold } from "@/state/household-provider";
    import { AgreementForm } from "./agreement-form";
    
    function AgreementActions({
      agreement,
      disabled,
      onEdit,
      onDelete,
    }: {
      agreement: Agreement;
      disabled: boolean;
      onEdit: () => void;
      onDelete: () => void;
    }) {
      const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
      const container = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
      const panelId = useId();
      const focusTrigger = () =>
        container.current
          ?.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>("[data-agreement-trigger]")
          ?.focus();
      useEffect(() => {
        if (!open) return;
        const closeOutside = (event: PointerEvent) => {
          if (
            event.target instanceof Node &&
            !container.current?.contains(event.target)
          )
            setOpen(false);
        };
        document.addEventListener("pointerdown", closeOutside);
        return () => document.removeEventListener("pointerdown", closeOutside);
      }, [open]);
      function choose(callback: () => void) {
        setOpen(false);
        focusTrigger();
        callback();
      }
      return (
        <div
          ref={container}
          className="relative shrink-0"
          onKeyDown={(event) => {
            if (event.key === "Escape" && open) {
              event.preventDefault();
              event.stopPropagation();
              setOpen(false);
              focusTrigger();
            }
          }}
          onBlur={(event) => {
            if (!event.currentTarget.contains(event.relatedTarget)) setOpen(false);
          }}
        >
          <Button
            variant="ghost"
            size="icon"
            data-agreement-trigger
            aria-label={`Actions for ${agreement.title}`}
            aria-expanded={open}
            aria-controls={panelId}
            disabled={disabled}
            onClick={() => setOpen(!open)}
            title="Agreement actions"
          >
            <MoreHorizontal aria-hidden="true" className="size-5" />
          </Button>
          {open && (
            <div
              id={panelId}
              role="group"
              aria-label={`Actions for ${agreement.title}`}
              className="absolute top-full right-0 z-10 mt-1 w-48 rounded-[7px] border border-line bg-page p-1 shadow-sm"
            >
              <Button
                variant="ghost"
                className="w-full justify-start"
                disabled={disabled}
                onClick={() => choose(onEdit)}
              >
                <Pencil aria-hidden="true" className="size-4" />
                Edit agreement
              </Button>
              <Button
                variant="ghost"
                className="w-full justify-start text-danger"
                disabled={disabled}
                onClick={() => choose(onDelete)}
              >
                <Trash2 aria-hidden="true" className="size-4" />
                Delete agreement
              </Button>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      );
    }
    
    export function AgreementsScreen() {
      const { state, store, conflict } = useReadyHousehold();
      const [editor, setEditor] = useState<Agreement | "new" | null>(null);
      const [deleting, setDeleting] = useState<Agreement | null>(null);
      const [error, setError] = useState<string>();
      function create() {
        store.dismissFeedback();
        setEditor("new");
      }
      return (
        <>
          <PageHeader
            title="House agreements"
            description="Keep the expectations you share in one place."
            icon={<BookOpen className="size-6" />}
            action={
              <Button id="new-agreement" disabled={conflict} onClick={create}>
                <Plus aria-hidden="true" className="size-4" />
                New agreement
              </Button>
            }
          />
          {state.agreements.length ? (
            <ul
              aria-label="House agreements"
              className="divide-y divide-line border-y border-line"
            >
              {state.agreements.map((agreement) => (
                <li key={agreement.id} className="py-6">
                  <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
                    <div className="min-w-0">
                      <h2 className="break-words text-lg font-semibold">
                        {agreement.title}

    # RoomieOS
    
    Your shared home, organized. An ENTI 407 client-side household prototype built with Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and Lucide.
    
    ## Local development
    
    Use Node.js 22.12 or newer and npm:
    
    ```sh
    npm ci
    npm run dev
    ```
    
    Open <http://localhost:3000>. Choose a sample household or create an empty household with a name, currency and 2–20 active roommates. Settings supports household edits, roommate names/avatars, archive/restore, reset demo and start over. The profile switcher changes your local demo perspective.
    
    Household data is validated and saved only in this browser under `roomieos:v1`. Refresh preserves changes; sample data is never silently regenerated. Invalid/unsupported data requires explicit confirmed recovery. Storage errors keep the previous household and form entries. If another tab changes the saved household, reload before editing further.
    
    Chores support create/edit/delete, List and Board views (Board opens by default), roommate/status filters, completion history and manual rotation with a confirmed due date. Click a chore title for details and actions. Completing a chore records the current demo perspective; reopening and rotating preserve its history.
    
    Expenses support create/edit/delete, multiple payers, equal/percentage/fixed participant splits, exact share previews, personal balances and household transfer suggestions. Click an expense for its contribution/share breakdown and actions. Marking an expense settled confirms that the whole expense was resolved outside RoomieOS; it removes the record's effect on balances and can be undone with Reopen. The app does not transfer money. Settled records remain editable, and currency stays locked until all expense records are removed. Archived historical roles remain visible; restore those roommates before reopening an expense that involves them.
    
    Agreement editing remains for the integration milestone. Photo uploads remain deferred; initials and 40 named icon avatars work locally, grouped by nature, animals, food/drink, hobbies and home/favorites.
    
    ## Current checkpoint
    
    Milestone 4 implements expenses and the dashboard's personal balance as of 24 November 2026. Next is Milestone 5: agreements CRUD, final dashboard composition and integration feedback. See [PLAN.md](PLAN.md) for progress and actual verification results.
    
    ## Checks
    
    ```sh
    npm run lint
    npm run typecheck
    npm test
    npm run build
    npm run test:browser
    ```
    
    Vitest checks exact cent parsing/formatting and allocation, multiple payers, all split methods, zero-sum nets and deterministic transfers, expense CRUD/settlement/reopening, chore history/rotation, archived members, local dates, setup, roster/currency guards, payload validation and storage transactions/failures. Browser tests exercise expense and chore workflows, previews/balances, setup/persistence, profile switching, roster management, recovery, failed-save retries, confirmations, cross-tab conflicts, large households/long content, responsive overflow and dialog keyboard behavior at 375, 768 and 1280 px. Install Playwright Chromium once with `npx playwright install chromium`, or use an existing compatible Chromium executable:
    
    ```sh
    CHROMIUM_PATH=/usr/bin/chromium-browser npm run test:browser
    ```
    
    The browser suite starts its own local dev server on port 3100 with an isolated `.next-e2e/` build directory, leaving a running preview on port 3000 alone. General browser checks use UTC in both the runner and Chromium to avoid differences in their daylight-saving databases; a separate Edmonton-time check covers local-midnight overdue updates. Override the test port with `ROOMIEOS_TEST_PORT` if necessary. Screenshots and failure traces are saved under the ignored `test-results/` directory.
    
    ## Hydration troubleshooting
    
    If the development overlay shows unexpected HTML attributes such as `bis_skin_checked` or `bis_register`, a browser extension may have modified the page before React hydrated it. Those attributes are not generated by RoomieOS. Try a fresh browser profile with extensions disabled, or a private window where no extensions are allowed. If the warning disappears, disable the responsible extension for localhost and reload. See the [Next.js hydration guide](https://nextjs.org/docs/messages/react-hydration-error).
    
    Keep hydration diagnostics enabled. The route browser test checks both uncaught errors and console errors, including React hydration warnings, in an isolated browser context. If the warning persists with extensions disabled, inspect the new diff for an application mismatch.
    
    ## Structure and deployment
    
    - `src/app`: static App Router pages and household route-group layout.
    - `src/components`: shared shell and UI primitives.
    - `src/features`: feature views; foundation views will be replaced incrementally.
    - `src/domain`: serializable types, runtime validation, household/chore/expense actions, integer money allocation/netting, date helpers and sample generation.
    - `src/state`: household provider, hydration gate and save-before-publish storage store.
    - `src/styles`: design tokens mapped into Tailwind.
    
    `npm run build` exports static files to `out/`, suitable for Vercel. There are no backend API routes, server mutations, remote fonts or service integrations. No deployment is performed by the foundation scripts.
    
    Read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md), [PLAN.md](PLAN.md), [PRD](docs/PRD.md) and [DESIGN](docs/DESIGN.md) before implementation. PLAN tracks verified progress; PRD and DESIGN remain authoritative for behavior and UI/UX.

    test("failed writes keep setup and settings drafts available for retry", async ({
      page,
    }) => {
      await page.addInitScript(() => {
        const original = Storage.prototype.setItem;
        Object.assign(window, {
          allowRoomieosWrites: () => {
            Storage.prototype.setItem = original;
          },
        });
        Storage.prototype.setItem = function (key, value) {
          if (key === "roomieos:v1")
            throw new DOMException("Full", "QuotaExceededError");
          original.call(this, key, value);
        };
      });
      await enterEmpty(page);
      await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Create my household" }).click();
      await expect(
        page.getByRole("alert").filter({ hasText: "Couldn't save changes" }),
      ).toBeVisible();
      await expect(page.getByLabel("Household name")).toHaveValue("Cedar House");
      await expect(page.getByLabel("Roommate 1 name")).toHaveValue("Alex");
      expect(await saved(page)).toBeNull();
      await page.evaluate(() =>
        (
          window as unknown as { allowRoomieosWrites: () => void }
        ).allowRoomieosWrites(),
      );
      await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Create my household" }).click();
      await expect(page.getByRole("heading", { level: 1 })).toHaveText(
        "Cedar House",
      );
      // Use client navigation so the initial failure injection is not reinstalled on reload.
      await page
        .getByRole("link", { name: "Manage your household in Settings." })
        .click();
      const before = await saved(page);
      await page.evaluate(() => {
        const original = Storage.prototype.setItem;
        Object.assign(window, {
          allowRoomieosWrites: () => {
            Storage.prototype.setItem = original;
          },
        });
        Storage.prototype.setItem = function () {
          throw new DOMException("Full", "QuotaExceededError");
        };
      });
      await page.getByLabel("Household name").fill("Unsaved name");
      await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Save household" }).click();
      await expect(page.getByLabel("Household name")).toHaveValue("Unsaved name");
      expect(await saved(page)).toEqual(before);
      await page.evaluate(() =>
        (
          window as unknown as { allowRoomieosWrites: () => void }
        ).allowRoomieosWrites(),
      );
      await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Save household" }).click();
      await expect(page.getByRole("status")).toContainText("Household saved");
      expect((await saved(page))!.household.name).toBe("Unsaved name");
    });
